title: Chef to join our international kitchen team
description:
CHEF WANTED FOR STAFF RESTAURANT IN COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

Looking for a chef position in Copenhagen with great working hours, professional cooking and weekends mostly free?

We are looking for a skilled and motivated chef to join our international kitchen team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Your main workplace will be The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine, located at Kalvebod Brygge in central Copenhagen.

This is a full-time position with working hours primarily Monday to Friday from 06:30 to 14:30 – giving you the opportunity to work in an ambitious professional kitchen while still having your afternoons, evenings and most weekends free.

Occasional evening and weekend events may occur.

THE JOB

You will become part of a professional kitchen team responsible for the daily production and service at our staff restaurant.

We cook from scratch and care about good ingredients, seasonality, flavour and proper craftsmanship.

You will work primarily with hot kitchen production and take responsibility for your own preparation and tasks while working closely with the rest of the team.

Our kitchen is busy, so we are looking for someone who works efficiently and in an organised manner without compromising quality.

Just as importantly, we are looking for a good colleague.

We believe a professional kitchen should be a place where people communicate respectfully, help each other and enjoy coming to work.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

You may already be living in Denmark, or you may be considering moving to Copenhagen from another EU/EEA country.

We would like to hear from you if you:

  • are a trained chef or have equivalent professional kitchen experience

  • have experience from à la carte restaurants, quality staff restaurants, hotels or similar professional kitchens

  • have solid experience in the hot kitchen

  • have a genuine interest in food, ingredients and good craftsmanship

  • can organise your own work and maintain a good pace throughout the day

  • are reliable and comfortable starting work early

  • enjoy working as part of a team

  • communicate in a positive and respectful way

  • can maintain an overview when the kitchen gets busy.

A background in classic French or Mediterranean cuisine would be particularly relevant to our kitchen.

However, we are also interested in chefs who bring their own culinary background and experience. Whether your inspiration comes from France, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Greece, North or South America, Asia or somewhere else, we would like to see what you can bring to the team.

We want to taste what you are passionate about.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a full-time chef position in central Copenhagen with a working schedule that is unusual in the restaurant industry:

Monday–Friday
Primarily 06:30–14:30
Most evenings and weekends free

You will join a friendly and international workplace with experienced colleagues, high professional standards and room to contribute your own knowledge and ideas.

We value professional pride, teamwork, reliability and a positive working environment.

Our goal is simple: good food, good ingredients, good craftsmanship and a kitchen team that works well together.

MORE THAN A STAFF RESTAURANT

Your daily workplace will be:

The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine
Kalvebod Brygge 35
1560 Copenhagen V
Denmark

Our kitchen also produces food for our small Copenhagen wine bar, Sankt Annæ 8, located in Christianshavn.

Within the same ownership group, we operate several Copenhagen restaurants, including Le Métier, La Propina and Ma Cuisine.

You will therefore become part of a wider restaurant family with different concepts and opportunities for future professional development.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Chef
Employment: Full-time
Working hours: Primarily Monday–Friday, 06:30–14:30
Workplace: Copenhagen, Denmark
Starting date: As soon as possible / by agreement
Salary: Based on qualifications and experience and agreed individually
Evening/weekend work: Occasional events only

INTERESTED?

Send us your CV and a short application in English to:

job@willworkforfood.dk

Please write “CHEF FOR ABACUS” in the subject line.

Tell us a little about yourself, your kitchen experience, what kind of food you enjoy cooking and when you would be available to start.

Applications are reviewed continuously, and suitable candidates will be invited for an interview.

If you are currently living outside Denmark, please mention your current location and when you would potentially be available to relocate to Copenhagen.

We look forward to meeting you for a coffee and a conversation about food, ambitions and your future in Copenhagen.

The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine
Copenhagen, Denmark

title: PhD scholarship at the Danish Institute for International Studies
description:
PhD scholarship at the Danish Institute for International Studies, Military Artificial Intelligence, Peace and International Security

The Danish Institute for International Studies (DIIS) is recruiting a PhD candidate to research military applications of artificial intelligence and their implications for peace and international security. We are especially interested in projects that examine how the development and use of AI-based military capabilities affect established practices of decision-making, human control, and accountability. The project should connect a nuanced understanding of the dynamics of technological change to wider questions of arms control and international regulation. 

The position is based at the DIIS Centre for Peace Research and will thematically be placed under one of the three pillars of the Centre, namely Arms control in a time of arms races and war. One of the questions that the Centre focuses on is how Nordic countries, including Denmark, can navigate a situation where the development of new technologies (e.g. AI and drones), along with increasing great power rivalry and competition in space, entail new types of security risks that traditional arms control models and treaties do not effectively regulate.

The successful candidate will develop an independent PhD project that speaks to the overall focus of the center and produces research relevant to Nordic and international debates on security and peace.

About the position 
AI is changing how military organizations collect information, assess threats, select targets and coordinate operations. These capabilities are currently developed faster than military doctrine, legal interpretation and oversight arrangements intended to govern their use. This raises questions about who exercises control, how responsibility is assigned, and how other states interpret capabilities whose operation is difficult to observe. Within this overall frame relevant proposals may examine:

  • The relationship between the adoption of AI and the development of military doctrine

  • The effects of AI-enabled decision support on military decision-making and the human role therein

  • The impact of uncertainty and opacity around the current state of AI integration among militaries on escalation dynamics and arms-race dynamics

  • Regulation of AI through multilateral governance mechanisms in and beyond the UN

  • Human judgement and accountability in military applications of AI

About DIIS and the position
The successful candidate will be employed by DIIS in a three-year, full-time PhD position, expected to commence on 1 February 2027. The candidate will be enrolled in the PhD School at the Faculty of Social Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), while their primary place of work will be the Centre for Peace Research at DIIS.

The PhD project will be jointly supervised by a senior researcher at DIIS and Professor Ingvild Bode at SDU.

At DIIS, the PhD candidate will join an inspiring and ambitious research environment committed to advancing multidisciplinary scholarship. The successful candidate is expected to engage actively in cross-disciplinary collaboration and to value insights from colleagues working with different theoretical and methodological approaches. Such exchanges across disciplinary boundaries are central to the research environment at DIIS.

We expect the candidate to:

  • have obtained a master’s degree in a relevant field

  • have at least received the grade of 10 (or equivalent) for the master’s thesis according to the Danish 7-point grading scale and a high weighted grade point average 

  • meet the general requirements for being accepted for enrolment as a PhD candidate (see below)

  • live up to the DIIS entry criteria for PhD positions https://www.diis.dk/files/media/document/diis-entry-criteria-rev-okt-24.pdf 

  • communicate clearly in written and spoken English, and proficiency in Danish is an advantage.

DIIS as a workplace
We offer an attractive and inclusive workplace where our employees can develop. We consider knowledge sharing and feedback essential to creating a dynamic workplace. We expect you to participate proactively in the common efforts of the institute. We prioritize a high degree of presence but want our employees to have a good work-life balance. Therefore, we offer flexible working hours and some possibility of working from home. We are located very close to Copenhagen’s city center with excellent public transportation options.

DIIS is a diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified candidates to apply for this position regardless of their personal background. DIIS is also a workplace where we consider the environmental consequences of our activities and strive to adopt more environmentally sustainable practices both in relation to our daily business at DIIS and our global travel activities.

In the assessment, consideration will be given to the following criteria:

  • The applicant has a relevant master’s degree or equivalent qualifications (corresponding to the 3 + 2 Bologna process), cf. the Danish qualifications framework for higher education

  • Quality and relevance of the project description

    • Quality and relevance of the methodical and theoretical choices

    • Consistency and coherence between the research problem and the choice of method and theory

    • The realistic and feasible scope of the PhD project

  • Relevance of the project for the DIIS Centre for Peace Research and DIIS in general

Contract and remuneration
The position as PhD candidate starts on 1 February 2027 and is a 3-year full-time position. Remuneration and other job conditions follow the general agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and the Danish Ministry of Finance, local collective agreements at DIIS as well as the 28 June 2019 Danish state protocol on PhD candidates. 

The standard starting salary for a PhD candidate at DIIS is 379,702,61 DKK per year excl. pensions – this may be increased depending on prior work experience after the acquisition of the master’s degree. A pension contribution of 18,07% is added to the above-mentioned salary.

Do you want to know more?
Visit http://www.diis.dk/jobs to learn more about DIIS as a workplace. Questions regarding employment and renumeration can be sent to hr@diis.dk. If you have inquiries regarding the professional focus of the position, you can contact Senior Researcher and Head of Research Unit, Mona Kanwal Sheikh at mosh@diis.dk  

The application
Deadline for applying is 23 October 2026, at 12.00 pm CET. 

Please note that we only accept applications through DIIS’ electronic recruitment system. 

Your application must include all the following documents:

  1. A motivational letter

  2. Curriculum Vitae 

  3. Master’s diploma including grades. If you hold a master’s degree which is not within the ECTS-framework, please also provide:

    • Your bachelor diploma and bachelor grades

    • A statement clarifying the subject and length (in years) of the master’s degree

    • An English translation of your diplomas 

  4. PhD project proposal (max 5 pages)

  5. Publication list

DIIS is an independent public research institution for international studies. We conduct and communicate multidisciplinary research on globalisation, security, development and foreign policy and within these areas we aim to be agenda-setting in research, policy and public debate.

DIIS participates in academic networks and publish in high-ranking academic journals, always striving to excel in academic scholarship.

We continuously assess Denmark's foreign and political situation and inform the Danish media, politicians and the public about our work

title: Postdoc in intestinal regeneration and mucosal immunology
description:
A full-time (100%) postdoctoral position is available in the lab of Dr. Srustidhar Das, at the Department of Clinical Research and at the Research Unit of Inflammation Research, Department of Molecular Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to two years, with the possibility of extension subject to funding.

Research tasks

The position comprises research, teaching, professional development and supervision within intestinal tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, mucosal immunology and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The postdoc will join a translational research programme that investigates how inflammation reshapes the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how these changes can be targeted to promote safe and durable mucosal healing.

The successful candidate will combine patient-derived organoid and co-culture models with molecular biology, functional assays, and computational analysis of single-cell and spatial datasets. The position is particularly suited to a researcher who can connect experimental biology with bioinformatics and clinically relevant questions.

Research environment

The postdoc will be embedded in a dynamic and highly collaborative research environment spanning the Department of Clinical Research and the Department of Molecular Medicine at SDU. The project benefits from close interaction among basic scientists, clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers, with strong links to Odense University Hospital and access to patient-derived material, advanced disease models and state-of-the-art molecular technologies.

The environment provides excellent opportunities to develop an independent research profile, contribute to clinically relevant discoveries in IBD and tissue regeneration, and build collaborations across experimental, computational and clinical disciplines.

Research project

The project investigates how inflammatory history establishes persistent epithelial and niche memory, shapes epithelial plasticity and influences intestinal regeneration in IBD. Using patient-derived biopsies, intestinal organoids, fibroblasts and immune-cell co-cultures, we will determine how epithelial memory and injury-induced cell-state transitions influence regenerative capacity and distinguish effective from impaired mucosal healing.

Functional experiments will be integrated with single-cell RNA sequencing, chromatin-accessibility analysis, spatial transcriptomics and spatial epigenomics. CRISPR-engineered patient-derived organoids, including lineage reporters and targeted genetic perturbations, will be used to trace epithelial cell states and validate candidate mechanisms. Selected organoids will also be tested in engraftment models to determine whether regenerative phenotypes translate into improved tissue integration and repair in vivo.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish and manipulate patient-derived intestinal organoids and fibroblast–immune-cell co-cultures to investigate epithelial plasticity, cell-state transitions, regeneration, inflammatory responses and barrier function.

  • Generate and validate CRISPR-engineered organoids, including reporter lines and targeted genetic perturbations, and perform engraftment studies to assess regenerative potential in vivo.

  • Analyse and integrate scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomic and spatial epigenomic datasets using reproducible workflows for quality control, differential analysis, cell-state annotation, trajectory analysis and multimodal integration.

  • Apply molecular and cellular methods, including qPCR, immunostaining, advanced microscopy, flow cytometry and ELISA-based assays, and validate candidate pathways using pharmacological and CRISPR-based perturbations where appropriate.

  • Collaborate with clinicians, experimental scientists and bioinformaticians to analyse and interpret patient-derived samples and data.

  • Maintain accurate and reproducible records, present findings, prepare manuscripts and conference contributions, and contribute to grant applications, teaching and supervision where relevant.

Expectations of qualifications

The successful applicant must hold a PhD in molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, bioinformatics, computational biology, regenerative medicine, biomedicine or a closely related discipline, with documented research experience relevant to the project.

Essential qualifications

  • Documented experience in organoid biology, preferably involving intestinal or other tissue-derived epithelial organoids, and in designing mechanistic studies of epithelial plasticity and regeneration.

  • A strong background in tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, mucosal immunology, inflammatory disease or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated expertise in analysing single-cell or spatial-omics data, with proficiency in R and/or Python and experience developing reproducible computational workflows.

  • Hands-on experience in molecular and cell biology, with the ability to design, perform, troubleshoot and interpret experiments using a structured and careful approach to data analysis, documentation and responsible research practice.

  • A strong publication record appropriate to career stage; excellent written and spoken English; and the ability to drive projects independently while collaborating effectively in a multidisciplinary and international environment.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with intestinal organoids, patient-derived material, fibroblast or immune-cell culture, or epithelial–stromal–immune co-culture models.

  • Experience integrating scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomic, spatial epigenomic or other multimodal datasets.

  • Familiarity with advanced imaging, quantitative image analysis, flow cytometry, organoid phenotyping or high-content screening.

  • Demonstrated experience generating and validating CRISPR-engineered organoids, including knock-in reporters or targeted gene perturbations, and with intestinal organoid engraftment or transplantation and in vivo assessment of epithelial regeneration is highly preferred.

  • An interest in supervising junior researchers and contributing to collaborative teaching and research activities.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Dr. Srustidhar Das, Department of Clinical Research and Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), tel.: +45 71504339, e-mail: srudas@health.sdu.dk

Application deadline

November 1, 2026 at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M, Denmark.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Facility manager wanted
description:
Facility Management Employees Wanted

Are you service-minded, practical, and good at making everyday operations run smoothly? Then we may have the job for you.

We are looking for skilled and responsible Facility Management employees for temporary assignments with our clients.

As a temporary Facility Management employee, you will become an important part of our clients’ daily operations. The tasks may vary from workplace to workplace, which is why we are looking for someone who is flexible, solution-oriented, and ready to step in wherever needed.

Your Responsibilities

  • Daily operation and inspection of facilities

  • Practical service and maintenance tasks

  • Preparing meeting rooms and common areas

  • Internal service for employees and guests

  • Receiving and handling goods and deliveries

  • Waste management and ensuring that common areas are kept tidy

  • Minor repairs and practical ad hoc tasks

  • Contact and coordination with external suppliers

  • Following up on faults and deficiencies

  • Moving and setting up furniture and equipment

  • Ensuring that the client’s facilities are presentable and function smoothly on a daily basis

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who sees a task and takes responsibility for getting it done.

You do not necessarily need many years of experience in Facility Management. The most important thing is that you are reliable, service-minded, and have a practical approach to your work.

We value candidates who:

  • Are reliable and responsible

  • Have a practical and solution-oriented approach

  • Have a professional and service-minded attitude

  • Can work independently and take initiative

  • Are flexible when it comes to different workplaces and tasks

  • Can communicate professionally with clients, colleagues, and suppliers

  • Have basic IT skills

  • Can maintain an overview when handling several tasks at the same time

Experience in Facility Management, property services, caretaker services, internal services, hospitality, warehousing, cleaning, or similar fields is an advantage, but not a requirement.

We Offer

As a temporary employee with us, you will have the opportunity to work for different companies and build experience within Facility Management.

We offer:

  • Exciting assignments with different clients

  • Full time work

title: Postdoc in Veterinary Microbiology
description:
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen



We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated veterinary microbiologist for a 2-year part-time postdoc position starting around 1st January 2027. The new postdoc is expected to contribute to the scientific and teaching activities of the research group One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) within the section of Veterinary Clinical Microbiology. Additionally, the postdoc will be responsible for defined scientific and management activities within the project SOA36 - Designing best veterinary practices to reduce antimicrobial and antiparasitic use (BEST-VET), funded by the European Partnership on Animal Health and Welfare (EUPAHW). These responsibilities include supporting the project Chair in the day-to-day coordination and management of the consortium, as well as planning and conducting research aimed at reducing antimicrobial use in pigs through improved diagnostic and treatment protocols for key endemic bacterial diseases, and active involvement in the development of clinical guidelines for prudent antimicrobial use in pig medicine, with a particular focus on developing evidence-based guidelines using the GRADE approach. Through these activities, the postdoc will contribute to strengthening antimicrobial stewardship and promoting evidence-based best practices in veterinary medicine.

Information on the department and the section can be found at: https://ivh.ku.dk/.

Our research
The postdoc will be part of the OHAR research group led by Prof. Luca Guardabassi. Our research is characterized by two focus areas:

  • Development of diagnostic tests and methods to reduce and rationalize antimicrobial use in animals.
  • Optimization of veterinary antimicrobial use to minimize selection and spread of antimicrobial resistance.
For more information, please check the OHAR homepage One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) – University of Copenhagen

Your job
You are a highly qualified veterinary microbiologist with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team. You will be required to be physically present in the laboratory to contribute to ongoing research projects and oversee experiments conducted by PhD, MSc, and BSc students. As part of the EU project BEST-VET, you will contribute to selected work packages and expert groups, including WP1 (Reduction of drug use in pigs), WP7 (Environmental impact of antimicrobial/antiparasitic drugs and phage therapy), Expert Group 1 (Phages and their environmental impact), Expert Group 3 (Standardization of sampling, metagenomics & analytical methods) and Expert Group 5 (Clinical guidance). You will be responsible for coordinating and following up on SOA36 activities related to these work packages and expert groups. You will also act as a key point of contact between the project management, work package leaders and expert groups. Your project management responsibilities will further include supporting the organisation of Management Board meetings, following up on project activities and deadlines, and maintaining the SOA36 SharePoint and associated project documentation. As part of the position, you will undertake a one-year training programme in evidence-based guideline development using the GRADE approach and subsequently contribute to the development of evidence-based clinical guidelines for veterinary medicine.

Profile
We are seeking a highly qualified scientist with a strong track record of independent research in veterinary bacteriology and experience in international collaborative research project coordination, as well as in the supervision and teaching of veterinary and postgraduate students.

Essential experience and skills:

  • A MSc degree in Veterinary Medicine
  • A PhD in Veterinary Microbiology or a closely related field
  • Previous postdoctoral experience
  • Outstanding publication record in relation to career stage
  • Excellent scientific writing and oral communication skills
  • Experience in supervising PhD, MSc, and BSc students
  • Experience in the coordination and management of collaborative research projects
  • Experience with bacterial whole-genome sequencing and genomic data analysis
  • Knowledge of key concepts in antimicrobial stewardship
Desirable experience and skills:

  • Research experience in antimicrobial resistance
  • Experience in metagenomics
  • Experience in routine bacteriological and mycological diagnostics
  • Experience in preparing research proposals and applications for external funding
Place of employment
The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories that are fully equipped to perform traditional and molecular microbiology, including omics.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 per week.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

Questions
For further information please contact Luca Guardabassi (lg@sund.ku.dk).

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Please include

  • Curriculum vitae
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers
After the expiry date or applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Application deadline: 15 October 2026, 23.59 CEST.

Interviews are expected to be held in weeks 44-45 (26th October – 5th November 2026).

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, nationality, race, religion or sexual orientation. Appointment will be based on merit alone.

title: Sales Executive  - Ready to turn Software/ERP expertise into closed deals? Interform HQ Birkerød, DK or Remote
description:
The role

Interform builds InterformNG2, an Output Management platform that sits next to the ERP and handles the documents a business runs on: invoices, labels, delivery notes, e-invoicing. When output fails, shipments stop and invoices get rejected. Our customers buy certainty that this never happens.

You will sell InterformNG2 to new customers across Europe - with our core markets in the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux and the UK - typically manufacturing, logistics and distribution companies running ERPs such as Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or IBM i. You own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed agreement.

There is no BDR team here, but you are not starting from a blank sheet either. We identify the most relevant accounts together, backed by an AI-driven engine that tracks buying signals across our markets. Your job is what happens next: the outreach, the conversations, the proposals and the close.

What you will do

  • Turn qualified target accounts into meetings, pipeline and closed deals across your European territory.

  • Open doors through direct outreach and your own network of ERP consultants, partners and IT decision-makers.

  • Run full sales cycles - qualification, demo coordination, proposal, negotiation, close - in close collaboration with the rest of the commercial team.

  • Work with our partner ecosystem around Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i and other ERP platforms as a second route to market.

  • Feed what you learn in the market back into how we position and price.

Who you are

  • Driven. You show up every day ready to do your best, and you keep that standard through long sales cycles.

  • Connected in the ERP ecosystem. Ecosystem knowledge is essential in this role: you know at least one major ERP ecosystem in real depth - the partners and implementation consultants in it, how they influence a deal and when to bring them in - and you bring a working network you can call on from day one.

  • Self-starting. You plan your own work, execute without being chased, and deliver.

  • Accountable. You own your number and you follow up - customers can trust that you are always a step ahead.

  • At home in the ERP world. You have sold software or services into environments running Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i or comparable ERP platforms, and you speak the language of IT managers and operations directors.

  • AI-forward. You already use AI in your daily sales work - research, preparation, follow-up - and want a company that works the same way.

  • A closer. You have proven you can turn outreach into pipeline and pipeline into signed deals - not just manage inbound.

  • Languages: fluent English is required. German, Danish or Dutch on top is a strong advantage - ideally you cover one of our core markets natively.

What we offer

  • A place in a solid company: profitable, in strong growth, and with a large market still ahead of us.

  • A product that is easy to stand behind: more than 4,500 installations worldwide, and customers who stay.

  • A defined category - Output Management - where we compete on depth, not noise.

  • Short decision paths and direct access to management.

  • An AI-driven account-based marketing engine that shows you which companies are in the market - so your time goes to conversations, not list-building.

  • A competitive package that rewards what you close.

About Interform A/S

Interform has built Output Management software since 1987 from our headquarters in Birkerød, Denmark. Our platform, InterformNG2, works with any ERP, any format and any environment - customers change or upgrade their ERP and keep their output running. Our first customer from 1987 is still with us today. Our customer base is international - companies across the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux, the UK and further afield - and our own team works across borders in the same way, with colleagues based in Denmark and Germany. We are a profitable, solidly run company in strong growth, and investment backing supports continued development of the platform.

Practical details

  • Location: our office in Birkerød, Denmark, or remote from anywhere in our European markets - we already have employees working outside Denmark, so a distributed setup is nothing new to us.

  • Travel: limited. Most sales work runs remotely, with occasional customer, partner and event travel.

  • Reports to: our Chief Commercial Officer - you will work alongside the rest of the commercial team.

  • Start: as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter, including the deals you are most proud of.

Birkerød I Remote

Erfaring indenfor restaurationsbranchen er et krav, og det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet at være i fronlinien for gæsterne før. Det vigtige er at finde den rette medarbejder, som brænder lige så meget som os, for at servicere og give vores gæster en god oplevelse.

Vi forventer at du er en smilende, udadvendt og serviceminded person, som stræber efter at give gæsten den bedste oplevelse. Det er vigtigt at du er mødestabil, venlig og positiv indstillet. Du skal kunne arbejde på alle ugens dage indenfor restaurantens åbningstid.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår aftales.

Ansøgningen sendes på mail: info@slagslunde.com.  Frist for ansøgningen er 30. oktober 2026.

title: Erfaren kok søges
description:
Vi på Restaurant Varna søger en ny kok med tiltrædelse efter aftale.


Vi er en multifunktionel restaurant som arbejder med mange typer afviklinger.
Vi laver overvejende selskaber i alle afskygninger. Vi er værter for mange bryllupper, konfirmationer, firmafester, julefrokoster, brunchselskaber og barnedåbe - alt fra 15 op til 300 personer.
Vi kan have flere selskaber i huset på samme tid - hvorfor vi ofte har 3 selskaber eller flere på en dag. 

Vi har sideløbende en ala carte restaurant som har åbent når vi ikke er fuldt booket med selskaber.
Her arbejder vi på højt niveau med en 5 retters menu med mulighed for tilkøb af yderligere.
På søndage har vi oftest luksus-brunch med 100-160 gæster, mens vi har andre selskaber.

Nøgleordet i vores virke er en 5-stjernet oplevelse - 360 grader.
Vi bestræber os på at give vores gæster en fuldkommen oplevelse med alt det indebærer, samtidig med, at vores personale har gode arbejdsforhold, trivsel og ordentlighed på arbejdspladsen. 

Vi søger en person som kan opfylde følgende krav:
 - Dansktalende erfaren kok
 - Erfaring med afvikling af selskaber og ala carte
 - Ledererfaring og er god til at lære fra sig
 - En person som rummer højt humør og humor
 - Er god til strukturering - både fra dag til dag, men også med et overblik over den næste uge og måned
 - En som har en kreativ tilgang til udarbejdelse af nye menuer
 - En holdspiller

Dette kan vi tilbyde dig:
 - Udvikling indenfor følgende områder:
    Strukturering, ledelse, planlægning, sammensætning af menuer, medarbejderudvikling og overblik
 - Gode arbejdsforhold med mulighed for en fleksibel arbejdskalender
 - God løn som sættes efter kvalifikationer
 - En plads i et team af passionerede kollegaer
 
Lyder ovenstående som noget for dig, så send os et cv, og vi vil tage en samtale om muligheden for en ansættelse.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Lastbilchauffør søges til Fri Transport ApS

title: Svejser søges
description:

title: Er du den fagperson, man kan regne med, når det bliver komplekst?
description:
Hos MerCare søger vi erfarne socialfaglige vikarer, der vil mere end bare tage en vagt.

Hos MerCare leder vi ikke efter flest muligt.

Vi leder efter de rigtige.

Vi arbejder med socialfaglige opgaver, hvor relation, stabilitet og faglighed gør en reel forskel.

Vi ved, at det ikke er ligegyldigt, hvem der træder ind ad døren – hvad enten det er på et bosted, i en institution, på en specialskole eller i en familie, hvor der er brug for en ekstra voksen.

Derfor matcher vi ikke bare mennesker med ledige timer.

Vi matcher faglighed, erfaring og menneske med den konkrete opgave. Er du den fagperson

Hvem er du?
Du har erfaring fra det socialpædagogiske område og ved, hvad det vil sige at være en del af en hverdag, hvor mennesker har brug for tydelige, stabile og fagligt stærke voksne.

Din erfaring kan fx være fra:
  • bosteder eller botilbud
  • institutioner
  • specialskoler
  • børne- og ungehjem
  • støtteopgaver i hjemmet
  • arbejde med børn, unge eller voksne med særlige behov

Du behøver ikke have prøvet alt.

Men du skal have faglig erfaring, dømmekraft og lyst til at gøre en forskel i praksis. Er du den fagperson

Det lægger vi vægt på
Hos MerCare leder vi efter medarbejdere, der:
  • kan skabe ro – også når situationen bliver presset
  • kan balancere relation og struktur
  • arbejder fagligt og reflekteret
  • tager ansvar for det, de siger ja til
  • kan samarbejde og indgå i en eksisterende praksis
  • møder mennesker med respekt og ordentlighed
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og søge sparring, når det er nødvendigt

Du skal ikke være perfekt.
Men du skal være ansvarlig. Er du den fagperson

Hvilke opgaver kan du få?
Vi matcher altid opgaven med den medarbejder, der har de rette kompetencer og den relevante erfaring.

Det kan blandt andet være:
  • støtte på bosteder, botilbud og institutioner
  • støtte i skole- og specialtilbud
  • 1:1-støtte i hjemmet, skolen eller fritiden
  • ledsagelse
  • aflastning i hjemmet
  • støtte omkring struktur og trivsel i hverdagen
  • længerevarende individuelle støtteforløb

Nogle opgaver kræver bred socialpædagogisk erfaring. Andre kræver en mere specialiseret profil.

Det er netop derfor, vi matcher grundigt. Er du den fagperson

Hos MerCare bliver du valgt til opgaven
Når du bliver en del af MerCare, bliver du ikke bare oprettet i et system og sendt videre.

Vi lærer dig at kende og spørger ind til din erfaring, dine kompetencer og de opgaver, du fungerer bedst i.

Vi tager kun nye medarbejdere ind, når vi kan se et fagligt og menneskeligt match.

For kvalitet må aldrig være tilfældig. Er du den fagperson

Det får du hos os
  • opgaver, der matcher din erfaring og dine kompetencer
  • tæt dialog og opfølgning
  • mulighed for både fleksible opgaver og længerevarende forløb
  • et bureau med rødder i socialpædagogisk praksis
  • mulighed for faglig udvikling og undervisning
  • en organisation, der tager ansvar, også når noget bliver svært Er du den fagperson

Praktisk information
  • Arbejdet foregår primært på Sjælland
  • Opgaver kan ligge dag, aften, nat og weekend
  • Relevant erfaring fra det socialpædagogiske område er et krav
  • Straffe- og børneattest skal kunne godkendes
  • Relevante referencer indhentes inden opstart
  • Dokumentation for uddannelse og kvalifikationer skal foreligge Er du den fagperson

Lyder MerCare som et sted for dig?
Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i det, vi beskriver, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Hos os handler det ikke om at være den, der kan mest.

Det handler om at være den medarbejder, der passer til opgaven – og som vi trygt kan sende ud.

Vi matcher ikke bare opgaver.

Vi matcher mennesker. Er du den fagperson

MerCare
Skabt af praksis – båret af ansvar.

title: Økonomikonsulent til Entreprenør virksomhed
description:
Job-id:4049-4262

Ønsker du at udvikle dig som Økonomikonsulent indenfor revision - vil du arbejde for en entreprenør virksomhed, som er kunde hos revisionsselskabet. Det er en fordel at du har kendskab til igangværende arbejde. 

Centrum Personale søger en Økonomikonsulent med ca. 3-5 års erfaring fra bogholderi, for vores kunde beliggende i Storkøbenhavn.

Trives du med ansvar og en afvekslende hverdag og motiveres du af, at hjælpe SMV virksomheder med at skabe økonomisk overblik og håndtere bogføring, afstemning, e-indberetning, og lønadministration?

Du vi opnå en varieret arbejdsdag fyldt med spændende opgaver og fleksibilitet samt et team-orienteret arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde og fællesskab er i højsædet. Du vil blive en del af en arbejdsplads med stor grad af tværfaglighed og gode kollegaer. Du får også masser af plads til faglig og personlig udvikling, og der vil være fokus på at sikre trivsel, og du vil blive klædt godt på til opgaverne via interne og eksterne kurser.

Dagligdagen som konsulent

Nogle dage sidder du ude hos kunden og arbejder – andre dage klarer du opgaverne hjemmefra eller fra kontoret. Du varetager sammen med dit team en andel af en kundeportefølje, som du sammen med teamet tilrettelægger arbejdet for. Det kan være en fordel, hvis du har kørekort og egen bil, men det er ikke et krav.

Opgaver indenfor bogholderi, herunder:

  • Bogføring og afstemninger i E-conomic & BC365

  • Periodebalancer og rapportering

  • Moms og afgifter m.v.

  • Klargøring af materiale til revisor

  • Indberetninger til det offentlige

  • Lønadministration i Danløn

  • Regnskabsmæssige ad hoc-opgaver

  • Løbende Bogføring og afstemning af balancen

  • Special områder du med fordel kender: Igangværende arbejde

Teamet
Du vil blive en del af et team på 25 regnskabskonsulenter, der glæder sig til at byde dig velkommen som kollega.

Sammen løser regnskabs-teamet opgaver inden for bogholderi og lønadministration hos virksomheder i alle størrelser, typer og brancher. Du skal derfor kunne lide at have kontakt med mange forskellige mennesker.

Ude hos kunderne er vi en del af hverdagen i deres virksomhed, men samtidig værnes om fællesskabet og samarbejdet i vores eget team. Man bruger hver dag hinanden til sparring – også, når man ikke fysisk er på samme kontor.

Det er vigtigt, at du får en tæt tilknytning til hjemmebasen på kontoret. Det er her man koordinerer arbejdet og har det rart sammen med kollegaerne.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte Chefkonsulent, Anette Thaulow via mail: at@centrum-personale.dk eller telefon: 33244080

title: Operations & Growth Manager
employer: BTR Personnel services AB, filial af BTR Personnel services AB, Sverige
description:
We are looking for an Operations & Growth Manager to join our team and play an important role in the next stage of our growth. We are looking for someone who wants to understand how a growing consumer brand works from the inside and become involved across multiple areas of the business—from operations and retail to marketing, business development, data, systems, and growth.


The Role

As Operations & Growth Manager, you will help manage the day-to-day execution of the business while also working on projects that contribute directly to the company’s growth.

Your responsibilities will span five main areas:

·       Operations & Execution — approximately 30%

·       New Business Development — approximately 20%

·       Marketing & Brand Growth — approximately 20%

·       Business Intelligence & Analysis — approximately 20%

·       Processes, Systems & Automation — approximately 10%

The exact balance may evolve as the company grows. This is a role for someone who is comfortable switching between execution and strategy.

What You'll Work On:

Operations & Retail Execution

You will help make sure the operational side runs accurately and efficiently.

This may include:

·       Managing and tracking purchase orders.

·       Monitoring inventory levels and availability.

·       Coordinating retailer orders.

·       Communicating with warehouses and logistics partners.

·       Following shipments and resolving delivery issues.

·       Managing Amazon inventory and operational requirements.

·       Supporting retailer compliance.

·       Coordinating invoices and documentation.

·       Communicating with customers, suppliers, retailers, warehouses, and external partners.

·       Identifying potential inventory shortages before they become problems.

·       Making sure deadlines and retailer requirements are met.

·       Improving operational accuracy.

·       Helping reduce preventable errors.

·       Creating better visibility into what is happening across the business.

 

Business Development & Retail Growth

You will also help identify and develop new commercial opportunities.

This may include:

·       Researching prospective retailers.

·       Identifying distributors and brokers.

·       Finding potential strategic partners.

·       Building lists of prospective accounts.

·       Conducting initial outreach.

·       Following up with prospective customers.

·       Preparing presentations and sales materials.

·       Coordinating product samples.

·       Preparing pricing and product information.

·        Supporting negotiations.

·       Helping onboard new accounts.

·       Researching new retail channels.

·       Identifying geographic expansion opportunities.

·       Helping grow relationships with existing accounts.

 

Marketing & Brand Growth

You will participate in initiatives designed to increase awareness, trial, engagement, and repeat purchase.

Projects may include:

·       Influencer partnerships.

·       Creator collaborations.

·       Social media initiatives.

·       Retail marketing programs.

·       Product sampling.

·       In-store activations.

·       Tastings.

·       Amazon marketing.

·       Brand partnerships.

·       Promotional campaigns.

·       LinkedIn and social content planning.

·       Retailer-specific marketing programs.

·       Coordinating marketing assets.

·       Tracking campaign results.

·       Identifying new ways to introduce consumers.

 

Business Intelligence & Analytics

As we grow, data will become increasingly important to how we make decisions. You will help organize information and transform it into useful insights.

This may include:

·       Building dashboards.

·       Tracking sales performance.

·       Analyzing inventory.

·       Reviewing Amazon performance.

·       Monitoring retail sell-through.

·       Comparing retailer performance.

·       Tracking marketing results.

·       Identifying patterns and trends.

·       Detecting potential risks.

·       Finding opportunities hidden in the data.

·       Preparing reports for company leadership.

·       Turning information into actionable recommendations.


Systems, Processes & Automation

We are building for the next stage of growth. That means improving not only what we do, but how we do it. You will help us create systems that make the business easier to operate and scale.

Projects may include:

·       Creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

·       Documenting recurring processes.

·       Building internal templates.

·       Improving information organization.

·       Identifying repetitive manual work.

·       Finding opportunities for automation.

·       Implementing AI tools where useful.

·       Creating dashboards and internal tools.

·       Developing processes that can eventually be delegated.

·       Helping create more scalable operating systems.

 

Preferred Background

·       A strong candidate may have experience or education in areas such as:

·       Business Administration

·       International Business

·       Operations

·       Supply Chain

·       Marketing

·       Business Development

·       Retail

·       Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG)

·       E-commerce

·       Entrepreneurship

·       Analytics

 

Experience working with food, retail, Amazon, consumer products, logistics, distributors, brokers, or growing companies is a plus. Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills are highly valuable. Experience with tools such as Amazon Seller Central, Notion, Canva, CRM platforms, dashboards, AI tools, or automation platforms is also a plus.

English is required. Spanish is highly valuable.

title: Køkkenfaglig medarbejder søges til unik opstartsopgave på Granmosevej
description:
Vil du kombinere din køkkenfaglighed med arbejdet med borgerinddragelse – og være med til at bygge et nyt tilbud op fra bunden?

På Granmosevej i Kjellerup åbnede vi den 1. september 2026 et nyt og moderne bo- og dagtilbud. Tilbuddet omfatter 24 lejligheder efter servicelovens §§ 107 og 108 samt et aktivitets- og samværstilbud efter § 104, som etableres gradvist fra september 2026 og frem mod 2027.

 
Om Granmosevej

Målgruppen på Granmosevej er voksne borgere med udviklingshæmning med mange og/eller væsentlige funktionsnedsættelser. Dagtilbuddet tilbyder både beskyttet beskæftigelse samt samværs- og aktivitetstilbud.

Tilbuddet ligger i grønne og åbne omgivelser, hvor vi skaber rammerne for en tryg, udviklende og meningsfuld hverdag for voksne med fysiske og/eller psykiske funktionsnedsættelser.

I Socialafdelingen i Silkeborg Kommune arbejder vi efter visionen: ”Sammen om et selvstændigt og meningsfuldt hverdagsliv.” På Granmosevej får du mulighed for at omsætte visionen til praksis i et helt nyt tilbud, som vi udvikler sammen – helt fra bunden.

 

En stilling med både køkkenfaglighed og borgerinddragelse

I opstartsfasen vil stillingen være delt mellem produktionskøkkenet og aktivitetskøkkenet. Omtrent halvdelen af arbejdstiden vil være knyttet til produktion af måltider og den daglige drift af køkkenet. Den resterende tid vil være i aktivitetskøkkenet, hvor du sammen med borgerne skaber fællesskab, deltagelse og læring.

Du bliver en del af et køkkenfagligt samarbejde, hvor der allerede er ansat en køkkenfaglig medarbejder. I kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen om den daglige drift, udviklingen af køkkenfunktionen og de gode måltidsoplevelser.

Samtidig bliver du en del af det samlede arbejdsfællesskab på bo- og dagtilbuddet, hvor du kommer til at samarbejde tæt med pædagogiske, sundhedsfaglige og øvrige kollegaer.

Vi lægger vægt på, at borgerne får mulighed for at være aktive deltagere i køkkenets aktiviteter. Du skal derfor have lyst til at støtte og motivere borgerne i madlavning og praktiske køkkenopgaver på en tryg, meningsfuld og udviklende måde.

Du bliver en vigtig del af arbejdet med at skabe gode måltidsoplevelser og samtidig understøtte borgernes ressourcer, selvstændighed og mulighed for deltagelse.

I takt med at dagtilbuddet udvides, og flere borgere bliver en del af tilbuddet, vil behovet for produktion i køkkenet stige. På sigt forventes stillingen derfor at blive primært tilknyttet produktionskøkkenet.

Du får dermed en særlig mulighed for både at være med til at opbygge køkkenfunktionen og skabe gode rammer for, at borgere kan deltage aktivt i køkkenrelaterede aktiviteter.

 

Hvem er du?

Vi søger en køkkenfaglig medarbejder, der har lyst til at være med til at opbygge og udvikle køkkenfunktionen på Granmosevej. Du er fagligt engageret, trives med ansvar og kan se værdien i at skabe gode måltider og meningsfulde fællesskaber sammen med borgerne.

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund kan for eksempel være:

  • Ernæringsassistent
  • Ernæringshjælper
  • Køkkenassistent
  • Køkkenmedhjælper
  • Kok med interesse for social- og pædagogisk arbejde
  • Pædagog eller pædagogisk assistent med stærke køkkenfaglige kompetencer

Det vigtigste er, at du har mod på at starte noget nyt, er fagligt stolt, samarbejdsorienteret og har lyst til at arbejde både køkkenfagligt og med borgerinddragelse.

Du skal være med til at skabe en bæredygtig og velsmagende madkultur, følge kommunens kostfaglige retningslinjer og bidrage til et inkluderende miljø, hvor hverdagen er præget af struktur, kvalitet og gode relationer.

 

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være
  • at producere sund, varieret og appetitvækkende mad til borgere og medarbejdere
  • at planlægge og klargøre måltider i en ny og moderne køkkendrift
  • at være med til at opbygge gode rutiner og arbejdsgange i køkkenet
  • at inddrage borgere i madlavning og praktiske køkkenopgaver ud fra deres ønsker, ressourcer og muligheder
  • at motivere og støtte borgerne i deres deltagelse
  • at samarbejde tæt med køkkenfaglige, pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige kollegaer
  • at sikre dokumentation og følge gældende retningslinjer
  • at arbejde med økologi, bæredygtighed og gode måltidsoplevelser
  • at bidrage til udviklingen af køkkenfunktionen i takt med, at tilbuddet vokser

 

Vi forventer, at du
  • er god til at lave mad og har faglig stolthed
  • kan skabe overblik og struktur – også når alt ikke er på plads endnu
  • har blik for borgernes ressourcer og ønsker at skabe mulighed for udvikling, medbestemmelse og deltagelse
  • kan motivere, vejlede og samarbejde med både borgere og kollegaer
  • kan dokumentere og evaluere dit arbejde
  • har flair for IT
  • har interesse for økologi og bæredygtighed
  • er fleksibel og trives i en opstartskultur, hvor ting kan udvikle sig undervejs
  • bidrager med humor, god energi og et positivt menneskesyn

 

Vi kan tilbyde
  • en unik mulighed for at være med fra starten og forme køkkenfunktion, kultur, hverdag og rammer
  • et trygt, varmt og udviklende arbejdsfællesskab, som du selv er med til at skabe
  • et tæt køkkenfagligt samarbejde med en allerede ansat køkkenfaglig medarbejder
  • gode kollegaer på tværs af fagligheder

title: Studentermedhjælper til grønne events, kommunikation og koordinering
description:
Kan du lide at få ting til at ske, koordinere events og samarbejde med mange forskellige mennesker? Har du samtidig blik for detaljerne og lyst til at arbejde med den grønne omstilling helt tæt på borgere, kultur- og erhvervsliv? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Klima- og Bæredygtighedsteamet søger en studentermedhjælper ca. 15 timer om ugen. Vi er fire fuldtidsansatte og to studentermedhjælpere, som arbejder bredt med den grønne omstilling på Frederiksberg. Vores opgaver spænder fra udvikling af strategier og politikker til kommunikation, events og aktiviteter sammen med borgere og lokale aktører.

Du bliver en del af et lille team med tæt samarbejde og får mulighed for både at tage ansvar for dine egne opgaver og arbejde sammen med kolleger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Dine opgaver

En stor del af dit arbejde bliver knyttet til planlægning og afvikling af Grønne Dage, Frederiksbergs grønne festival, som i 2027 finder sted fra den 13. til 19. september. Her vil du sammen med en kollega være med til at koordinere festivalen og de mange arrangementer, der skabes i samarbejde med lokale aktører.

Du får blandt andet en vigtig rolle i kontakten til aktørerne og i at sikre, at deres arrangementer kommer godt hele vejen fra idé til færdigt arrangementsopslag. Det betyder, at du skal indsamle og kvalitetssikre information, afklare spørgsmål med aktørerne og sørge for, at arrangementerne bliver oprettet korrekt på vores platforme og løbende opdateret på hjemmesiden.

Der kan være mange arrangementer i proces på samme tid og en del detaljer, der skal falde på plads. Derfor er jobbet også for dig, der kan lide at skabe system i mange informationer, opdager når noget mangler og har tålmodighed til at følge op og få ting helt i mål.

Du kommer også til at:

  • koordinere aktiviteter og arrangementer med lokale aktører og frivillige grønne ildsjæle på Frederiksberg
  • løse kommunikationsopgaver, fx skrive tekster til sociale medier og web samt opdatere vores hjemmeside
  • hjælpe med forskellige praktiske og administrative opgaver i forbindelse med teamets projekter og arrangementer
  • bidrage til andre indsatser under Klimaplan 2025, særligt arbejdet med at engagere borgere, foreninger, uddannelsesinstitutioner, kulturaktører og erhvervsliv i den grønne omstilling.

Arbejdet foregår som udgangspunkt i almindelig arbejdstid, men i forbindelse med arrangementer vil der indimellem være arbejde om aftenen eller i weekenden. 

Hvem er du?

Vi forventer ikke, at du kan det hele fra starten. Til gengæld leder vi efter dig, der er nysgerrig, tager ansvar og har lyst til at lære.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • er i gang med en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for fx miljø, klima, samfundsvidenskab eller kommunikation og har minimum 1,5 år tilbage af dit studie
  • er detaljeorienteret og trives med opgaver, hvor der er mange informationer, aftaler og deadlines at holde styr på
  • arbejder struktureret og følger dine opgaver til dørs, også når det kræver et par ekstra afklaringer
  • er imødekommende og har let ved at kommunikere med mange forskellige mennesker
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage initiativ og samtidig spørge om hjælp, når der er brug for det
  • interesserer dig for klima og den grønne omstilling
  • er god til at formulere dig på skrift og kan tilpasse kommunikationen til forskellige målgrupper
  • gerne har et godt visuelt blik og lyst til at arbejde med indhold til sociale medier og web.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos os får du:

  • mulighed for at arbejde konkret med den grønne omstilling i en ambitiøs klimakommune
  • et studiejob med ansvar og mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på opgaverne
  • erfaring med eventkoordinering, kommunikation, borgerinddragelse og samarbejde med lokale aktører
  • en bred kontaktflade til både kolleger på tværs af kommunen og foreninger, kulturaktører, virksomheder og andre samarbejdspartnere på Frederiksberg
  • et lille team med høj faglighed, godt samarbejde og plads til nysgerrighed og nye idéer
  • fleksible arbejdstider, hvor du i høj grad kan tilrettelægge dine timer i forhold til dit studie

Ansøgningsfrist

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, kan du kontakte Klimakonsulent Siri Astrup på 28984077. Du kan læse mere om Frederiksberg Kommune på vores hjemmeside www.frederiksberg.dk 

Vi ser frem til at modtage en kort ansøgning og CV senest den 17. november. 

Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler d. 26 eller 27 november med henblik på opstart i midt januar. 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! 

Frederiksberg er en levende by med et dynamisk bysamfund. Byens sjæl bygger på vores historie og klassiske arv og er med til at præge den spændende udvikling af Frederiksberg som en grøn, sund og pulserende del af Hovedstaden.
Vi er en moderne kommune, der betjener 104.305 borgere. Frederiksberg Kommune ønsker at fremme ligestillingen og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, handicap, race, hudfarve, religion eller tro, politisk anskuelse, seksuel orientering, kønsidentitet, kønsudtryk eller kønskarakteristika eller national, social eller etnisk oprindelse.

title: PhD position at the Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA)
description:
The Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA) at The Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark, is seeking a talented and highly motivated PhD student to work on the development of new theoretical frameworks for describing light–matter interactions in advanced van der Walls heterostructures probed by polaritons generated through inelastic tunneling. The position is funded by a Villum Young Investigator grant awarded to Assistant Professor P. André D. Gonçalves, who will supervise the PhD research.

The position is available starting 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The successful candidate will develop new theoretical frameworks and computational methods to investigate the fundamental limits of polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling in tunnel junctions based on van der Waals heterostructures composed of atomically thin materials. The project will employ a broad range of analytical, semi-analytical, and numerical techniques to explore electrically driven polaritonic phenomena. A major focus will be on harnessing polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling as a tool to probe and manipulate light–matter interactions at the nanoscale, as well as to characterize the optoelectronic response of complex quantum materials.

We welcome candidates with a strong background in condensed-matter physics and/or quantum nanophotonics who are highly motivated and eager to pursue world-class research in theoretical quantum nano-optoelectronics. Experience with scientific programming is expected, while familiarity with numerical techniques is advantageous but not required. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about contributing to cutting-edge research in a dynamic and ambitious young research group, supported by the POLIMA Center and its extensive network of international collaborators.

POLIMA is a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation (DNRF) for an initial period of 6 years (2023–2028), with the possibility of a 4-year extension. The center is led by Professor N. Asger Mortensen and currently consists of two Professors, three Assistant Professors, a Lab Manager, a Center Administrator, and approximately 10–15 PhD students, postdocs, and visiting scientists. Several POLIMA researchers have attracted prestigious personal grants, e.g., Villum Investigator, Villum Young Investigator, DFF Sapere Aude, Novo Nordisk’s Foundation RECRUIT and Data Science Investigator – Emerging, and Maria Skłodowska-Curie Fellowships. Read more on POLIMA’s website.

We offer a competitive and highly collaborative research environment with close interaction between experimental and theoretical activities. You will join a thriving community of researchers and benefit from a strong network of international collaborators. Our work environment is supportive, dynamic, and designed to foster creativity and the development of innovative projects.

 

We offer:

• A PhD student position in an ambitious and supportive, international research environment.

• A dedicated supervisor research team to support the academic development of the PhD student.

• Access to state-of-the-art equipment, facilities, and infrastructure.

• A competitive salary and social benefits (e.g., health coverage, parental leave, social security, etc.) (https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/international-staff/getting-settled)

POLIMA is located at the University of Southern Denmark in Odense – 1h15min by train from Copenhagen Airport. The University of Southern Denmark offers dedicated assistance and support with various practical, social, and legal aspects (housing, visa, administration, tax, etc.), especially for international candidates through our international staff office (ISO) and the administrative staff at POLIMA.

 

For further information and details about the position, application, and the research center, please contact Assistant Professor Paulo André Dias Gonçalves (padgo@mci.sdu.dk).

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (copy of original and an official English translation).  

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is 31 December, 2026, at 11:59 PM / 23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process. 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is 1 March 2026 (may be adjusted by mutual agreement) or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Kirketjener til Stengård Kirke
description:
Er du typen, der ser, hvad der skal gøres – og får det gjort?
Stengård Kirke søger en engageret kirketjener med tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Vi er en levende og aktiv kirke med mange gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger, arrangementer og aktiviteter. Som kirketjener får du en alsidig arbejdsdag med selvstændige opgaver og tæt samarbejde med kirkens øvrige medarbejdere, herunder en anden kirketjener, en kordegn og en daglig leder.

Vi søger dig, som
  • er imødekommende og serviceminded over for kirkens brugere og gæster
  • tager ansvar og arbejder selvstændigt – ser, hvad der skal gøres, tager initiativ og får tingene gjort, samtidig med at du arbejder inden for aftalte rammer og beslutninger
  • kan prioritere og strukturere opgaver og bevare overblikket
  • er en god samarbejdspartner, der lytter, kommunikerer åbent og bidrager konstruktivt
  • er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider, herunder aftener, weekender og helligdage.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra et serviceorienteret arbejde og har håndværksmæssig erfaring. Erfaring som kirketjener er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du er ansvarsbevidst, praktisk anlagt og har lyst til at få tingene til at fungere. Kørekort og adgang til bil er en fordel.

Dine opgaver
  • kirketjeneste ved gudstjenester og kirkelige handlinger
  • praktisk forberedelse og oprydning ved gudstjenester og arrangementer
  • rengøring og vedligeholdelse af kirke og tilknyttede bygninger
  • servicering ved arrangementer og møder
  • praktiske og mindre håndværksmæssige opgaver samt pasning af udendørsarealer, herunder havearbejde
  • kontakt med brugere af kirkens lokaler og håndværkere
  • indkøb af dagligvarer og forbrugsvarer.

Vi tilbyder
  • et meningsfuldt og alsidigt arbejde
  • selvstændige opgaver og mulighed for at bruge dine praktiske evner og dit initiativ
  • engagerede kolleger, en arbejdsplads med plads til forskellighed og et godt samarbejdsmiljø
  • fleksible arbejdstider inden for en tjenesteplan, der tilrettelægges efter kirkens aktiviteter.

Om stillingen
Stillingen er på fuld tid med tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Ansættelsen er omfattet af gældende overenskomst og organisationsaftale for kirketjenere. Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kirketjenere har ret til at fortsætte som tjenestemænd.

Lønnen aftales mellem menighedsrådet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening inden for intervallet 324.667 - 408.841 kr. årligt, afhængig af kompetencer og erfaring. Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen, og rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 33.231 kr. årligt. Herudover er der et OK18 tillæg på 1.401 kr. årligt. Alle ovennævnte beløb er i niveau pr. 1. august 2026 ved fuldtidsbeskæftigelse (37 timer ugentligt). Herudover er der et pensionsbidrag på 15%.

Der er 3 måneders prøvetid, og der indhentes børneattest. Har du ikke gennemført den obligatoriske 5-ugers kirketjeneruddannelse, skal den gennemføres inden for 2 år efter ansættelsens start.

Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen fås ved henvendelse til daglig leder, Lars Grindsted, tlf. 3011 6141 eller e-mail lagri@km.dk.

Kan du se dig selv i jobbet? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.
Læs mere om Stengård Sogn og Kirke på www.stengaardkirke.dk.

Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes til Stengård Sogns Menighedsråd, mrk. Kirketjener, på 7133fortrolig@sogn.dk senest 30. oktober 2026. Vi holder ansættelsessamtaler løbende efter fristen.

title: Senior Support Specialist, Telecom, Location: Danmark - Esbjerg
description:
Are you technically curious, service-minded, and motivated by helping customers resolve critical technical issues? Do you enjoy combining troubleshooting with coordination and clear communication? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. 

Your position 

As our new Senior Support Specialist, Telecom, you will support the daily operation of our customers communication Systems. You will take ownership of incoming requests, gather the necessary technical information, assess urgency and operational impact, and perform structured troubleshooting. When specialist assistance is required, you will coordinate the correct escalation and ensure that customers remain informed throughout the process.

You are not expected to be the specialist for every system. Your role is to establish a clear overview, perform the agreed initial checks, document findings and decisions, and ensure that each case is resolved.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg in a full-time position. You must be willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation according to an agreed schedule.

Your tasks & responsibilities 
Your work will include receiving customer calls and service requests, monitoring tickets and alarms, carrying out remote troubleshooting, and coordinating technical responses. You will maintain technical records, contribute to service reporting and preventive-maintenance activities, and help improve service procedures and documentation.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Manage service tickets from initial request through resolution.
  • Perform troubleshooting and monitor systems through Zabbix or comparable platforms
  • Keep customers informed and ensure that technical findings, communication, and agreed actions are documented accurately


Your profile & qualifications
 
You are service-minded, technically curious, and comfortable taking responsibility. You approach technical issues systematically and communicate clearly with customers and colleagues. You do not need to be a specialist in every system, but you are motivated to investigate issues, perform structured trouble shooting, and coordinate the right technical support.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you:

  • Have a technical background within telecom, networking or related field
  • Have practical experience with technical troubleshooting and fault handling
  • Strong Microsoft Office software knowledge
  • Are comfortable using ticketing systems and documenting technical findings, customer communication, and agreed actions
  • Communicate clearly in written and spoken English
  • Are willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation

Experience with telecom systems such as PABX, TETRA, VHF, AIS, CCTV, PAGA, LTE or Network infrastructure would also be beneficial. General knowledge with, Window, Linux, Proxmox, Zabbix, TOPdesk, or comparable systems, but your technical curiosity and willingness to learn are equally important.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.
