title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join Biomason’s production facility in Ikast.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is motivated by solving real technical challenges, improving operational and equipment reliability, and helping scale a first-of-a-kind process toward commercial production.

Do you have solid experience from an industrial or manufacturing environment, and do you thrive in a setting where not everything has been fully built or established yet? Then we would very much like to hear from you.

Read more about the role in the below job description.

If you have technical questions, you are welcome to contact Director of Plant Performance Aaron Bellis at +45 28966291 or HR Partner René Bitsch at +45 21756113.

If you are from a recruitment agency please note that we will contact you if we need your assistance.

Job description

The position:

As Mechanical engineer, you will play a hands-on role in establishing, stabilizing, and improving the mechanical performance of our first-of-a-kind tile production facility in Ikast. This role will work closely together with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, and Process Engineering to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient plant performance. You will help translate innovative process science into robust day-to-day manufacturing at the first of a kind facility, while driving structured problem-solving, equipment reliability, ppm, plant expansion support, and continuous improvement across the facility.

You will support the scaling of this process to our first commercial facility from engineering design and equipment selection through commissioning, start-up, and operations working together with our project department and our EPC firms.

Responsibilities also include:

  • Mechanical Operations & Equipment Reliability

    • Provide day-to-day supervisory and execution support for electrical and mechanical systems and production equipment across the tile manufacturing process.

    • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for mechanical failures, downtime events, and recurring equipment issues.

    • Help establish preventive and predictive maintenance routines for critical equipment, utilities, and production assets.

    • Support commissioning, start-up, and scale-up activities in a FOAK environment, helping to translate development work into reliable plant operation.

  • Production Support & Continuous Improvement

    • Partner with Operations and Quality teams to improve equipment performance, uptime, process stability, and product consistency.

    • Contribute to waste reduction, line efficiency, and standardization efforts as production scales.

  •   Technical leadership

    • Support the development of SOPs, technical work instructions, equipment care standards, and troubleshooting guides.

  • Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and internal teams on equipment modifications, installation work, and performance improvements.

  • Project engineering and commercial facility scale-up

    • With the Director of projects and an EPC firm, act as Biomason’s lead mechanical engineer supporting the development of FEL3 and detailed engineering design packages including participation in and review of Block Flow Diagrams (BFDs), Heat and Material Balances (HMBs), Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), General Arrangements (GAs), Basis of Design (BoD) documents, equipment specification and selection, and HAZOP (Hazard an Operations study).

    • Support the commissioning and startup of the commercial facility through:

      • Participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) at vendor sites as needed and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) at the facility.

      • Provide on-site technical leadership during the "boots-on-the-ground" commissioning phase, troubleshooting mechanical, thermal, or other deviations in real-time.

      • Bridge the gap between EPC firms and internal operations to ensure a seamless handover.

What we are looking for:

  • Experience

    • Minimum 5 years of experience in mechanical engineering, maintenance engineering, or a similar industrial role.

    • Strong experience in industrial process or manufacturing environments, ideally with automated or semi-automated production equipment. Concrete manufacturing or other heavy industry is bonus but not essential.

    • Experience with motors, heat exchangers, airflow and hydraulics is a strong advantage.

    • Basic electrical experience testing logout tag out.

    • Experience supporting production start-ups, greenfield projects, FOAK environments, or first-time industrial implementation is strongly preferred.

  • Technical Expertise

    • Experience working with crane and conveyance systems is a critical requirement of this position

    • Strong understanding of industrial mechanical systems, equipment reliability, maintenance strategies, and structured troubleshooting.

    • Experience with 5S, good manufacturing practices, and continuous improvement in a production setting.

    • Ability to read technical drawings, manuals, equipment layouts, P&IDs, and supplier documentation.

    • Familiarity with Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing principles, root cause analysis methodologies, and continuous improvement practices is an advantage.

  • Management & Interpersonal Skills

    • High attention to detail, with the ability to manage complex, detail-oriented projects and ensure disciplined follow-up through execution.

    • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work across functions and cultures, preferable experience from a matrix organization..

    • Structured, practical, and data-informed approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

    • Contractor control

    • Fluency in English is essential

On a personal level, the role needs the following approach:

  • Proactive with a practical approach and the ability to be hands-on 

  • Motivation to solve real industrial challenges

  • Flexible where systems and routines are still being built

  • A collaborative mindset, but also the ability to solve matters on your own

  • Good safety attitude

  • Can do attitude

title: Specialist/Consultant in Neurology looking for job opportunities in Denmark
description:
Newly Created Position at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital for an Emergency Neurology Profile in Partnership with Rigshospitalet, The University Hospital of Copenhagen.

We are expanding our team of specialists at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital, Denmark as we develop a new emergency neurology profile. You will have a direct professional influence on our future emergency services and become part of a new, close partnership with Rigshospitalet.

Why choose us?

Help shape the emergency services of the future: You will play a central role in developing and launching our upcoming emergency neurology profile (without a thrombolysis service).
New partnership with Rigshospitalet: The collaboration will open opportunities for professional exchange, knowledge sharing and research. For those interested, there will also be opportunities for attractive split appointments (e.g. one day per week at Rigshospitalet).
New professional opportunities from 1 January 2027: As a result of the healthcare reform in Denmark, we will take over specialised rehabilitation from the municipalities, creating exciting opportunities for professional development.
Scope for your subspecialty: Whether your interests lie in MS, movement disorders, headache, dementia, epilepsy or rehabilitation, we will adapt the framework to allow you to pursue your area of expertise.
A strong research environment: We focus on patients with multimorbidity and have our own Professor of Neurology. Research is primarily focused on multiple sclerosis.
Your profile

You are a specialist/consultant in neurology, whether you are newly qualified and eager to develop your skills or an experienced colleague looking for a new professional setting.

We imagine that you:

Are passionate about multidisciplinary collaboration and want to help shape the quality of the new emergency setup.
Value a strong professional network across hospitals.
Appreciate the opportunity to provide clinical guidance and supervision to our junior doctors.
Are decisive, flexible and actively contribute to our positive working environment and pioneering spirit.

Your working day and responsibilities

Our department provides primary-level neurological services in the hospital at Slagelse (inpatient ward for phase II rehabilitation, primarily for apoplexy cases, as well as specialist clinics), and in the hospital of Naestved, where we run the Centre for Neurorehabilitation (CNN), which provides services at regional level.

Your responsibilities will include:

Working in our outpatient department, specialist clinics or the interdisciplinary Memory Clinic, in collaboration with geriatricians, psychiatrists and neuropsychologists.
Supervising junior doctors and participating in the multidisciplinary environment across our hospital sites.
On-call duties: Our consultants currently cover the senior on-call function on site until 9.00 pm, followed by an on-call-from-home arrangement (there is junior on-call doctor is present on site around the clock).
About the department

Neurology is part of a combined department (Medicine 3 and Department of Physio- and Occupational Therapy) that works closely and efficiently alongside the Department of Geriatrics. We place a strong emphasis on professional dialogue and peer support within a group of doctors characterised by strong collegial relationships and a shared desire to develop the specialty.

Mid- and West Zealand Hospital is located around 60 min. by car from central Copenhagen.

Practical information and application

The seven medical roles: Your application should address the seven medical competencies specifically, supported by the best possible documentation.
Interests: If you have specific wishes regarding subspecialisation or are interested in a split appointment with Rigshospitalet, we would be pleased if you mention this in your application.

Relocation Assistance and Danish Language Tutoring

When you relocate to Denmark in connection with your employment, we offer free, professional assistance with relocation and settling in, either close to the hospital or anywhere on Zealand you might prefer. You will receive help with everything from finding accommodation to registration and arrangements for any accompanying family members.

An important part of working as a doctor in Denmark is communication between you and your patients and colleagues. For patient safety reasons, Region Zealand therefore requires our doctors to have a satisfactory level of Danish language proficiency. We therefore provide a language teacher for one-to-one tuition, enabling you to communicate with your patients as quickly as possible at a level where you can understand one another.

This means, that we expect you to be prepared to devote time to learning Danish, both spoken and written as part of your employment.

Find out more about what kind of assistance we offer, as well as watch interviews with other doctors that have relocated to Region Zealand at www.medicaljobsdenmark.com.

Would you like to know more?

You are very welcome to contact Chief Physician Benedikte Wanscher on mobile +45 93 57 62 51 or by email at bewa@regionsjaelland.dk for an informal and confidential conversation about the position.

Please upload your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

title: Postdoc positions within Robotics for Laboratory Automation
description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within the project CAPeX which focuses on robotics for laboratory automation. We therefore invite applications for one or more fully funded postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

  • An opportunity to collaborate with excellent researchers within the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery

 

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to CAPeX; specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automation of laboratory experiments that require manipulation of tubes, fragile glass vials, and liquids. The robotic solution should be flexible in the sense that it should be able to conduct several experiments with little user-intervention, operate alongside humans, and recover from failures. Consequently, visual feedback must be used for adapting robot behavior to a dynamic environment.  The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in laboratories in both SDU and DTU. The successful candidate will work closely with other PhDs and postdoc candidates in CAPeX.

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching responsibilities could also be part of the employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

  • Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics and CAPeX.

  • Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

  • Supporting the team in securing external funding.

  • Contributing to the project CAPeX deliverables. 

 

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to robotic systems controlled using visual feedback. The candidate is hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Expert knowledge in the control of robots

  • Experience in simulation of robotic systems

  • Experience in design and development of robotic systems

  • Experience with using computer vision.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Conduct independent research. 

 

Research environment

The candidate will be integrated into the SDU Robotics unit, which is a team of approx. 60 employees. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. The group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners.

We are a team specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, estimation, and control of advanced robot systems. In addition, the candidate will be integrated into CAPeX - a pioneer center for accelerating P2X materials discovery and working on automation of laboratory experiments.

CAPeX is a 13-year and 300 MDKK “Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery”, funded by Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science, the Danish National Research Foundation, the Carlsberg Foundation, the Lundbeck Foundation, the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and the Villum Foundation. CAPeX is hosted by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and co-hosted by Aalborg University (AAU), and unites leading experts from DTU, AAU, University of Copenhagen, Aarhus University, and the University of Southern Denmark with international partners from Stanford University, Utrecht University, and the University of Toronto to form a truly Pioneering Center on P2X. You can read more about the CAPeX research themes and X-trails, our organization, and the other open PhD and postdoc cohort positions at http://www.capex-p2x.com. 

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your academic growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Professor Christoffer Sloth chsl@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

The application deadline is October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

The application may also include: 

  • Research statement. 

  • Summary of experience in teaching. 

  • References (names and emails) and/or reference letters.

  • Documentation of other qualifications with relevance for the position. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

title: Restaurationsmanager
description:
Restaurationsmanager

Dit Smørrebrød i Skagen er en travl virksomhed i rivende udvikling. 
Vores kendetegn er traditionelt dansk smørrebrød til Skawboer og turister – uden dikkedarer.
Godt gammeldags smørrebrød, klassiske frokost retter samt “Mormor mad” på aftenmenuen, hvor det er lavet fra bunden med friske råvarer – og ”salt, peber og kærlighed”, råvarer af bedste kvalitet samt vores kvalitet og service er ALTID i top.

Vores restaurant emmer af afslappet stemning og maden indtages i hyggelig gammel dansk atmosfære med rød og hvidternede duge. Skagens hyggeligste frokost og aftens restaurant. 

Vi har stor ansvarsfølelse for vores ansatte - vi værdsætter gensidig tillid. Vi løser vores opgaver i fællesskab ved at serverer godt gedigent mad i en afslappet atmosfære, som er fyldt med grin og glæde for så vel ansatte som for vores gæster.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver
Som restaurantansvarlig får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du blandt andet skal:

•    Lede og koordinere restaurantteamet under vagterne
•    Fordele arbejdsopgaver og administrere personalets pauser
•    Sikre en effektiv og velfungerende service
•    Tage godt imod gæsterne og hjælpe til, hvor der er behov
•    Overvåge servicekvaliteten og sikre høj kundetilfredshed
•    Håndtere gæstespørgsmål og eventuelle reklamationer professionelt
•    Koordinere samarbejdet mellem køkken og serveringspersonale
•    Åbne og/eller lukke restauranten samt foretage kasseafstemning
•    Sikre, at restauranten altid fremstår ren, organiseret og klar til service
•    Medvirke til oplæring af nye medarbejdere
•    Løse udfordringer løbende under vagten
•    Stå for varebestilling og lagerstyring

Vi forestiller os, at du

•    Har erfaring fra restaurant- eller servicebranchen
•    Trives med ansvar og kan bevare overblikket i travle perioder
•    Er serviceminded, imødekommende og løsningsorienteret
•    Kan motivere og skabe et godt samarbejde blandt kollegaerne
•    Har fokus på kvalitet og gæsteoplevelser

Vi tilbyder

•    Helårsansættelse
•    Mulighed for bolig
•    Et uhøjtideligt arbejdsmiljø med plads til humor
•    Afslappet omgangstone og godt humør i hverdagen
•    Nogle af de gladeste gæster, fordi vi laver god mad
•    Gode kollegaer, hvor vi løfter i fællesskab
•    En hektisk, spændende og sjov højsæson
•    Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer

Arbejdstid i tidsrummet mellem kl. 10.00 og 21.00, på alle ugens dage

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig

---------------------------------------------------------------

Restaurant Manager

Dit Smørrebrød in Skagen is a busy restaurant experiencing strong growth.
We are known for serving traditional Danish open sandwiches (smørrebrød) to both local residents and tourists. We pride ourselves on good old-fashioned ‘smørrebrød’, classic lunch dishes, and traditional home-style cooking on our evening menu. Everything is prepared from scratch using fresh ingredients, seasoned with "salt, pepper and love". We use only the finest quality produce, and our standards of food quality and customer service are always second to none.

Our restaurant offers a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, where guests enjoy their meals surrounded by cosy Danish charm, complete with red-and-white checked tablecloths. We are proud to be one of Skagen's most inviting lunch and dinner restaurants.

We take great responsibility for the wellbeing of our employees and place a high value on mutual trust. We work together as a team to serve honest, wholesome food in a relaxed environment for both our staff and our guests.

Your Key Responsibilities

As Restaurant Manager, you will play a central role in the daily operation of the restaurant.
 Your responsibilities will include:
•    Leading and coordinating the restaurant team during service
•    Allocating tasks and managing staff breaks
•    Ensuring efficient and smooth-running service
•    Welcoming guests and assisting wherever needed
•    Monitoring service quality and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction
•    Handling guest enquiries and any complaints professionally
•    Coordinating communication and cooperation between the kitchen and front-of-house teams
•    Opening and/or closing the restaurant, including cash reconciliation
•    Ensuring the restaurant is always clean, organized, and ready for service
•    Assisting with the training and onboarding of new employees
•    Resolving operational challenges as they arise during service
•    Managing stock orders and inventory control

About You

We are looking for someone who:
•    Has experience within the restaurant, hospitality, or service industry
•    Thrives on responsibility and remains calm under pressure during busy periods
•    Is service-minded, approachable, and solution-oriented
•    Can motivate colleagues and foster a positive team environment
•    Has a strong focus on quality and guest experience

We Offer

•    Permanent, year-round employment
•    Accommodation available
•    An informal working environment with plenty of room for good spirits
•    A relaxed workplace culture with a positive atmosphere
•    Some of the happiest guests around, because we serve great food
•    Supportive colleagues who work together as a team
•    A busy, exciting, and enjoyable high season
•    Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

Working Hours
Working hours will be scheduled between 10:00 am and 9:00 pm, seven days a week.

Interested?
If this sounds like the opportunity for you, please send your application and CV to smag@smag-toscana.dk

Subject line: Restaurant Manager

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will appoint the right candidate as soon as they are found.

We look forward to hearing from you

title: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English

Please note:
You must be an EU/EEA citizen. Applicants who do not meet this requirement should not apply.

Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

description:
Work tasks: - Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages.
- Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Open and close the restaurant in accordance with approved Company procedures and checklists, ensuring that all required opening and closing tasks are properly and fully completed. - Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. - Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. - Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. - Guide, supervise, train, and support servers and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. - Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth restaurant operations. - Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. - Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. - Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. - Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. - Manage and participate in continuous improvement of operations. Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Trustworthy, responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
.

Work tasks: Main Duties
• Prepare and cook a wide range of restaurant products, including savory and sweet dishes, baked products, pastries, dough products, fillings, sauces, soups, salads, desserts, and meat and fish dishes, according to established recipes and standards. • Prepare, roll, stretch, layer, fill, and handle dough and ensure consistent taste, texture, portioning, appearance, and presentation of finished products. • Organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, monitor product availability and workflow, adjust production when necessary, and maintain quality while minimizing waste. • Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. • Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. • Prepare and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly operational plans, including staffing, production, inventory, cleaning, maintenance, and other recurring requirements. • Monitor stock, ingredients, expiration dates, deliveries, inventory, write-offs, storage, and waste, and assist with ordering and stocktaking. • Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. • Guide, supervise, train, and support cooks and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring cooks, servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, allergen management, cleanliness, occupational health and safety, and general restaurant operating requirements. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, trustworthy, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

Tööülesanded: Oled hooliv, vastutustundlik ning hindad meeskonnatööd ja arengut? Siis on see ametikoht Sulle!
Sinu töö eesmärgiks on arendada ja säilitada psüühilise erivajadusega inimeste elukvaliteeti. Selleks tuleb igapäevaselt kliendiga koos või tema jaoks teha erinevaid tegevusi: - iseseisvalt elamiseks vajalike oskuste õpetamine; - tööalane nõustamine; - vajadusel arsti külastamine; - juhendamine kodu korrashoiul ja toitumisel; - suhtlemine kliendi lähedastega; - dokumentide haldamine; - vaba aja sisustamise motiveerimine või juhendamine; - võrgustiku- ja meeskonnatöö korraldamine. Kliendiga tehtud töö tuleb dokumenteerida ning see võtab umbes pool tööajast. Töö nõuab tahtmist ja võimekust ringi liikuda - korterite külastused, arstil, tööandja juures käimised jms. Teenusel olevatele inimestele väljasõitude ja ühisürituste korraldamine ja nendel osalemine. Tööle asudes tuleb arvestada, et osa väljaõppest toimub Tartus.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meil on hooliv ja kokkuhoidev kollektiiv - jagame ühiselt nii muresid kui rõõme. Elvas on kokkuhoidev kollektiiv. Kord kuus toimuvad asutuse töökoosolekud Tartus. Uutele töötajatele toimuvad uue töötaja koolitused, kus kõik erialaga seotud teemad detailselt läbi käime. Lisaks on olemas mentori ja kvaliteedijuhi tugi.
Võid kindel olla, et see ametikoht arendab Sind. Töö pakub võimalust tunda end vajaliku ja olulisena. Tööalaste väljakutsetega toimetulekuks toimuvad regulaarsed kovisioonid ja supervisioonid. Pakume puhkust suveperioodil ja tasustatud lisapuhkepäevi jõulude ajal ning tasustatud vaba päeva võimalust. Toimuvad ühised väljasõidud õppimise- ja kogemuste saamise eesmärgil. Sul on töö tegemiseks oma kindel töökoht, arvuti ja töö telefoniga. Juhul kui erialane haridus puudub, on võimalik see omandada tööl käimise ajal.

Muud nõuded: Töö edukaks elluviimiseks on vaja järgmisi omadusi: hoolivus, sallivus, vastutustunne, asjatundlikkus, avatus, uuendusmeelsus.
Sul peab olema valmisolek tööks puuetega inimestega - võimekus toime tulla pingelistes olukordades, kus on vaja rahu säilitada. Väga oluline on iseenda tundmine, võimekus hoida oma vaimset tervist korras. Samuti on vaja osata oma tööd ja tööaega planeerida. Töö eeldab võimekust töötada nii individuaalselt kui meeskonnas. Parimad tulemused tulevad oskusest ja julgusest küsimusi küsida. Kasuks tuleb hea huumorimeel.

description:
Experienced sewing professional wanted for Estonian clothing brand UMU’s studio

Work tasks: As UMU’s workload grows, we are looking for a skilled sewing professional with garment-cutting skills to join our small team. Your main task will be sewing everyday clothing from start to finish. Each team member makes complete garments independently. This keeps the work varied and gives you the opportunity to see the results of your work and take pride in them.

title: Office Assistant
description:
Work tasks: The Role:
Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

title: Senior Server
description:
Work tasks: - Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages.
- Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Open and close the restaurant in accordance with approved Company procedures and checklists, ensuring that all required opening and closing tasks are properly and fully completed. - Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. - Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. - Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. - Guide, supervise, train, and support servers and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. - Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth restaurant operations. - Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. - Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. - Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. - Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. - Manage and participate in continuous improvement of operations. Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Trustworthy, responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

Work tasks: - Prepare a variety of dishes and baked goods according to established recipes and quality standards.

We offer: - The opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly, supportive, and professional international team where every member’s contribution is valued. - Modern working conditions and professional equipment. - Competitive remuneration. - Opportunities for career advancement and personal development. - Affordable staff meals at our restaurant-bakery.

Other requirements: - Knowledge of baking techniques and current trends is an advantage.
- Strong attention to detail, reliability, excellent organizational skills, and commitment to maintaining hygiene and safety standards. - A positive, motivated, and cooperative attitude, with the ability to lead by example and maintain a positive working environment. - Leadership skills, including the ability to supervise and guide assistant cooks. - Passion for cooking and dedication to preparing high-quality food. - A valid health certificate for food handling. - Ability to work effectively under pressure and in a fast-paced environment. - Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required. Further details regarding the work schedule will be provided during the recruitment process. - Physical stamina to stand for extended periods and meet the demands of a busy restaurant-bakery environment.

Tööülesanded: Majapidaja/toateenindaja vastutab külalistubade, heaolualade ja ühiskasutatavate ruumide puhtuse, korra ning esindusliku välimuse eest.
Töö on füüsiline ning eeldab valmisolekut tõsta ja liigutada kuni 20 kg kaaluvaid esemeid, seadmeid ja töövahendeid. Laupäev on tavapärase töögraafiku osa. Peamised tööülesanded Külalistoad Külalistubade ettevalmistamine, koristamine ja hooldamine Eha töö-, tervise- ja ohutusnõuete kohaselt. Külaliste privaatsuse austamine ja nende isiklike esemete hoolikas käsitlemine. Hooldusvajadustest viivitamata teavitamine. Probleemidest, külaliste soovidest ja pooleliolevatest töödest majapidamisjuhi teavitamine. Heaolualad ja ühiskasutatavad ruumid Heaoluruumide, hoolitsustubade, termiliste alade ja ühiskasutatavate ruumide koristamine ning korrashoid. Ruumide puhtuse, hügieeni ja külaliste ohutuse tagamine. Ruumide ettevalmistamine ja taastamine vastavalt päevakavale. Akende puhastamine iganädalase graafiku alusel. Pesumajandus ja voodipesu Pesu kogumine, sorteerimine ja töötlemine kehtestatud töökorra kohaselt. Voodipesu nõuetekohane käsitlemine ja korrastamine. Tervis, ohutus ja hügieen Töötervishoiu- ja ohutusnõuete järgimine. Puhastusvahendite ja -seadmete korrektne kasutamine. Hooldusprobleemidest, ohuteguritest ja puudustest viivitamata teavitamine. Majapidamiskäru ja laoruumide puhta ning korrastatuna hoidmine. Suhtlus ja meeskonnatöö Tõhus suhtlemine majapidamisjuhi ja teiste kolleegidega. Täpse teabe edastamine tehtud tööde, pooleliolevate ülesannete ja külaliste soovide kohta. Koostöö kolleegidega sujuva igapäevase töökorralduse tagamiseks. Professionaalse ja lugupidava käitumise säilitamine.

Omalt poolt pakume: Brutotasu 1 300 - 1 500 EUR kuus.
Põhjalikku väljaõpet ja tuge sisseelamisel. Tasuta toitlustust igal tööpäeval. Eha poolt vajalikke tööriideid. Transporti või sõidukompensatsiooni vastavalt kokkuleppele. Abi sobiva kohaliku majutuskoha leidmisel. Eha töötajatele majutust ei paku. Toetavaid töötingimusi ja professionaalse arengu võimalusi. Meeskonnakultuuri, kus sinu panust siiralt hinnatakse. Rollis arenedes ja oma võimekust näidates saad võtta rohkem vastutust, panustada majapidamisprotseduuride täiustamisse ning meeskonna kasvades liikuda edasi majapidamistööde juhendaja rolli.

igapäevaseks töösuhtluseks vajalikku kirjalikku ja suulist inglise keele oskust, sest kohapealse meeskonna töökeel on inglise keel; võimet töötada kõrgete puhtus- ja hügieenistandardite järgi; head ajaplaneerimis- ja organiseerimisoskust; tähelepanu detailidele ja järjepidevust; oskust töötada nii iseseisvalt kui ka meeskonnas; usaldusväärset, professionaalset ja lugupidavat suhtumist; valmisolekut füüsiliseks tööks ning kuni 20 kg raskuste tõstmiseks ja liigutamiseks; võimalust töötada teisipäevast laupäevani; soovi õppida ja oma rollis areneda. title: AV Designer
description:
Big ideas in, flawless shows out. You're the calm voice in the control room – three steps ahead of everyone. Your next stage is at FLIK.

**The role**

FLIK is looking for an AV Designer who understands how live events work from planning to execution.

You combine technical understanding, practical production experience and strong problem-solving skills. You can design reliable technical setups, anticipate issues before production, and find solutions when plans change. You'll be the link between our Event Managers, Designers and Technical team. You'll translate 3D designs and client wishes into workable technical plans, challenge them when needed, and lead the team that brings them to life.

We deliver more than 2,000 IR hybrid events every year across the Nordics through our own platform VideoSync, ranging from simple audiocasts to cutting-edge Virtual AGMs.

**What you'll do**

- Plan technical setups for our studio, on-site and hybrid events

- Anticipate technical risks and solve problems before and during productions

- Prepare plans, budgets, equipment requirements and documentation

- Coordinate with internal teams, customers, freelancers and suppliers

- Participate hands-on in productions and technical operations

- Improve our studio architecture and ways of working

- Take ownership of technical production in our most important events

- Place customer needs first in your decisions


**Technical environment**

You'll work with technologies such as:

- vMix, Madmapper, Lightkey, Companion and other software-based AV tools

- AVoIP protocols such as NDI, Dante, ArtNet, OSC

- PTZ systems, audio systems, automation

- Production networking

- LED volumes, vision mixing

- WebRTC, RTMP and streaming platforms


You don't need to be an expert in everything. We're looking for strong general technical understanding and the ability to see how the pieces work together.

**Who you are**

- Have 5+ years of experience in live production, broadcasting, streaming, events or a similar technical environment

- Understand the whole production chain, not just your own technical area

- Can plan practical solutions based on real production experience

- Think ahead and spot potential problems early

- Take ownership and move things forward without guidance

- Have excellent communication and collaboration skills

- Can explain and justify technical choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Want to improve how we work, not just deliver the next production

- Are happy to get your hands dirty and participate in production

- Have fluent English and Finnish skills


**What we offer**

- A high degree of ownership in a flat, self-managed organisation

- A varied role combining planning, problem-solving and hands-on production

- The opportunity to influence our technical environment and processes

- A technically strong and supportive team

- Hybrid work model across our Ruoholahti premises, on-site or remote when applicable

- Opportunities to work across the Nordics and Europe


The position is full-time and permanent. The salary range for this position is €4,000–5,200/month + benefits. Our company benefits include high-end IT equipment, comprehensive health insurance, lunch/activity benefit and share option program opportunities, among others.

**About Inderes**

Inderes' mission is to connect listed companies and investors. Our customer base includes over 400 listed companies that rely on us for better investor communication.

Our Events business delivers over 2,000 online and hybrid events annually across the Nordics. We operate with a high degree of ownership, where teams are flat, decisions are made close to the problem, and roles evolve over time.

Inderes Playbook: https://group.inderes.com/files/documents/Inderes%20Playbook%20v4.pdf

**Application process**

Submit your CV and application via TeamTailor: https://careers.inderes.com/jobs/8455404-av-designer You may apply in Finnish or English.

We're more interested in how you approach technical problems than in polished applications. We'll aim to conduct preliminary Teams interviews, followed by in-person interviews for selected applicants.

The position will be filled when we find the right candidate.

title: Scaffolding Equipment Maintenance & Logistics Technician
description:
Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy is establishing its Finnish operations in Hyvinkää for the import, storage, logistics, sales and rental of professional scaffolding systems and related equipment.

The Hyvinkää site includes approximately 10,000 m² of operating and storage area, approximately 300 m² of covered shed/workshop space, and additional container-based storage.

We are recruiting two Scaffolding Equipment Maintenance & Logistics Technicians to support and manage the daily handling, inspection, maintenance, storage and inventory control of scaffolding equipment.

This is a technical logistics role requiring previous experience with scaffolding, construction equipment or comparable technical products.

Main responsibilities

\- Receiving, unloading and checking incoming deliveries.

\- Identifying scaffolding components and verifying quantities against shipment documents.

\- Inspecting equipment for damage, wear and defects.

\- Carrying out maintenance, repair and basic metalwork where required.

\- Organising scaffolding equipment in the yard, covered areas and storage containers.

\- Maintaining stock and inventory records.

\- Preparing and loading customer deliveries.

\- Maintaining tools, workshop and storage areas.

\- Supporting the development of warehouse and maintenance processes.

\- Following occupational safety and company procedures.

International coordination

The role includes regular communication with Affix manufacturing, sourcing, supply-chain and back-office teams outside Finland, including teams in India. Coordination may relate to shipments, packing lists, product codes, quality issues, damaged equipment, stock discrepancies, replacement components and delivery planning. Previous experience working with international manufacturing, logistics, sourcing, supply-chain or back-office teams is therefore important.

Required experience and skills

\- Relevant experience with scaffolding, construction equipment, structural-metal products or comparable technical equipment.

\- Experience in inspection, maintenance, repair, warehousing or logistics.

\- Ability to identify components and understand product compatibility.

\- Experience maintaining stock or inventory records.

\- Ability to read shipment and product documentation.

\- Sufficient English for daily international communication.

\- Ability to work independently and perform physically demanding work.

Considered an advantage

\- Experience with Ringlock, Cuplock or similar scaffolding systems.

\- Scaffolding-industry experience.

\- Metalworking or welding skills.

\- Forklift experience.

\- Experience with warehouse-management systems.

\- Car driving licence (Category B).

\- Experience in international import, export or container logistics.

Pre-employment requirement

\- A drug test will be conducted before a final job offer is made.

What we offer

\- Permanent, full-time employment.

\- A key role in establishing Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy's Finnish warehouse, maintenance and logistics operations.

\- International cooperation with Affix teams abroad.

\- Employment terms in accordance with Finnish legislation and the Commerce Sector Collective Agreement.

title: Spare Part Planner, Waterjets
description:
**Spare Part Planner, Waterjets**

An exciting opportunity has arisen as a **Spare Part Planner** with us at **Kongsberg Maritime** **in Kokkola**. You will be a Planner in our Global Customer Support division (GCS). The division is responsible for the customer support activities towards installed systems until phase out and removal.

You will be a key player in improvement of delivery time to our customers, mitigate risk upon delivery and other supply chain activities. We are looking for an analytical and hands-on planner to improve customer satisfaction by cooperating with our supply chain and sales team to ensure orders are delivered as planned.

_This is a great opportunity for either recent graduate or professional to join our Spare Parts team in Waterjets!_

**Key Accountabilities:**

- Be a link between procurement, production, and sales to ensure parts and orders are finished in time.

- Improve lead times for our orders

- Maintenance and continuous improvement of our delivery processes

- Represent GCS spares in weekly production meetings.


**Qualifications and experience:**

- Bachelors degree in Logistics, Finance or Engineering

- Oral and written communication skills in English, Finnish and Swedish is seen as an advantage.

- It is considered an advantage if you have experience with:


- Infor Baan ERP or Dynamics 365

- Excel, SQL


**You are able to:**

- Identify commercial opportunities and you have a positive impact on business growth and profitability

- Use a methodical and systematic approach and plan ahead

- Communicate in a clear, precise and structured way

- Co-operate well with others, share knowledge and support others in the pursuit of team goals

- Act on your own initiative, make things happen and accept responsibility for the results


**What we can offer you**

With us, you will be offered a competitive salary, good benefit package, flexible work hours, and good development opportunities in an international environment. In accordance with the remote work policy, you have the possibility for flexible remote work. By choosing us, you get to work in an inspiring and safe work-environment with sustainable and exciting solutions for the future.

**Work location** Kokkola

**Point of contact** For more information please contact Benjamin Gripenberg, Spare Parts Manager, Waterjets +358 442924246 on Wednesdays and Thursdays between 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM.

**Interested?** Please submit your application by 28th of October through our recruitment system.

**Our Global Customer Support** division is responsible for Kongsberg Maritimes services, upgrades and support in the aftermarket. Our 3400 employees are present in 35 different countries around the world. During the operational lifetime of more than 30.000 installations, we ensure cost-efficient delivery of services, upgrades and spare parts in order to secure availability and predictability to our customers.

**Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology.** We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than **30,000 vessels** operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than **8,300 employees in 35 countries.**

title: Software Developer
description:
**Would you like to build software that real companies use every day?**

CraftLeap is a software company founded in 2023. We develop easy-to-use software, particularly for **production and inventory management**, for companies in the manufacturing industry. Our product is already in active use by companies across Finland – and now we are looking for our first software developer to join us and help build the next stage of CraftLeap.

Our first customer joined us in 2023. We now have **almost 20 customers, with the majority joining us during this year**. Growth has been strong, and new customers are continuously coming in.

This is an exciting stage to join us if you want to have a real impact on a growing product.

What will you be doing?

You will be developing CraftLeap's web-based software together with the founder. Your work will include, for example:

- designing and implementing new features

- developing user interfaces and functionality

- improving and maintaining existing code

- investigating and fixing bugs

- developing the software based on customer needs

- building new integrations and backend services


As the product continues to grow, you will also have the opportunity to influence **what we build and how we build it**.

What kind of developer are we looking for?

We are primarily looking for someone who already has experience in software development and is comfortable taking responsibility for their work.

**Developers at the early stages of their careers are also very welcome to apply.** If you are familiar with software development, learn quickly, and are eager to work on a real software product, this could be a great opportunity for you.

Experience with technologies such as these is a plus:

- **JavaScript or TypeScript**

- **React, Angular, Vue or other modern web development**

- web-based application development

- REST APIs and integrations

- cloud services and cloud-based databases

- Git and modern software development tools


We are not looking for a long list of technologies on your CV. What matters most to us is that **you can build working software and solve problems independently**.

What is it like to work at CraftLeap?

CraftLeap is a small company, so you won't be one developer among a hundred others.

You will work directly with the founder. Decisions can be made quickly, new ideas can be tested, and your work will have a visible impact on the product.

The position is **hybrid, with a strong focus on remote work**. We do, however, hope that you can work together with us in the Seinäjoki area when needed.

There is no unnecessary bureaucracy or complicated organizational structure. If you see something that could be done better, you can say it – and even better if you can help make it happen.

Why join us now?

CraftLeap is at a point where the product is no longer just an idea or a prototype.

**The software is in production, we have customers across Finland, and our customer base is growing rapidly.**

We are now building the foundation for the next stage of growth. As one of the first developers at CraftLeap, you will have a significant role in developing the product and shaping the technical solutions as the development team grows.

Salary and applying

Salary will be agreed based on your experience and skills.

**Please include your salary expectation in your application.**

If this sounds like something you could be a good fit for, **we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement listed above**.

Tell us briefly about yourself, your previous experience and the kind of software you have worked with.

**More information:** craftleap.com

**Applications:** info@craftleap.com

title: Raskaskoneasentaja
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme **Raskaskoneasentajaa** vahvistamaan ammattitaitoista porukkaa!

Jos raskas kalusto, huolto- ja korjaustyöt ovat sinulle tuttuja ja tykkäät siitä, että työpäivät eivät ole aina samanlaisia, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö. Tehtävät ovat monipuolisia, joten tylsää tässä työssä tuskin tulee.

**Mitä toivomme sinulta?**

- Osaamista raskaan kaluston huolloista ja korjauksista

- Ajoneuvosähkön ja lukulaitteiden tuntemusta

- Hydrauliikan osaamista – tästä iso plussa!

- Hitsausosaaminen katsotaan eduksi

- Turvallista, huolellista ja tarkkaa työotetta

- Hyviä ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

- Hyviä yhteistyötaitoja ja asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä
