Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Manager (m/f/d) in Actuarial and Risk Modelling Services (ARMS). What if it was you?

The PwC Actuarial and Risk Modelling Services (ARMS) team in Luxembourg is looking for a manager with a background in non-life insurance and reinsurance expertise to join our local actuarial practice of over 20 actuaries and risk modellers. This is one of the largest actuarial consulting teams in Luxembourg. As part of our dynamic and diverse team, you will work on complex problems and challenges related to reserving, pricing, risk or capital projects across the Luxembourg and broader European markets, as well as multidisciplinary projects in areas such as reinsurance optimisation and business transactions.
Your role will involve working with the ARMS team on non-life insurance projects alongside colleagues from different teams with diverse backgrounds to provide our clients with the best possible solutions. Depending on the project, you will either manage it or carry out the analytical work yourself.

Be a part of our team where you will:

• Provide actuarial consulting services, including risk pricing, reinsurance optimisation, business plan review and development, claims reserve review, risk and capital modelling, and other actuarial projects.
• Perform IBNR reserving analysis, backtesting and valuation with a strong focus on business drivers, ensuring reserve adequacy aligns with regulatory requirements and translate technical insights into actionable recommendations for management and stakeholders.
• Support/lead Solvency II reviews for insurers, including Solvency II balance sheets, QRTs and ORSAs.
• Support insurance regulation-related projects as subject matter experts (SMEs) in reinsurance and non-life insurance, such as local regulation, IFRS 17 accounting, transfer pricing, POG/VFM, etc.
• Lead and deliver projects related to reinsurance strategy and optimization, including planning and pricing, and capital efficiency analysis.
• Work closely with audit teams to provide actuarial support to our audit practice with regard to Luxembourg-based insurers and reinsurers.
• Support the finance and tech transformation journeys of clients with subject matter expertise in reinsurance, risk pricing and reserving.
•  Lead and deliver actuarial projects focused on analyzing claims experience and development patterns, assessing reserving implications, and quantifying the impact on loss ratios and profitability to support strategic decision-making and improve overall efficiency.
• Support the Corporate Finance, M&A and Strategy teams by providing expert support for business transactions, portfolio transfers, actuarial due diligence projects and reserves/provision certifications.
• Assist in the continued growth and development of PwC's actuarial practice.
• Supervise and coach junior actuarial staff.

Let's talk about you. We expect that …

• You have significant progress in the examination process towards becoming a Fellow of the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries or a Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (or an equivalent actuarial association in a European country).
• You have at least 5 years of experience in reserving, pricing, capital or risk modelling in non-life insurance industry and/or consultancy. Alternatively, you have a background as a recognised non-life insurance consultant or have successfully delivered significant actuarial projects within the non-life insurance industry.
• You have practical experience with reinsurance, including planning, pricing, and optimisation, as well as Product design, risk transfer mechanisms, retrocession strategies, capital efficiency analysis, exposure modelling, and compliance with Solvency II and IFRS 17 frameworks.
• You demonstrate solid understanding of standard non-life actuarial practices under Solvency II, complemented by expertise in one or more related areas such as Luxembourg GAAP, IFRS 17 reporting, and regulatory compliance frameworks.
• You developed wider commercial awareness and understanding of the business and regulatory issues facing the non-life insurance industry.
• You enjoy working in a practical and creative manner, constantly analysing and solving new challenges. You inspire and retain clients thanks to your advisory skills.
• You have good command of the English language. Fluency in French is considered an advantage.
• You enjoy working in a team. You want to develop, build relationships and bring out the best in yourself and your colleagues.
• You are proficient in specialised non-life software in one of areas such as pricing, reserving, capital management (for example, URS, ResQ, or other recognised).

…so that you are the candidate we are looking for!

A final word about us:

At PwC, we believe diversity is the representation of all the characteristics that make us both alike and unique. Our backgrounds, cultures, nationalities, lifestyles, identities, opinions and beliefs, approaches to solving problems, ways of working, and views of personal and professional success, all add value to the services we deliver to our clients. BDO in Luxembourg is looking for a Senior Advisor in Liquidation Services !

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. title: Senior Data Sales Manager (m/f)
description:
Senior Data Sales Manager

Located in the heart of Luxembourg city, the Luxembourg Stock Exchange (LuxSE) is home to over 55,000 international securities and gathers diverse and committed teams covering listing, trading, information services and of course, the Luxembourg Green Exchange (LGX) - the world's leading platform dedicated to sustainable finance.

By joining LuxSE, you will become part of an independent stock exchange that has shaped international capital markets over the past 60 years and pioneered the rise of sustainable finance.

The Luxembourg Stock Exchange is looking for a:

Senior Data Sales Manager

Permanent contract (F/M)

As Senior Data Sales Manager at LuxSE, you will drive the commercial development of the company's Market Data and Sustainable Data offering. You will play a key role in strengthening LuxSE's position as the financial market infrastructure (FMI) of choice for international securities, while driving business growth and profitability through client acquisition and value creation.

Tasks/missions/responsibilities

• Act as a trusted advisor to the Head of Market Infrastructure and Data Solutions aligned with the corporate strategy and the product portfolio
• Exercise the Data Sales management at LuxSE and execute the workflow across the complete chain, from prospecting to closing deals
• Strengthen existing client relationships and build new ones (banks, asset managers, data vendors, fintechs and other data users); manage the sales pipeline from prospecting to closing
• Prepare sales forecasts and budgets; monitor and report on the commercial performance of our data products by analysing monthly vendor reportings and create dashboards (KPIs)
• Contribute to the definition of pricing, licensing policies and sales processes relating to Market Data and Sustainable Data products.
• Develop new products with stakeholders from other departments to add value to the business; monitor market trends, anticipate future customer needs and feed the product roadmap with market feedback;
• Participate actively in projects with impacts on Data Sales
• Act as opinion leader externally, contribute to raising LuxSE visibility and represent it actively in conferences and industry events

Education & experience

• Degree in Business/Economics/Finance or a related field;
• Min. 7 years of experience in business-to-business sales of financial market data, sustainable finance/ESG data or comparable information services;
• Strong expertise & proven track record in selling data products and licences to institutional clients;
• Solid knowledge of fixed income and sustainable finance markets and of the market data ecosystem (exchanges, vendors, index providers);
• A previous experience in an exchange, a data vendor, an index provider or another financial market infrastructure is an asset.

Technical competencies

• Sales strategy & pipeline management, from prospecting to signature;
• Knowledge of data licensing models, redistribution rights and the regulatory framework applicable to market data;
• Excellent business negotiation skills;
• Strong stakeholder management & communication skills;
• Excellent presentation & business writing skills;
• Data-driven decision-making & analytical capabilities;
• Proficiency in the use of usual office automation tools (MS-Suite) and CRM tools.

Soft skills competencies

• Consultative and strategic thinking;
• Ability to drive initiatives and to show accountability;
• Ability to work in a team, interact with various parts of an organisation (legal, compliance, IT etc), favour dialogue, listen to other perspectives and build consensus;
• Result-oriented mindset, with the objective to achieve tangible outcomes through persistence and determination;
• Ability to balance customer needs, business objectives & constraints;
• Public speaking and the capability to develop an industry network;
• Act with integrity and respect; foster diversity & inclusion.

Language skills

• Full professional proficiency in English. Any other languages is an asset.

Application

Luxembourg Stock Exchange is an employer for whom diversity and inclusion are important. We therefore encourage you to apply, regardless of your gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, religion or disability. At a later stage of the recruitment process, we may ask for a recent copy of your criminal record (N°3).

LuxSE does not accept unsolicited resumes, CVs, or profile summaries from agencies. In case of an unsolicited proposal, this shall not be considered as (i) "ownership" of the candidate and/or (ii) introduction of the candidate by such agency unless the agency has received prior authorization from our Legal and/or HR departments.

title: Business Analyst SAP FI-CO (m/f)
description:
Job Title:  Business Analyst SAP FI-CO
Company:  Deloitte General Services
Job Function:  Technology & Cyber Security
Level of Experience:  Experienced
Contract Type:  Open-term
Req ID:  14128

Job Description:  

Your future team

We are looking for a SAP Business Analyst to join our dynamic internal applications team. You will support our SAP ECC and Concur systems by managing tickets, overseeing enhancement projects, coordinating testing with users, and contributing to release management and planning. You will work closely with business stakeholders and technical experts to ensure our systems run reliably and evolve with the needs of the firm.

The advantages of joining us

• Career growth, your way: Access structured training and development opportunities to build your SAP and business analysis expertise.
• Global impact, local connections: Work in an international environment while collaborating closely with local stakeholders.
• Innovative work that matters: Contribute to continuous improvements of core finance and travel systems used across the firm.
• Inclusive, flexible culture: Join a collaborative team where your ideas are valued and work-life balance is supported.
• Build your network: Work with diverse professionals across business and IT, expanding your internal and external network.

How you'll contribute to our success

• Incident investigation & root cause analysis: Investigate and troubleshoot incidents on SAP FI-CO and Concur, identifying and addressing root causes to ensure stable and reliable solutions.
• Code reading & debugging: Analyze and debug existing code to understand system behavior, trace anomalies, and support the resolution of technical issues in collaboration with ABAP developers.
• Interface analysis: Review and interpret system interfaces (IDoc, OData, REST/SOAP APIs) to understand data flows, identify integration issues, and support seamless communication between systems.
• Ticketing & enhancement support: Manage and prioritize incoming tickets, and contribute to the identification, planning, and implementation of system enhancements to improve internal processes.
• Testing & release coordination: Collaborate with business users to organize testing phases and support release management activities, including planning, scheduling, and stakeholder communication to ensure smooth deployments.

Your skills

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

title: Senior/Assistant Manager - Local Market Advisory (m/f)
description:
Senior/Assistant Manager - Local Market Advisory
BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Senior/Assistant Manager to join our Local Market Advisory team!

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values-honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility—define our culture. Hence, our people can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

Being part of the Local Market Advisory team, you will:

• Support advisory assignments for local companies and subsidiaries of international groups, including cash flow, reporting, forecast and business planning projects
• Prepare, review and enhance cash flow models, budgets, forecasts and management reporting packs
• Develop reporting frameworks, dashboards and KPIs that translate financial and operational data into clear performance insights
• Leverage financial modelling and technology tools to improve data reliability, automation and decision-making
• Interact directly with clients to understand their needs, challenge assumptions and present pragmatic recommendations
• Work autonomously in a small and entrepreneurial team, while coordinating with internal specialists when needed

This position is for you if:

• You hold a Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics or a related field
• You possess several years of experience in finance, audit, accounting, controlling, advisory or a similar environment
• You have a solid financial and accounting background, strong analytical skills and a genuine interest in business performance
• You are comfortable with financial modelling and digital tools such as advanced Excel, Power Query/Power BI, reporting tools and ERP/accounting platforms
• You are able to build, review and explain cash flow forecasts, reporting packs, dashboards and KPIs
• You are professional, client-oriented and confident in discussions with management and finance teams
• You are autonomous, proactive, well-organized and comfortable working in a small team
• You are fluent in French and English; German or Luxembourgish are considered as asset.

What's in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

We are looking for a Business Solutions Engineer for our Investment Services field
Our Investment Services team is developing an internal platform that supports the management of cross-border fund registrations and regulatory operations. The platform is developed directly with the business teams who use it daily.
We are looking for a business solutions engineer who enjoys working within a business team, understanding operational needs and translating them into practical digital solutions. About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
The Department of Engineering (DoE) is a dynamic, interdisciplinary group engaged in civil, electrical, mechanical engineering and operations research/management, driving forward innovative research and solutions. It also has an internationally leading profile in computational science and engineering. We develop cutting-edge technologies, promoting the sustainable and economical use of resources, and meeting the technological demands of Luxembourg, the Greater Region, and beyond. Nearly all research projects are supported by a network of national and international partnerships, several with public or industrial stakeholders. At the University, the Department cooperates across faculties and with the interdisciplinary centres. In particular, the new interdisciplinary centre focused on complex environmental systems opens up significant opportunities for future collaborations.
The Department of Engineering seeks to hire a Research Support Engineer, with an interdisciplinary background in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, to integrate the Technical Support Unit (TSU). The candidate will work closely with the Technical Support Unit (TSU) Team Leader across all DoE research areas.

Your role
As a Research Support Engineer within the Department of Engineering TSU, you'll have an exciting and diverse job, typically at the intersection of technical support and project management. You'll be involved in research activities but as well support the Department outreach and education missions.
Support management tasks:
• Project management: Plan and coordinate research support activities, allocate resources, set timelines, continuously evaluate and optimise resource utilisation to improve efficiency and ensure project deliverables are met, in close collaboration with the Principal Investigator
• Acquisition/procurement: Organise together with the PI the purchase of materials, equipment and software. Keep the maintenance and update of licenses schedules
• Laboratory Management: Ensure all laboratory equipment is properly maintained, calibrated, and functioning optimally. Implement and enforce safety protocols to maintain a safe working environment, in collaboration with the FSTM Safety Officers. Oversee that researchers create and maintain accurate lab books
• Communication: Support the Team Leader in the liaison between PIs and relevant central administration services, e.g. procurement, infrastructures, safety and security, in collaboration with the Head of Department and the Deanship

Technical Support and Development:
• Work closely with researchers to understand their technical needs, provide advice on technical solutions and facilitate the translation of research questions into technical implementations
• Setup of experimental platforms involving sensors, instrumentation, and physical measurements, support to prototyping, including the involvement in the design, wiring, commissioning, and troubleshooting of systems
• Coordination and supervision of experimental work together with the PIs
• Liaising with companies and experts to guarantee the efficient, timely, and quality supply of services, software, equipment and laboratory consumables
• Good practices in documenting prototypes, procedures, and experimental results
• Ability to read and write technical documents: schematics, protocols, reports

Your profile
• Master's degree in mechanical, electrical engineering, or similar
• Leadership skills, experience as a team coordinator
• At least 7 years of experience in academia, in charge of supervision of experimental tasks: in the fields of mechanical and civil engineering - structures, knowledge in thermodynamics would be considered an asset
• Interest in academic environments and collaborative research is highly valued
• Adaptability and eagerness to learn
• Problem-solving attitude
• Excellent command of English (C1) is required for international communication and documentation. Excellent command of French or German (C1) is mandatory

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
The Department of Engineering (DoE) is a dynamic, interdisciplinary group engaged in civil, electrical, mechanical engineering and operations research/management, driving forward innovative research and solutions. It also has an internationally leading profile in computational science and engineering. We develop cutting-edge technologies, promoting the sustainable and economical use of resources, and meeting the technological demands of Luxembourg, the Greater Region, and beyond. Nearly all research projects are supported by a network of national and international partnerships, several with public or industrial stakeholders. At the University, the Department cooperates across faculties and with the interdisciplinary centres. In particular, the new interdisciplinary centre focused on complex environmental systems opens up significant opportunities for future collaborations.
The Department of Engineering seeks to hire a Research Support Engineer, with an interdisciplinary background in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, to integrate the Technical Support Unit (TSU). The candidate will work closely with the Technical Support Unit (TSU) Team Leader across all DoE research areas.

Your role
As a Research Support Engineer within the Department of Engineering TSU, you'll have an exciting and diverse job, typically at the intersection of technical support and project management. You'll be involved in research activities but as well support the Department outreach and education missions.
Support management tasks:
• Project management: Plan and coordinate research support activities, allocate resources, set timelines, continuously evaluate and optimise resource utilisation to improve efficiency and ensure project deliverables are met, in close collaboration with the Principal Investigator
• Acquisition/procurement: Organise together with the PI the purchase of materials, equipment and software. Keep the maintenance and update of licenses schedules
• Laboratory Management: Ensure all laboratory equipment is properly maintained, calibrated, and functioning optimally. Implement and enforce safety protocols to maintain a safe working environment, in collaboration with the FSTM Safety Officers. Oversee that researchers create and maintain accurate lab books
• Communication: Support the Team Leader in the liaison between PIs and relevant central administration services, e.g. procurement, infrastructures, safety and security, in collaboration with the Head of Department and the Deanship

Technical Support and Development:
• Work closely with researchers to understand their technical needs, provide advice on technical solutions and facilitate the translation of research questions into technical implementations
• Setup of experimental platforms involving sensors, instrumentation, and physical measurements, support to prototyping, including the involvement in the design, wiring, commissioning, and troubleshooting of systems
• Coordination and supervision of experimental work together with the PIs
• Liaising with companies and experts to guarantee the efficient, timely, and quality supply of services, software, equipment and laboratory consumables
• Good practices in documenting prototypes, procedures, and experimental results
• Ability to read and write technical documents: schematics, protocols, reports

Your profile
• Master's degree in mechanical, electrical engineering, or similar
• Leadership skills, experience as a team coordinator
• At least 7 years of experience in academia, in charge of supervision of experimental tasks: in the fields of mechanical and civil engineering - structures, knowledge in thermodynamics would be considered an asset
• Interest in academic environments and collaborative research is highly valued
• Adaptability and eagerness to learn
• Problem-solving attitude
• Excellent command of English (C1) is required for international communication and documentation. Excellent command of French or German (C1) is mandatory

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Curriculum Vitae, including any publications or technical projects, if applicable
• Cover letter
Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

title: IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator (m/f)
description:

IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in the domain of IoT communication connectivity and associated services. We are a venture capital-backed company with a successful track record of satellite launches and the first company in the world to disrupt the telecommunications industry by merging cellular 5G with satellites.
Our technology has massive implications for the Oil & Gas, Maritime, Industry 4.0, and Transport sectors, particularly in the management and tracking of assets in remote and rural areas and in extending 5G coverage through non-terrestrial networks.
As our wireless technologies continue to evolve and earn multiple awards, with funding for the next phase secured and strong commercial traction demonstrated, we are now looking to onboard an experienced IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator to strengthen and manage our cloud-first IT infrastructure.
In this role, you will be responsible for managing and supporting our modern IT environment across Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and virtualization platforms, ensuring the security, availability, scalability, and reliability of our systems. You will play a key role in maintaining a secure, resilient, and well-documented infrastructure, driving infrastructure modernization initiatives, supporting users across the organization, and enabling the continued growth and success of OQ Technology.

Job Responsibilities

• Administer and support all types of endpoints (Windows, Mac, Linux, and mobile) across the organization.
• Manage and support Microsoft Azure cloud services, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, conditional access, backups, and monitoring.
• Manage identity, access, and device management (Entra ID, Intune, MDM).
• Support secure collaboration tools (Microsoft 365, file sharing, conferencing), SharePoint Online administration, and licensing management (including CSP/NCE transitions).
• Maintain and optimize virtualization platforms (Proxmox or other hypervisors) and containerized environments where applicable.
• Manage and support AWS infrastructure, including provisioning, monitoring, and maintaining EC2 instances and related resources.
• Handle user and access management on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Support and maintain secure remote access (OpenVPN, bastion hosts, jump servers) and general network infrastructure (switches, firewalls, VLANs, routing).
• Support system availability, performance, patching, and lifecycle management across cloud platforms.
• Manage backup and disaster recovery operations using Veeam, ensuring reliable backup jobs, retention policies, and recovery testing.
• Maintain and support self-hosted or cloud-based GitHub/GitLab instances, including user access, repository administration, and general upkeep.
• Apply security-by-design principles across all IT systems; support compliance with relevant standards (e.g. ISO 27001) and internal security policies.
• Assist with vulnerability management, patching, audits, and risk assessments.
• Participate in infrastructure planning, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
• Troubleshoot complex system and virtualization issues across cloud environments.
• Provide Level 2/3 escalation support for the helpdesk team and end users.
• Document system configurations, procedures, architectures, and operational standards.
• Manage IT-related purchases (hardware, software licenses, cloud credits) in collaboration with procurement, and track asset lifecycle to optimize spend.
• Develop working knowledge of Linux systems and assist with Linux-based workloads as needed.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience as a Systems Administrator or in a comparable IT infrastructure/operations role in a corporate environment.
• Strong hands-on experience with Azure/Microsoft 365 administration (Entra ID, SharePoint Admin Center, conditional access, licensing).
• Solid understanding of virtualization concepts (Proxmox, Hyper-V, or similar).
• Experience managing AWS resources (EC2 instances and related services); familiarity with GCP user/access management is a plus.
• Solid networking knowledge, including OpenVPN administration, switches, firewalls, VLANs, and routing (TCP/IP).
• Experience with backup, disaster recovery, and system monitoring solutions (Veeam experience is a strong plus).
• Comfortable working with enterprise ticketing systems (e.g. Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk) for incident and request management.
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with a preference for clear, GUI-driven administration tools where practical.
• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting or administering Linux systems, or strong willingness to learn.
• Familiarity with scripting and automation (PowerShell, Bash, or comparable) as a complement to GUI-based administration.
• Exposure to containerization (Docker) and infrastructure automation tools (Ansible, Terraform).
• Familiarity with maintaining GitHub/GitLab instances (user management, repository administration).
• Experience working within an international organization, comfortable navigating diverse cultures and multiple time zones.
• Relevant certifications (Microsoft, Azure) are a plus.

Additional Information:

As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.

What We Offer

• Direct exposure to infrastructure modernization and licensing/procurement decisions.
• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week
• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.
• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.
• Regular company events and team activities.

Description

Leaders are owners. They think long term for our customers and don't sacrifice long-term value for short-term results. Amazon Freight Europe is looking for just such an owner to lead the strategy for our externalized freight business to design and deliver a world class freight experience for our business customers.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Head of Strategy will report directly into the leader of the Amazon Freight Europe business to lead and build out the newly created Strategy team across Europe (including UK). They will be based in Luxembourg, London or Munich to tackle the most hotly debated topics within our startup organization. They will partner closely with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial leaders to identify the challenges and opportunities in our organization, and come up with creative, customer-driven solutions to solve them. The Head of Strategy will work across both the European business and worldwide tech domains to shape our long-term business plan, diving deep with leaders across multiple areas to define customer problems and deliver the solutions.

ABOUT YOU

You're a self-described ‘builder' and ‘fixer' with a passion for figuring out what the future looks like. You have a relentless focus on creating and improving customer value. You're a hands-on multitasker who can quickly change focus and balance the needs of the moment with longer-term goals. You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. You have resilience and a positive, solutions-oriented attitude – even the toughest challenges are possible with the right amount of creativity, good judgment and hard work. You have strong problem solving, communication and organizational skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority, along with a good understanding of product development/management and digital media.

You're a leader with a blend of strategy, product management and/or operations experience and have the business acumen to understand and shape Amazon Freight's business-wide roadmap. You achieve your results through other people, often without authority, making complex decisions simple through data and inspire people at all levels in the organization. You proactively identify gaps and risks, and partner with senior leaders in and out of the organization to define creative solutions to solve them. You embody the rare combination of thinker and doer.

YOU WILL.

-Partner with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial teams to oversee strategic business initiatives from development through to successful execution, ensuring that individual function targets are in harmony and resolving those that aren't.
Support colleagues in their decision-making, program management, and initiative implementation, calling out opportunities to double-down and the unseen risks.
-Review, design, and execute improvements to organizational structure; find knowledge and skills gaps and help address them.
-Improve current processes and review organization-wide procedures for efficiency and productivity.
-Control the output of shared-services functions to ensure that outsourced tasks deliver to the high expectations of our Amazon Freight customers.

Key job responsibilities

•Ensure department goals are well integrated with each other and control organization-wide success, identifying areas to invest, double down or repair.
•Influence wider Amazon teams to secure collaborative, efficient solutions for our customers, re-using existing capabilities wherever possible.
•Build long term strategic plans, working alongside our product team, who specifies new products and features, our tech team that builds them, our operations that deliver them, our commercial team that sells them as well as the Amazon Freight teams outside EU.
•Stay close to the operational realities of our business, recognizing that what we will build has its foundation in the work of our Associates and partners on sites and in vehicles.
•This includes organizational design to help build our future team structures whilst securing support to our team for new hires, including documentation, onboarding, and learning and development team.
•Develop and build relationships with all employees for increased efficiency and responsiveness of existing operations, and help define new operational strategies by working with EU AF Director and other executives on special projects.

A day in the life

- Build relationships with our customers (shippers).
- Coach and mentor business developers within the team.
- Define business development KPIs targets and manage performance against these KPIs.
- Dive deep into shippers' requirements and pain points to find solutions.

About the team

At Amazon Freight, we blend advanced technology with Amazon's network of 6,500+ owned trailers and 13,000+ trusted carrier partners across UK & EU to move freight-simply and reliably. We apply the same customer obsession that we are known for in the consumer business to the Business to Business segment, aiming to partner with our customers to meet the demands of today while helping to navigate the road ahead. The team is diverse and intercultural with passionate members with a team-focused attitude. Across Amazon, we have committed to reach net-zero carbon by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement and we take this commitment seriously in Amazon Freight too. We're not there yet but if this sounds interesting, maybe you can help us get there.

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities

Description

Would you like to build technology products that help shape Amazon's transition toward a more circular economy? Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations are rapidly changing how producers and retailers manage products and packaging after sale, including recycling obligations, fees, reporting, seller compliance, and reverse logistics. Amazon is building the technology and operating mechanisms required to manage these obligations at global scale while creating the foundation for broader circularity services.

As a Principal Product Manager – Technical, you will define and lead the product strategy for some of Amazon's most complex sustainability and regulatory challenges. You will work across engineering, science, compliance, finance, operations, and sustainability teams to automate global EPR programs, improve product and packaging data, enable compliant selling partners, and develop scalable capabilities for recycling, recovery, and circularity.

This role requires a product leader who can operate in significant ambiguity, translate evolving regulatory and business requirements into durable technical solutions, and influence across a broad set of senior stakeholders. You will help determine where Amazon should build common global platforms versus localized solutions, establish mechanisms that improve accuracy and reduce manual effort, and shape new services that can support both compliance and circular-economy objectives.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to build at the intersection of technology, regulation, sustainability, and Amazon-scale commerce, with the ability to influence how Amazon manages producer responsibility today and how it develops broader circularity capabilities for the future.

Key job responsibilities

-Define and deliver AI-enabled products that scale global EPR compliance, including monitoring emerging regulations and policy changes, translating requirements into product and control strategies, and enabling rapid expansion across new geographies and regulatory use cases.
-Improve the Selling Partner compliance experience by building products that make requirements easier to understand and act on, reduce the effort and cost required to achieve compliance, and enable sellers to continue offering products across Amazon stores.
Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for EPR and circular economy, leading 3-Year Vision, annual operating planning, and quarterly prioritization while aligning investments across business, technology, compliance, sustainability, and operations teams.
-Drive automation and simplification across Amazon's EPR operating model, replacing manual processes with scalable technology, improving data and classification accuracy, and strengthening controls across reporting, fees, registrations, and compliance monitoring.
-Develop new circular-economy capabilities and services across recycling, recovery, reverse logistics, and producer accountability, identifying opportunities where Amazon can meet regulatory requirements while improving customer and Selling Partner experiences.
-Influence and align senior cross-functional leaders across engineering, science, finance, legal, public policy, operations, and sustainability to resolve ambiguous problems, make investment tradeoffs, and deliver durable global solutions.

description:

Job ID: 10558293 | Amazon EU Sarl - A84

Description

Amazon is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the EU Digital Product Passport (DPP) product end-to-end. The DPP is a foundational regulatory obligation under the EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) - and a significant strategic opportunity for Amazon. As product owner, you will define the vision and roadmap and translate a fast-moving regulatory landscape into concrete product requirements.
This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The problem space is not fully defined: regulations are still being finalized, harmonised technical standards are emerging, and Amazon's approach must be invented from first principles. You will set the goals, make the one-way and two-way door calls, and drive clarity across teams that have competing priorities. You will hold an honest tension between what the regulation requires and what creates durable value for customers and the business.

Success looks like: a defensible product strategy grounded in the regulation; a data pipeline and attribute framework that scale across product categories; on-time delivery of mandatory obligations; and DPP data positioned as a reusable asset that unlocks value across Amazon beyond pure compliance.

Key job responsibilities

* Own the DPP product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
* Translate regulation into product requirements.
* Shape the DPP data pipeline alongside engineering.
* Manage stakeholders and communicate with precision.
* Own DPP metrics and reporting.
* Extend DPP value beyond compliance.
* Operate AI-first. Encode product judgment, tenets, and trade-off frameworks into durable, machine-readable artifacts, and use AI to compress research, synthesis, and drafting cycles — owning the outcome and applying judgment to what ships.

About the team

The EU Digital Product Passport team sits within Amazon RISC International and owns Amazon's response to one of the most consequential product-compliance shifts in the EU. A Digital Product Passport is a structured, verifiable record of a product's attributes — origin, composition, sustainability, and circularity data - accessible via a data carrier such as a QR code. Under ESPR and its delegated acts, DPPs become mandatory on a rolling schedule by product category, starting with batteries and extending to textiles, toys, and beyond.
Beyond the regulatory mandate, the team is charting how DPP data can become a strategic asset across Amazon - for example, powering Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) eco-modulation, enriching the catalog, and serving as a single source of truth that auto-populates downstream compliance requirements. The person in this role helps define that ambition and turn it into a shippable roadmap.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience with end to end product delivery

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

title: Applied Scientist, SCOT FO Science and Tech (m/f)
description:
Applied Scientist, SCOT FO - SnT
Job ID: 10554093 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

How does Amazon decide which fulfillment center ships your order, which truck carries it, and how to keep promises across hundreds of millions of packages daily? How does it decide how many trucks and how much labor are required to ship orders across the network?

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization (FO) owns the optimization and forecasting science behind these decisions.

We are seeking Applied Scientists to join the FO Science & Tech team in Barcelona (alternatively: Luxembourg or London) with a strong academic background in optimization, machine learning, and/or time-series forecasting.

• You will design and build state-of-the-art machine learning and optimization models that power Amazon's fulfillment decisions at an unprecedented scale across two core scientific pillars:
• Large-Scale Optimization and Planning: Designing planning systems for order assignment and resource utilization, while balancing multi-objective cost-speed tradeoffs to enable controllers to steer millions of shipments per hour optimally.
• Demand Forecasting & Predictive ML: Developing time-series forecasts for customer demand, incorporating contextual information (weather, sales, order properties), and modeling uncertainty for core planning systems.

Basic qualifications

• PhD in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
• Strong programming skills (Python preferred; experience with optimization solvers a plus)
• Research experience in one or more:
• Large-scale mathematical programming (LP, MIP, decomposition methods)
• Combinatorial optimization (assignment, scheduling, network flows)
• Multi-objective optimization and control
• Large-scale time-series forecasting (GenAI models, probabilistic forecasting, uncertainty quantification)
• Causal inference (spatiotemporal causal modeling, offline policy evaluation)

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building optimization systems that run in production at scale
• Being comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration cycles
• Publications in relevant venues

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement optimization and forecasting models for large-scale fulfillment problems, from order assignment to network flow control. Build research prototypes end-to-end: from problem formulation through scalable implementation to production validation. Analyse complex tradeoffs (cost, speed, capacity, accuracy) and translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership and operations teams. Collaborate with engineers to bring science solutions into production systems serving millions of customer orders daily.

A day in the life

You formulate an optimization or forecasting problem on a whiteboard with teammates, then prototype it in Python with real data by the afternoon. You run experiments against production-scale datasets, iterate on the model, and present results to stakeholders who will use them to make network decisions next week. Some days you dive deep into solver performance; other days you're explaining a Pareto frontier to an operations leader. You collaborate with large engineering and product teams to bring your solutions into systems serving millions of customers. Alongside fast-turnaround prototypes, you own long-term research bets, the kind that reshape how Amazon's fulfillment network operates at scale. Your work goes live.

About the team

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization Science & Tech (FO SnT) is the applied research team behind Amazon's fulfillment decision-making systems. We decide how orders get assigned to warehouses, how capacity is allocated across the network, and how cost and speed tradeoffs are managed in real time, at global scale. Our models influence billions of euros in annual operational spend. They protect sites from overload during peak, reduce transportation costs and CO2 emissions, and ensure customers receive their packages when promised. Leadership relies on our science to make investment decisions worth hundreds of millions. We are practitioners of large-scale optimization: MIP formulations, decomposition methods, approximation algorithms, and parallelisation. We use machine learning where it sharpens our decisions, including forecasting, learned heuristics, and multi-armed bandits. We pick the right tool for the problem, not the fashionable one. You will work alongside Senior and Principal scientists, and collaborate with Amazon Scholars and academic partners who bring frontier research into our applied problems. We code our prototypes to be production-ready and collaborate with large engineering teams to ship systems, not papers. Above all, we have fun solving hard real-world problems at real-world speed, failing, learning, and shipping along the way.

Basic Qualifications

- PhD, or a Master's degree and experience in CS, CE, ML or related field
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in building models for business application
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) coordinates all teaching programmes in life in sciences, medicine, nursing, radiology and midwifery. The department's research combines basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches, with a particular focus on cancer biology, while also encompassing clinical research in human health and disease.
The DHML cooperates with the national health care centers and leading international biomedical research institutions. As medicine and health are strategic priorities for the University of Luxembourg, the department is actively expanding its education and research activities in these fields, providing exceptional opportunities for medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The position focuses on innovative, interdisciplinary teaching in public health at the bachelor's level and within health-related specialization programmes. The recruited professor will establish teaching and expertise in areas such as epidemiology, health systems, disease prevention, and health policy.
The successful candidate will lead the development and coordination of public health teaching activities across the University's programmes in medicine, nursing sciences, and midwifery. The role includes the implementation of a state-of-the-art public health curriculum, incorporating advanced educational tools such as digital learning platforms, data-driven health simulations, case-based learning, and interactive policy analysis. Working closely with faculty members and clinical partners, the successful candidate will ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students.

Research Portfolio
The candidate is expected to have an internationally recognised research profile and to bring a coherent research programme in public health. The candidate will develop and lead an ambitious research agenda in areas such as population health, primary care, prevention, health systems, epidemiology, health inequalities, data driven health sciences, and digital health.

Policy and Practice Integration
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in public health research and/or practice, with a commitment to integrating real-world perspectives into education. This will enhance the practical application of public health principles in healthcare and policy contexts. The possibility of maintaining collaborative activities with national health authorities or international organizations may be considered, depending on the candidate's profile and institutional partnerships.

For further information about the role, please contact: Serge Haan, Head of DHML, Email: serge.haan@uni.lu


Your profile
• MD/PhD or PhD in Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Systems, or a closely related field. An MD is considered an asset
• Extensive experience in public health research and/or practice, ideally with a strong track record in population health, primary care, health policy, or health systems analysis
• Substantial teaching experience in public health, epidemiology, or health sciences at undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels, preferably within medical, nursing, or life sciences programs
• Proven commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching, particularly in integrating public health with medicine, life sciences, and nursing
• Demonstrated ability to design and implement new educational courses, including modules on health systems, epidemiology, and preventive strategies
• Familiarity with modern teaching methods and tools, such as online learning platforms, simulation-based training, data-driven case studies, and interactive policy analysis

Language requirements
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. However, a strong command of French is considered a significant asset. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

title: Danish-Speaking Customer Account Advisor – Relocate to Malta
description:
As a Customer Account Advisor at bet365, you will be part of the European Customer Service team helping our customers around the world from our office in sunny Malta.

This puts you at the forefront of the world's most popular online gambling brand, helping customers with a wide range of queries related to their bet365 account.

This position is offered as a full-time position which requires flexible working hours. In order to cover the full sports calendar, you work in a shift system in which you work five days out of seven; this regularly includes public holidays and weekends.

This role falls under our hybrid working model, where you will work both from home and in the office. When working from the office, you will work from a modern office in the heart of Sliema with spectacular sea views and nearby flat rocky beaches with a variety of outdoor activities. From your first day you will receive training from instructors who will support, guide, and mentor you, so can provide an excellent customer experience.

What do we offer?

    Complete relocation package (more information below)

    Hybrid Working Model

  

Relocation package:

What you will be doing?

In this role, you will work within our dynamic and multicultural work environment. You will deal with different topics; among other things, you will respond to betting, payment, verification, and general account inquiries. Tasked with supporting our customers via live chat, email, and phone, they play a central role in the customer's bet365 experience.

    Providing support to our customer base via Live Chat and email

What we are looking for?

·        Fluent knowledge of spoken and written Danish is essential

·        Good written and spoken English is required

·        Passion for delivering outstanding customer service

·        Ability to problem-solve and find a resolution

Do you have what it takes?

Then send in your application in English today and we will contact you shortly!

title: Regulatory Counsel - Malta
description:
At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about regulation, we’d love for you to join our team as a Regulatory Counsel. This is an exciting opportunity for a professional looking to make a significant impact in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Regulatory Counsel is a mid-level role within the Regulatory function, responsible for providing independent regulatory advice and analysis to the business across multiple gambling jurisdictions.

The Regulatory Counsel takes ownership of a defined portfolio of regulatory matters, providing clear and practical advice on the application of gambling laws, licence conditions, and regulatory requirements.

The role involves independent management of licensing and regulatory submissions, proactive identification of regulatory risks, and substantive input into the development of policies, frameworks, and business initiatives. The Regulatory Counsel will develop relationships with internal stakeholders and regulators, contributing meaningfully to the delivery of the team’s objectives.

Accountabilities:

Regulatory Advisory & Interpretation

    Monitor, analyse and interpret regulatory developments across multiple gambling jurisdictions, assessing their impact on the business.
    Provide clear, practical, and independent regulatory advice to internal stakeholders across product, marketing, payments, operations, and technology.
    Conduct substantive legal research and regulatory analysis on applicable laws, licence conditions, and regulatory frameworks.
    Manage regulatory queries from the business, providing timely and well-reasoned responses with limited supervision.
    Provide regulatory input on customer-facing terms and conditions, complaints, and related matters.
    Identify and escalate novel, complex, or high-risk regulatory issues to the Senior Regulatory Counsel as appropriate.

Regulatory Strategy & Business Enablement

    Lead regulatory impact assessments in connection with new products, features, market entries, and strategic initiatives.
    Identify, assess, and advise on regulatory risks, contributing to risk assessments and mitigation strategies.
    Drive cross-functional engagement to support the embedding of regulatory requirements across the business.
    Provide substantive regulatory guidance on AML/CFT, sanctions, responsible gambling, data protection, and other key regulatory areas.
    Support the Senior Regulatory Counsel in providing regulatory input into the business’s strategic planning and commercial activities.

Licensing & Regulatory Operations

    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Oversee and ensure compliance with regulatory reporting obligations, including timely and accurate submissions to licensing authorities.
    Maintain and develop regulatory registers, licences, approvals, and associated documentation.
    Manage and develop relationships with regulators and competent authorities, escalating significant regulatory interactions to the Senior Regulatory Counsel.
    Prepare and coordinate responses to regulatory inquiries, inspections, enforcement actions, and information requests.

Regulatory Framework & Policy Development

    Assist in the development and maintenance of assigned regulatory policies, standards, and frameworks, ensuring alignment with applicable laws and licence conditions.
    Provide substantive regulatory input into AML, responsible gambling, consumer protection, and other regulatory policy areas.
    Develop and deliver regulatory training and awareness materials to Compliance and operational teams.
    Identify gaps in existing policies and frameworks and propose improvements proactively.

Governance, Assurance & Collaboration

    Provide meaningful regulatory input into compliance monitoring activities, internal reviews, and audit processes.
    Collaborate closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Technology, and operational teams to ensure consistent interpretation and application of regulatory requirements across the business.
    Lead or contribute to regulatory workstreams within internal projects, change program, and cross-functional initiatives.
    Support junior members of the Regulatory team, providing guidance and reviewing their work where required.

Documentation & General

    Maintain accurate and up-to-date regulatory documentation, records, and internal registers.
    Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Regulatory function’s processes and ways of working.
    Perform other duties reasonably aligned with the role.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    3–4 years post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, ideally within iGaming, fintech, financial services, or other regulated industries.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Exposure to AML/CFT, responsible gambling, and consumer protection regulatory requirements is required.
    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language (Danish, Finnish, or Swedish) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Confident and credible in providing independent regulatory advice, with the judgement to know when to escalate.
    Commercially aware and solution-oriented, with a pragmatic approach to regulatory challenges.
    Proactive, intellectually curious, and committed to developing deep expertise in international gambling regulation.
    Collaborative and effective in building relationships with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary
    Relocation package to Malta (if applicable)
    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

Je kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbinden

je werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je resultaten borgt in systemen, processen en gedrag,

Werken bij Compris:
Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.
Wat je gaat doen:
Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.
Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.
Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en weet belangen bij elkaar te brengen in een duidelijke aanpak. Thema's als risico gestuurd onderhoud, datagedreven werken en het vertalen van beleid naar concrete onderhoudsplannen? Daar draai jij je hand niet voor om.
En ondertussen help je ook collega's vooruit. Je begeleidt junior consultants en draagt actief bij aan het delen en borgen van kennis binnen Compris.

Word jij de SHEQ Adviseur die veiligheid, structuur en daadkracht brengt in complexe hijs- en transportprojecten?

Ben jij niet bang om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en medewerkers te coachen op veiligheidsbewustzijn? Dan is dit jouw kans om direct impact te maken!

title: Senior Engineer - AI-Native IDE & Agentic Developer Tooling
description:
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands
Employment Type: Permanent

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer in AI-Native IDE & Agentic Developer Tooling to join a small, highly technical R&D team in Amsterdam.
You will explore and build the next generation of AI-native developer experiences — from intelligent IDE capabilities and coding agents to context-aware, tool-using and self-verifying development workflows.
This is a highly hands-on role with significant technical ownership. You will turn emerging ideas in LLMs, coding agents and developer tooling into working prototypes, evaluate new architectures, and help shape future product direction.

What You'll Do

  • Build working prototypes and technical demos for AI-native IDE and developer-tooling capabilities.
  • Explore how modern coding agents handle context, tool use, planning, orchestration and verification.
  • Design and prototype AI-assisted and agentic developer workflows that improve developer productivity and experience.
  • Evaluate emerging IDE, LLM and agent architectures hands-on and translate findings into practical technical recommendations.
  • Experiment with new approaches to context engineering, agent orchestration and coding-agent evaluation.
  • Collaborate with universities, open-source communities, researchers and industry partners.
  • Work closely with international R&D teams to influence technical direction and future product capabilities.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong hands-on experience building IDE, developer-tooling or engineering-productivity features.
  • Good understanding of IDE technologies such as IntelliJ Platform, PSI, LSP, or similar architectures.
  • Practical experience with LLMs, coding agents, context engineering, agent orchestration, or evaluation.
  • Strong software engineering skills and the ability to independently turn an early-stage idea into a working prototype.
  • Strong engineering judgment and ability to evaluate emerging technologies beyond the proof-of-concept stage.
  • Strong English communication skills and confidence working with international technical teams.
  • Based in Amsterdam or willing to relocate.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with compiler toolchains, build systems, runtimes, debugging, or developer test infrastructure.
  • Contributions to developer tools, AI coding tools, research projects, or open-source communities.
  • Experience building developer tooling for ecosystems with limited documentation, tooling, or training data.
  • Experience with code intelligence, code completion, static analysis, refactoring, or program analysis.
  • Strong technical communication skills and the ability to clearly explain and advocate for new technical ideas.

Why Join?

You'll work at the intersection of AI, IDEs and software engineering, exploring how the next generation of developers will build software with intelligent agents.
Rather than simply integrating existing AI APIs, you'll have the opportunity to experiment, prototype and influence how AI-native development environments are designed from the ground up.
The position is based in Amsterdam and offers a competitive compensation package within an international R&D environment. -

title: Principal Architect — OS & System Performance
description:
About the Company
 
The R&D Center of a global leading ICT company, based in Amsterdam.
 
We are looking for a senior architect to drive the design and development of advanced OS-level system performance technologies and hardware-software-chip co-optimization for next-generation computing devices.
 
 
About the Role
 
The role focuses on system scheduling and performance optimization across CPU, GPU, memory, operating system, and chipset layers, balancing performance, power consumption, and thermal constraints. You will work across operating system, hardware, chipset, runtime, and application layers, driving technologies from architecture and research through implementation and deployment on end devices.
 
 
Responsibilities
 
  • Design and develop hardware-software-chip co-optimization and integrated system scheduling technologies, including CPU/GPU/DDR scheduling, priority management, task grouping, core selection, frequency scaling, resource allocation, and performance/power/thermal-aware scheduling.

  • Design and optimize high-performance core system modules and resolve critical system performance bottlenecks.
  • Research and develop high-performance APIs, runtimes, application frameworks, and performance-oriented system technologies.
  • Track advanced industry technologies and academic research and contribute to future technical roadmaps for system performance, scheduling, and hardware-software co-optimization.
  • Drive technical solutions from architecture and research through implementation, validation, and deployment on end devices.

Strong expertise in one or more of the following areas:
  • OS or kernel performance optimization
  • CPU/GPU/DDR scheduling and system resource management
  • Hardware-software or chipset-level co-optimization
  • Power- and thermal-aware scheduling and optimization
  • Application or runtime performance optimization
  • High-performance system, runtime, or framework design
In addition:
  • Strong understanding of operating system architecture and system performance fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience identifying and resolving complex system performance bottlenecks.
  • Proven ability to deliver measurable performance improvements in real-world systems or products.
  • Strong problem-solving and engineering execution capabilities, with the ability to drive solutions from architecture and design through implementation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively across international research and engineering teams.
 
Preferred Skills
  • Experience with Linux, Android, or other modern operating-system platforms.
  • Experience with kernel scheduling, DVFS/frequency scaling, heterogeneous computing, graphics/GPU systems, memory systems, or chipset-level optimization.
  • Experience working across hardware and software boundaries on complex computing platforms.
  • Experience translating research or advanced technical concepts into production-level system technologies.

At REV'IT!,, we have a deep-rooted drive. We want motorcyclists to enjoy their passion to the fullest. To achieve that goal, we try to learn something new every day. From each other, from our customers, from our data, and maybe also from you.

title: Senior Engineer - AI-Native IDE & Agentic Developer Tooling
description:
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands
Employment Type: Permanent

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer in AI-Native IDE & Agentic Developer Tooling to join a small, highly technical R&D team in Amsterdam.
You will explore and build the next generation of AI-native developer experiences — from intelligent IDE capabilities and coding agents to context-aware, tool-using and self-verifying development workflows.
This is a highly hands-on role with significant technical ownership. You will turn emerging ideas in LLMs, coding agents and developer tooling into working prototypes, evaluate new architectures, and help shape future product direction.

What You'll Do

  • Build working prototypes and technical demos for AI-native IDE and developer-tooling capabilities.
  • Explore how modern coding agents handle context, tool use, planning, orchestration and verification.
  • Design and prototype AI-assisted and agentic developer workflows that improve developer productivity and experience.
  • Evaluate emerging IDE, LLM and agent architectures hands-on and translate findings into practical technical recommendations.
  • Experiment with new approaches to context engineering, agent orchestration and coding-agent evaluation.
  • Collaborate with universities, open-source communities, researchers and industry partners.
  • Work closely with international R&D teams to influence technical direction and future product capabilities.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong hands-on experience building IDE, developer-tooling or engineering-productivity features.
  • Good understanding of IDE technologies such as IntelliJ Platform, PSI, LSP, or similar architectures.
  • Practical experience with LLMs, coding agents, context engineering, agent orchestration, or evaluation.
  • Strong software engineering skills and the ability to independently turn an early-stage idea into a working prototype.
  • Strong engineering judgment and ability to evaluate emerging technologies beyond the proof-of-concept stage.
  • Strong English communication skills and confidence working with international technical teams.
  • Based in Amsterdam or willing to relocate.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with compiler toolchains, build systems, runtimes, debugging, or developer test infrastructure.
  • Contributions to developer tools, AI coding tools, research projects, or open-source communities.
  • Experience building developer tooling for ecosystems with limited documentation, tooling, or training data.
  • Experience with code intelligence, code completion, static analysis, refactoring, or program analysis.
  • Strong technical communication skills and the ability to clearly explain and advocate for new technical ideas.

Why Join?

You'll work at the intersection of AI, IDEs and software engineering, exploring how the next generation of developers will build software with intelligent agents.
Rather than simply integrating existing AI APIs, you'll have the opportunity to experiment, prototype and influence how AI-native development environments are designed from the ground up.
The position is based in Amsterdam and offers a competitive compensation package within an international R&D environment. -
