title: Sales development
description:
We are looking for a motivated full-time sales professional to join our commercial team. In this role, you will work with the CamReach platform, run outbound campaigns, follow up with prospects by phone, and support the development of our commercial pipeline.

This is a hands-on B2B sales role with a strong focus on outbound calling, but you will not be working alone. You will have a support structure around you with pre-sales research, target selection, prospect data, campaign messaging, and the CamReach platform helping you prepare for and follow up each conversation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make outbound cold calls to selected Nordic SMB prospects based on structured pre-sales research and qualification

  • Follow up on prospects already engaged through CamReach campaigns across email and LinkedIn

  • Work from prepared target lists, company research, contact data, campaign messaging, and call support provided by the wider sales operation

  • Use the CamReach platform to understand prospect activity, engagement, and relevant context before and after calls

  • Qualify interest, identify sales opportunities, and move relevant prospects into the next stage of the sales process

  • Maintain accurate CRM and campaign records, including call outcomes, follow-up actions, and prospect feedback

  • Work closely with the sales team to continuously improve targeting, messaging, call scripts, and campaign performance

Mindset & Work Style

  • Self-managed and target-driven, and comfortable taking responsibility for your own activity and results

  • Comfortable working in an early-stage company where processes continue to evolve

  • Confident speaking with new prospects and starting commercial conversations

  • Professional and comfortable using LinkedIn as part of the sales process

  • Commercially minded and interested in understanding how different businesses sell and acquire customers

  • Willing to learn, test different approaches, and use feedback to improve

Skills

  • Fluency in Norwegian or one of the Scandinavian languages is a must

  • Strong verbal communication skills and confidence on the phone

  • Ability to independently research, understand, and qualify prospects

  • Ability to communicate clearly and adapt your approach to different companies and decision-makers

  • Comfortable using CRM systems, sales platforms, and digital tools

  • Confident handling objections and progressing conversations towards a meeting or next step

Experience

  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, account management, or a similar commercial role

  • Experience with outbound calling and prospecting

  • Experience with cold outreach across channels such as phone, email, and LinkedIn

  • A track record of working towards activity, pipeline, or sales targets


Perks and benefits

  • Full-time position

  • Flexible working hours

  • Remote work allowed

  • Office location near public transport

  • Opportunity to grow with an early-stage technology company and take on increasing responsibility as the team expands

Working at CamReach AS

CamReach is a B2B sales platform built around three core capabilities: Discover. Qualify. Engage.

The platform helps companies identify the right prospects, qualify which opportunities are worth pursuing, and engage them through coordinated outreach across channels such as email and LinkedIn. The aim is to give sales teams a more structured and effective way to build pipeline, with better data, better preparation, and more relevant outreach.

CamReach comes from a strong software development and technology background. The platform has been developed by a team of experienced developers, data analysts, and data scientists with deep experience in building digital products, data-driven systems, and business applications.

The wider team combines this technical capability with senior commercial and executive experience across technology, international business development, sales, and company building. This means we approach the product from both sides: how the technology should work, and how it needs to perform in a real commercial environment.

We are an early-stage Norwegian technology company with paying customers and an active commercial pipeline. We also have an ambitious product and growth roadmap ahead of us, with plans to expand both the capabilities of the platform and the markets we serve.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to join at an early stage, grow with the team, take on increasing responsibility, and be part of building the commercial side of a technology company with significant ambitions for the years ahead.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

CamReach is a B2B outbound sales platform built for Nordic and European SMBs. We help sales teams find the right prospects, run multichannel outreach across email and LinkedIn, and book more meetings, without adding headcount or relying on expensive agencies. The platform is built around a simple idea: precision beats volume. Instead of blasting thousands of generic messages, CamReach helps companies identify the right targets, craft relevant outreach, and learn from every campaign to get sharper over time. We are an early-stage Norwegian startup with paying customers, an active pipeline, and a team that moves fast. GDPR compliance is built into the core of what we do, which matters increasingly for companies selling into European markets. We are now expanding our go-to-market engine and looking for driven people to join the team.

title: PhD position in cancer chromatin biology
description:
About the position

Applications are invited to apply for a 100% 3-year PhD position in cancer chromatin and structural biology in the research group of Prof. Philippe Collas, project group of Dr. Marie Rogne, at the Department of Molecular Medicine, Division of Biochemistry, Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo (Collas Lab). The position is funded through the Norwegian Research Council. The successful candidate will collaborate with partners at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU).

Within the Institute, the Division of Biochemistry consists of a young and active community of nine research groups working on cancer biology, chromatin and nuclear dynamics, nuclear architecture, membrane trafficking, and adipocyte, muscle and vascular biology, using human, fly and mouse models. 


More about the position

The overall goal of the project is to establish knowledge of the innovative therapeutic potential of microproteins in advanced prostate cancer. In this context, the successful applicant will, in collaboration with the rest of the team and external partners, examine how specific microproteins regulate the activity of the transcription factor SOX2 using cell-based and epigenomic assays, and resolve the SOX2 microprotein complex using a crystallographic approach.

To be employed as a PhD Research Fellow, admission to the Medical Faculty's PhD program is required, or there must be a binding agreement for admission. Normally, one must apply for admission within 3 months after the start of the research project leading to the Ph.D. degree. The PhD fellow is expected to complete the project within three years.


Responsibilities
  • Plan and execute experiments in genomics (RNA‑seq/ATAC‑seq/ChIP‑seq), proteomics and recombinant protein expression/purification.
  • Design and perform cellular assays.
  • Maintain accurate electronic lab records, analyze and interpret data.
  • Present results at group meetings and scientific platforms, and contribute to manuscript writing.
  • Take the required doctoral coursework.

Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • To be admitted to the PhD programmes at the University of Oslo, an applicant must have a five year master's degree or equivalent studies in molecular biology, epigenetics or a related field, minimum grade B (ECTS grading scale) or equivalent.
  • Experience in cell and molecular biology, including vector design, cloning, engineering cell lines, cell-based assays
  • Knowledge and experience in chromatin, transcriptional regulation or microproteins.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Desired qualifications

  • Experience in proteomics (wet-lab and data analysis) will be a strong advantage. 
  • Some background in bioinformatics analysis of epigenetic data (RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, etc) is a plus.
  • Experience with electronic lab-journal systems (e.g. Benchling or E-lab) is valued.
  • Previous publishing experience is positive. 

Personal skills
  • You are independent but enjoy working as part of a team towards shared, ambitious goals.
  • You are positive, structured, solution-driven and accurate, with grit and determination.
  • You have a result-oriented mindset and contribute scientific and practical inputs to projects.
  • You are eager to learn and develop your scientific thinking.
  • Communication with other team members is important: you will therefore have excellent communication and collaborative skills. 

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues - could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A professionally stimulating working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550.800 to 607.500, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • If the person appointed does not have skills in Norwegian, Swedish or Danish at level A2 at the time of employment, we will offer Norwegian language courses with the aim of achieving Norwegian language skills at least this level.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities. 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter statement of your research interests and motivation for the position
  • CV summarizing education, positions, and academic work 
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only)
  • Copy of relevant certification(s) for laboratory animal work, if this applies
  • List of publications and academic works; do not include the publications themselves or your dissertation. 
  • List of 3 reference persons (name, relation to you, e-mail, phone number) 

Foreign applicants must attach an explanation of their University's grading system. All documents should be in English or in a Scandinavian language. 

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

 

The Institute of Basic Medical Sciences overall objective is to promote basic medical knowledge in order to understand normal processes, provide insight into mechanisms that cause illness, and promote good health. The Institute is responsible for teaching in basic medical sciences for the programmes of professional study in medicine and the Master's programme in clinical nutrition. The Institute has more than 300 employees and is located in Domus Medica.

title: Researcher in mathematical modelling of hub molecules
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

A temporary position as Researcher in mathematical modelling of hub molecules is available within the Marie Skłodowska-Curie (MSCA-DN) network HubMOL. The position is for a period of two years and three months. It will be affiliated with the Bioinformatics and Systems Biology Group at The Department of Arctic and Marine Biology at UiT. The candidate will be enrolled in the Ph.D. program at the faculty. The research project will be on mathematical modelling approaches targeting mitochondrial metabolism of hub molecules with focus on metabolic flux analysis.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. 


The position's field of Research

The main task of the project will be the reconstruction of models of mitochondrial biochemistry with strong focus on transport and dynamics of hub molecules and related post translational modifications and the development of new approaches for metabolic flux analyses to unravel the impact of changes in hub molecules on protein modification dynamics. 


Qualifications

Marie Skłodowska-Curie (MSCA-DN) education program enrollment requirements:

  • The candidate must not have completed a PhD. 
  • The candidate must not have lived, studied or worked for more than12 months in Norway within the last 36 months. 
  • The candidate should describe his/her motivation to join the project and how his/her prior experience will help to develop the project.
  • The position requires to spend several month in other research institutions within the network. 

Required qualifications: 

  • Successfully completed a master in biochemistry, biophysics, or mathematical biology or similar qualification.
  • Strong background in mathematics as well as programming experience in Python.
  • Good understanding of biochemistry.
  • Documented good written and oral  proficiency in English language.
  • We are looking for a colleague with excellent cooperation skills, and a positive attitude towards collaborative research, education and outreach. The successful candidate must have ambitions for a Ph.D. and be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

Additional desirable qualifications, knowledge and experience: 

  • experience in the use of advanced AI models
  • working experience in mathematical modelling of biological pathways beyond the master, especially metabolic flux analysis - 
  • experience in the interpretation of metabolomics mass spectrometry data

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Application

The applicants may be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants'
qualifications on the basis of the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description drawn up for the position. The application must include the following:

  • Cover letter including a description of interests, motivation and reasons for applying for the position.
  • CV containing a complete overview of education, experience and professional work. 
  • Diplomas, diploma supplements and transcripts (all relevant degrees, in original language and translated). 
  • Letter(s) of recommendation if applicable.
  • Two references with contact details. 
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important.
  • Documentation of English proficiency. Proficiency in the English language can be documented in the following ways: 
    • Diploma from a Norwegian upper secondary school with both spoken and written English (140 hours) 
    • TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) 
    • IELTS (International English Testing Service) 
    • Completed university degree in the field of English language or literature 
    • One year of completed university studies in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK or USA, for which English was the language of instructions. 
    • Or, by using alternatives listed here.

All of the documentation in the application has to be in English or a Scandinavian language. The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no. The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview shall among other things, aim to clarify the applicants personal suitability for the position and motivations.


We offer
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Good career opportunities
  • Good arrangements for pension, insurance and loans in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund

The remuneration for Researcher is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1108, with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 540.000,- to 590.000,- in a 100 % position. In special cases a higher salary might be considered. As a state employee, you have one of the best pension schemes availiable. For more information see: spk.no.

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants.

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

More information about moving to Norway and working at UiT: http://uit.no/mobility

​According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

In case of discrepancies between the Norwegian and the English version of this description, the Norwegian version takes precedence. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics. The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

title: Automasjonsingeniør
description:
Om stillingen

På grunn av økende oppdragsmengde, er vi på jakt etter deg som har erfaring med design av elektriske systemer, styresystemer og programmering/igangkjøring av styresystemer (PLS).

De fleste arbeidsoppgaver utfører vi fra kontorsted. Nordkontakt har kunder over hele landet, så noe reisevirksomhet ifm. kundebesøk, igangkjøring nye anlegg og serviceoppdrag må påregnes.

Vi har kontorsted i Bodø, men kan også vurdere andre lokasjoner om rette søker dukker opp.

Automasjonsavdelingen vår har i dag 40 ansatte, med en god bredde med tanke på bakgrunn og grunnutdanning. Her kan nevnes ingeniørutdanning/bachelor og master innen automasjon/cybernetikk, elkraft, mekatronikk og datateknikk. I tillegg har flere fagbrev som automatiker, elektriker, maskinist, kjølemontør og lignende som basis før høyere utdanning. En herlig blanding som gjør at vi sammen finner gode løsninger i et bredt spekter av oppdrag. Nordkontakt har som mål å være blant de fremste i bransjen på å teste ut og utvikle nye tekniske løsninger.


Som ingeniør i Nordkontakt

 Får du :

  • Jobbe med spennende kunder
  • Utvikle deg faglig i et sterkt teknisk miljø
  • Være med å teste ut nye systemer og tekniske løsninger
  • Ta et tydelig teknisk ansvar i prosjekter
  • Et spennende fagmiljø innen moderne og avanserte automasjonssystemer
  • Bred teknisk eksponering fra design til ferdig anlegg
  • Et kompetent og uformelt fagmiljø
  • Reell påvirkningsmulighet
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter, både faglig og personlig
  • Korte beslutningsveier og høy grad av tillit

Arbeidsoppgaver

• Prosjektering automasjonsanlegg.

• Programmering styresystemer og sikkerhetssystemer

• Konfigurering/programmering/design HMI og driftskontrollanlegg. Alarmhåndtering, datalogg og rapportering. 

• FAT- og SAT-prosesser - igangsetting nye anlegg

• Dokumentasjon 

• Serviceprosjekter - feilsøking, vedlikehold og ombygging eksisterende anlegg

• Oppsett servere/nettverksutstyr for automasjonsanlegg og driftskontroll

Avhengig av din kunnskap og erfaring, kan det også være aktuelt med arbeidsoppgaver/støttefunksjon opp mot andre funksjoner og fagfelt i bedriften. Våre leveransen stiller store krav til både IT- og OT sikkerhet.


Kvalifikasjoner

Vi søker deg som har :

Bachelor eller Master innen automasjon, kybernetikk, elektro eller tilsvarende. 

Du kan også ha teknisk fagskole innen elektro/automasjon.

Kan vise til arbeidserfaring fra lignende type arbeid.


Vi ser etter deg som
  • Er systematisk og strukturert.
  • Har lyst å jobbe direkte mot kunder.
  • Er faglig trygg og kunne jobbe selvstendig under tidspress.
  • Har god skriftlig og muntlig framstillingsevne.
  • Behersker norsk og engelsk skriftlig/muntlig.
  • Har mulighet for noe reisevirksomhet ifm. kundebesøk og igangkjøring av anlegg.
  • Har arbeidserfaring med lignende type arbeid.

Gode grunner til å jobbe i Nordkontakt

Gode grunner til å jobbe hos oss

Vi kan tilby en spennende stilling med utfordrende arbeid i en bedrift i vekst. Foruten et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og en stor dose godt humør kan vi også tilby:

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med god spredning i alder og kompetanse
  • Stor påvirkningskraft over din egen arbeidshverdag
  • Å delta på våre gøye sosiale tiltak
  • Treningsavtaler
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • En attraktiv bonusavtale

Vår viktigste kapital er våre medarbeidere! Vi setter derfor utvikling og kompetanseheving hos våre ansatte veldig høyt. Det forvalter vi som best vi kan i opplæringsplattformen vår Elektroakademiet. Les mer om hvordan vi legger til rette for at medarbeiderne våre kan søke ny- eller friske opp sin kunnskap via denne linken.


Vi trenger flere kvinner!

Vi og resten av Elektrogruppen anser mangfold som en styrke, og oppfordrer derfor spesielt kvinner til å søke. Les mer om våre målsettinger og hvordan vi arbeider med å styrke mangfoldet i vår likestillingsredegjørelse.


Vi tar bærekraft på alvor

For oss er bærekraft en del av alt vi gjør. Vi utvikler løsninger som reduserer utslipp og fremmer energieffektivitet, samtidig som vi skaper trygge og gode arbeidsplasser for våre ansatte. Les mer i vår bærekraftsrapport.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordkontakt er en ingeniørbedrift med 105 ansatte som jobber med automasjon, tavleproduksjon, digitalisering, informasjonsteknologi og elektro. Vi har hovedkontor i Bodø, avdelingskontor i Ørsta/Volda og er ledende innfor våre områder med en historikk tilbake til1966.

Vi er i dag en betydelig aktør innenfor automatisering av landbasert settefisk- og oppdrettsanlegg. Vi har også kunder innen slakteri, vei, jernbane, gruvedrift, forskningsfartøy, fiskebåter, bygg, industri, VA-anlegg og energi. Nordkontakt tilbyr også skybaserte tjenester ifm. SD-anlegg (NK-sky) til våre kunder. 

Vi har en stor IT-avdeling som leverer kameraløsninger samt bistår med OT-sikkerheten til våre kunders anlegg. 

Nordkontakt leverer produkter og tjenester på alle nivå i prosessen, fra enkle komponenter til ferdige idriftsatte anlegg. Vi har flere ulike testverksted tilknyttet våre ulike fag. Og om vi ikke har funnet komponenter som dekker kundenes behov, så har vi faktisk bare utviklet disse selv. 

Vårt verdigrunnlag er tuftet på at vi er en bedrift som opptrer Fremtidsrettet Ansvarlig Løsningsorientert og Kompetent. Vi løser våre oppdrag med målsetting om å skape trygghet for våre kunder, så vel som våre medarbeidere og samfunnet vi er en del av, og i Nordkontakt, holder vi det vi lover!

Vi er en del av konsernet Elektrogruppen, en av landets største private tekniske entreprenører med virksomhet fra Trøndelag i sør til Vesterålen i nord.  Samlet er nesten 700 ansatte, fordelt på 15 entreprenører. Effektivt tverrfaglig samarbeid og erfaringsutveksling bedriftene imellom gir positive effekter for våre kunder lokalt.

title: Senior Financial Controller - regnskap og rapportering - Osland AS
description:
Osland-konsernet er et av landets eldste akvakulturselskaper, med virksomhet innen genetikk, settefisk og matfiskproduksjon. Vi søker nå en erfaren Senior Financial Controller som vil få en sentral rolle i videreutviklingen av konsernets økonomifunksjon.

 

Rollen er knyttet til Osland AS-delkonsernet, som består av Osland AS og fem datterselskaper, i tillegg til løpende oppfølging av fire produksjonsregnskap. Dette gir et bredt og komplekst økonomisk landskap med behov for god forståelse av sammenhengen mellom selskapsregnskap, produksjon, rapportering og styringsinformasjon. Dette er en bred seniorrolle for deg som har solid regnskapsforståelse, liker å skape struktur og kvalitet, og samtidig motiveres av utvikling, systemer og smartere arbeidsprosesser.

 

Du vil arbeide tett med økonomisjef/CFO, Business Controller og regnskapsførerne, og få en viktig rolle i å sikre kvalitet i regnskap og rapportering på tvers av selskaper og produksjonsområder.

 

Stillingen spenner fra operative og regnskapsnære oppgaver til rapportering, budsjett, internkontroll, systemutvikling og forbedring av økonomiprosesser. Vi ser derfor etter en erfaren person som trives med bredde og variasjon, og som er komfortabel med at prioriteringene kan variere gjennom året.

Om rollen

Som Senior Financial Controller vil du være en sentral fagressurs i økonomiteamet og bidra til at regnskap, tallgrunnlag og rapportering holder høy kvalitet. Du vil arbeide tett med regnskapsførerne og Business Controller i den månedlige lukkingen av regnskapene, og bidra til gode rutiner, avstemminger, periodiseringer og regnskapsmessige vurderinger. Samtidig vil du ha en viktig rolle innen konsolidering, rapportering, budsjett og prognoser, og være med på å videreutvikle konsernets økonomiske styringsinformasjon.

 

En viktig del av rollen er også løpende arbeid med å styrke internkontroll og strukturkapital. Det innebærer å bidra til tydelige rutiner, dokumenterte arbeidsprosesser, god ansvarsdeling og etterlevelse av etablerte prinsipper og kontrollaktiviteter. Vi arbeider tett med robuste prosesser som er forståelige, etterleves i organisasjonen og er mindre personavhengige.

 

Du vil også bidra til å utvikle måten vi arbeider på gjennom bedre utnyttelse av ERP-system, rapporteringsløsninger, data og automatisering.

 

Rollen passer godt for deg som liker kombinasjonen av regnskap, kvalitet, internkontroll, systemforståelse og utvikling. Dette er en seniorrolle som krever at du arbeider selvstendig, tar eierskap til dine ansvarsområder og selv ser hvor det er behov for oppfølging eller forbedring. Vi ser etter en person som tar initiativ, driver saker fremover og bidrar der behovet er størst.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Delta aktivt i månedlig regnskapsavslutning for selskapene og sikre god kvalitet og fremdrift i closingprosessen
  • Kvalitetssikre regnskap, avstemminger, periodiseringer og vesentlige regnskapsmessige vurderinger
  • Bidra til konsolidering og konsernrapportering
  • Kvalitetssikre og videreutvikle månedlig rapportering og styringsinformasjon
  • Ha en sentral rolle i omfattende budsjett- og prognoseprosesser
  • Følge opp balanse, arbeidskapital, kontantstrøm og grunnlag for likviditetsprognoser
  • Følge opp internprising, internfakturering og konserninterne avregninger
  • Arbeide med verdsettelse og kontroll av beholdning og varelager
  • Delta sentralt i årsoppgjør og revisjon
  • Videreutvikle internkontroll, rutiner, dokumentasjon og kontrollaktiviteter
  • Bidra til at etablerte rutiner, fullmakter og prosesser etterleves i organisasjonen
  • Bygge og vedlikeholde strukturkapital gjennom tydelige arbeidsprosesser, ansvarsdeling og dokumentasjon
  • Redusere personavhengighet og bidra til robuste og skalerbare økonomiprosesser
  • Bidra til videreutvikling og bedre utnyttelse av ERP- og rapporteringssystemer
  • Identifisere muligheter for standardisering, automatisering og effektivisering
  • Bidra i økonomirelaterte utviklingsprosjekter på tvers av konsernet
  • Være en faglig sparringspartner for kollegaer i økonomiteamet
Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en erfaren og faglig trygg økonom som liker å ta ansvar for at tallene er riktige og prosessene fungerer godt.

 

Du er strukturert og nøyaktig, men samtidig pragmatisk og løsningsorientert. Du evner å gå ned i detaljene når det er nødvendig, samtidig som du ser helheten og forstår hvordan selskapsregnskap, produksjon, systemer, internkontroll og rapportering henger sammen.

 

Vi tror du vil trives i rollen dersom du:

  • liker en variert arbeidshverdag og et bredt ansvarsområde
  • er selvstendig, initiativrik og komfortabel med å ta faglig ansvar
  • er fleksibel og håndterer både faste prosesser og problemstillinger som oppstår underveis
  • tar eierskap, jobber åpent og følger opp oppgaver til de er løst
  • ser forbedringsbehov og tar initiativ uten å være avhengig av detaljerte bestillinger
  • liker å skape struktur og sikre at avtalte arbeidsmetoder faktisk etterleves
  • har forståelse for betydningen av gode rutiner, dokumentasjon og internkontroll
  • er opptatt av å bygge robuste prosesser som ikke er avhengige av enkeltpersoner
  • er nysgjerrig på systemer og hvordan teknologi kan brukes til å forenkle og forbedre økonomiarbeidet
  • liker kombinasjonen av operative oppgaver og mer langsiktig utviklingsarbeid

Vi ser ikke etter en person som kun ønsker å arbeide med én avgrenset del av økonomifaget. Stillingen har stor bredde og krever at du både kan gå ned i detaljene og løfte blikket, samt bidra der behovet til enhver tid er størst.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Høyere utdanning innen økonomi, regnskap, revisjon eller tilsvarende
  • Flere års relevant erfaring fra regnskap, revisjon, controlling eller finansiell rapportering
  • Solid regnskapsforståelse og erfaring med måneds- og årsavslutning
  • God forståelse for resultat, balanse og kontantstrøm
  • God systemforståelse og erfaring med ERP- og rapporteringssystemer, samt interesse for videre læring
  • Gode Excel-kunnskaper
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk

Erfaring med konsernregnskap, budsjett og prognose, varelagervurdering, revisjon, internkontroll, Xledger, One Stop Reporting, Power BI, Power Query eller automatisering er en fordel.

 

Det viktigste er at du har et solid faglig fundament, tilstrekkelig erfaring til å ta et selvstendig faglig ansvar og et ønske om å bidra til å bygge en stadig bedre og mer robust økonomifunksjon.

Vi tilbyr
  • En sentral seniorrolle i økonomifunksjonen i et norsk havbrukskonsern
  • Et bredt ansvarsområde på tvers av selskaper, produksjonsområder og økonomiprosesser
  • Stor grad av selvstendighet og påvirkningsmulighet
  • Mulighet til å påvirke hvordan økonomiprosesser, internkontroll, systemer og rapportering videreutvikles
  • En sentral rolle i å bygge robuste arbeidsprosesser og strukturkapital i organisasjonen
  • Tett samarbeid med økonomisjef/CFO, Business Controller, regnskapsførere og ledere i konsernet
  • Moderne systemer og gode muligheter for faglig utvikling
  • Mulighet til å kombinere regnskapsfaglig arbeid med system- og prosessutvikling
  • Fleksibilitet og mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Arbeidssted: Sandviken, Bergen

  • Hjemmekontor: Delvis, etter avtale

     

Har du spørsmål om stillingen kan du kontakte vår rekrutteringsrådgiver i Lederhuset AS, Bjarne Jacobsen.

title: Green Office - Project Coordinator
description:
About the position 

The UiO Green Office is looking for a student employee to help strengthen sustainability engagement across student life, education, and research at the University of Oslo.

This position is part of two of our working groups; Education & Research and Dissemination & Dialogue work. They work to connect students, student organizations and researchers to strengthen sustainability engagement at UiO.


Qualifications

Previous experience or education related to organizational work or education is an advantage. You must be enrolled as a UiO student throughout 2026 and 2027

Key responsibilities and tasks include:

  • Collaborating with the Student Parliament, student organizations and other sustainability initiatives.
  • Promoting sustainability-related education and research at UiO
  • Contributing to larger events such as the SDG conference, theme weeks and national and international Green Office networks
  • Supporting projects that connect students, faculties, and researchers

Personal skills

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has an interest in sustainability education and research and student engagement
  • Can work independently and take responsibility for projects
  • Enjoys working collaboratively in a team

  • Has strong organizational skills

    It is an advantage if you have experience with:

  • Student organizations, politics (i.e. program committee), volunteer work, or project coordination.
  • Event planning, communication, or outreach activities

We offer 
  • A 20-30% position (depending on your capacity) 
  • Salary NOK 425 000 - per year for a full-time position (pro-rated for 20–30%).
  • Practical experience with sustainability projects and collaboration across the university
  • Practical experience in sustainability and project development
  • An engaging, creative, and supportive work environment
  • Opportunities to shape sustainability initiatives at UiO
  • Valuable experience in teamwork, leadership, and stakeholder collaboration

Inclusive worklife and diversity at UiO

Inclusion and diversity are a strength. The University of Oslo has a personnel policy objective of achieving a balanced gender composition. Furthermore, we want employees with diverse professional expertise, life experience and perspectives.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, employment gaps or immigrant background, we will invite at least one applicant from each of these categories to an interview.

We hope that you will apply for the position. 


How to apply

Please submit:

  • A CV
  • A short motivation letter (approximately one page)
  • A reference person (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number) is positive, but not a requirement. 

In your motivation letter, we would like you to reflect briefly on:

  • Why would you like to work at the Green Office?
  • How would you engage students and student organizations in sustainability work at UiO?
  • What experience, skills, or interests would you bring to this role?
  • Describe an initiative, project, or collaboration that you are proud of contributing to.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

About the Green Office

The Green Office is UiO's student-driven hub for sustainability initiatives (Green Office - University of Oslo).. We develop projects, events, and collaborations that help make the university more sustainable while creating opportunities for students to get involved. Our team is organized into four working groups that reflect the themes of UiO's Climate and Environmental Strategy (Comprehensive Climate and Environmental Strategy - University of Oslo).

title: Researcher in artificial intelligence for future healthcare solutions
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

An exciting position as Researcher is available in the Department of Computer Science within the TRUSTING project (https://trusting-project.eu/). The project is funded by the EU until 31st December 2028. The position is for one year initially. The research focuses on voice and language-based AI for psychosis relapse detection and will be conducted within a thriving research group that has recently received grants of excellence.

The goal is to contribute broadly to research on applications of AI in medicine, specifically to the development and validation of novel computational language models, algorithms, and tools for spoken language-based detection of schizophrenia relapse in 6 different languages.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. Ideally, you can start as soon as possible but must be able to start in the position in Tromsø within a reasonable time after receiving the offer. 


The project

TRUSTING is a research project where an international interdisciplinary team are developing a machine learning based monitoring system that leverages spoken language processing (SLP) and natural language processing (NLP) of speech recorded at home to calculate relapse risk. The developed monitoring system will be used in a forthcoming randomized clinical trial where the goal is to validate the clinical outcomes of those affected by schizophrenia. Within this project, we are seeking a researcher with a strong computer science background to take an active role in developing novel machine learning based systems and tools on the path towards clinical use and implementation of AI for the treatment and care of patients. The candidate will contribute broadly to the project to enable the development of new algorithms for clinical AI based on patient data from heterogeneous sources notably language/speech-based sources. The activity will focus on the development of a prototype implementation of early warning- and other AI-based decision support systems to study the effectiveness and safety of a novel clinical decision tool that is based on SLP/NLP and utilizes large language models. The monitoring system has three main parts, namely a secure backend for recording sounds from mobile phones, a platform for data cleaning and machine learning model development, and a front-end app used by the patients. Therefore, an interest in working with state-of-the-art MLOps technology is an advantage. The project will focus on interaction with clinicians, with a goal of closing the gap between foundational research in machine learning and the clinical use of machine learning methods for the benefit of patients from a healthcare point of view. Hence, the work will be conducted in a highly interdisciplinary research environment and the candidates will collaborate with an international team consisting of clinicians, researchers in science and technology, health, industry partners, as well as personnel responsible for ICT, data security, privacy concerns and more. 

The UiT team will collaborate with the other research teams within the TRUSTING consortium. 


Contact

Further information about the position and UiT is available by contacting: 

  • Professor Brita Elvevåg: phone +47 91993063; email: brita.elvevag@uit.no 
  • Professor Lars Ailo Bongo: phone +47 92015508; email: lars.ailo.bongo@uit.no 
  • Associate Prof. Sandra Just, phone +49 1771966546; email: sandra.a.just@uit.no

General and administrative questions: 

  • Head of administration Martin Fjellvang Osima, phone +47 77 64 62 44; email: martin.osima@uit.no 

Qualification requirements

We are looking for applicants with a strong background, interest and expertise in computer science research with a focus on machine learning methods for the health domain, with strong coding skills and familiarity with state-of-the-art machine learning frameworks. We would like an interested, active and highly motivated candidate who likes to explore new technologies, and who is an independent thinker but also a team player who will enjoy collaborating with other researchers and clinicians. 

The position requires 

  • a PhD degree in computer science or a related field (e.g., computational behavioral science) 
  • a publication record that document solid expertise in computer science
  • strong technical skills 
  • since the position is part of an interdisciplinary project, close interaction with other project participants will be required.
  • good communication skills in English are necessary and documented fluency in English is required.
  • personal suitability: Our working culture is important to us. We will emphasize the applicants motivation for the position and personal suitability. We are looking for candidates who display the following:
    • Collegial team player, ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff and contribute to a good working
      environment.
    • Strong networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
    • Interest in strategy and strategic development of the department.
    • Good communication skills and ability to engage with academic, stakeholder and public audiences.

 

An advantage:  

  • previous experience in natural language processing, sound-based machine learning, development and deployment of health technology software is considered a benefit. 
  • experience with explainable and interpretable AI methods applied within medical contexts, notably in clinical decision systems, would be an advantage. 
  • previous experience in systems development, data management, networking, and applied machine learning is also considered an advantage. 
  • it is also beneficial if the applicant has an interest and previous experience with inter-disciplinary or industry collaboration. 
  • candidates with research experience and relevant publications in conferences and journals will be considered with higher priority

For a permanent position as researcher it requires proficiency in a Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). New employees who do not fulfill the language criteria by appointment are required, within three years, to demonstrate sufficient proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Arrangements will be made to facilitate the completion of Norwegian courses.

During this assessment process, emphasis will be placed on your potential for research as evidenced by a thesis and any other academic works. In addition, we may consider work experience or other activities of significance. The assessment will emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position.

 At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA). 

UiT wishes to increase the proportion of females in academic positions. In cases where two or more applicants are found to be approximately equally qualified, female applicants will be given priority. 


Application

We will evaluate you based only on the documentation that you submit with the application. 

The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no and must contain:

  • Letter of application – this should include a short description of your background and its relevance to the advertised position, as well as a summary of your motivation for applying for this position. Please make it clear why you consider yourself qualified for this position and describe how you will strengthen the research activity in the research team (e.g., a vision statement).
  • CV with complete overview of education, supervised professional training, professional experience, and list of scientific publications.
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important and of relevance to this position. A brief description of the other listed works should also be included to demonstrate breadth of production. These descriptions shall be an attachment to the application. 
  • Description of your academic and software production and links to any open-source code.
  • Up to five academic works. The doctoral thesis is regarded as one work. 
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all academic degrees) 
  • Contact information to 2-3 references 
  • Documentation of English proficiency 

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. We only accept applications and documentation sent via Jobbnorge within the application deadline. The applicant will be assessed by an expert committee. 


We offer
  • Participation in an excellent and thriving research group that has recently received a prestigious ERC Synergy grant (https://erc.europa.eu/news-events/news/synergy-grants-2023-examples-projects) 
  • A productive, collaborative, and stimulating environment with researchers working on cutting-edge medical applications of artificial intelligence and speech technologies
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement 
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • The possibility to balance professional development with a location to experience the liberating arctic nature: ski under the northern lights, hike and bike along the fjords 
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services. 
  • If you have to relocate to Tromsø then the Faculty of Science and Technology may reimburse your moving costs. Further details
    regarding this matter will be made available if you receive an offer from us.

 

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for
applicants.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment.
 

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.
 

More information about moving to Norway and working at UiT: http://uit.no/mobility
 

The remuneration for the position is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1109, with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 670000 to 730000 (in a 100% position)  (In special cases, a higher salary may be considered.)


A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. As a state employee, you will have one of the best pension schemes available. For more information see: spk.no

Employees who have been temporarily employed at UiT continuously for more than three years shall be deemed to be permanently employed, cf. the Civil Service Act § 9 (3).


According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 

In case of discrepancies between the Norwegian and the English version of this description, the Norwegian version takes precedence.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is an internationally leading broad-based university. Our vision is to be a driving force in the North. The Northern Sami term eallju, which means diligence, sets the tone for UiT's drive. Together with students, staff, and society at large, we will utilizeour location in Northern Norway and Sápmi, our academic breadth, and interdisciplinary advantages to shape the future.

UiT has approximately18,000 students, more than 4,000 employees, and is established across four main campuses and seven additional study locations in Northern Norway and on Svalbard. Our largest campuses are Tromsø, Alta ,Narvik, and Harstad. UiT has seven faculties, 40 departments and centers, and leading research environments in various fields. The university offers 269 study programs and focuses on
educational quality.

Academic freedom, scientific principles, and research ethics form the foundation of all UiT'sactivities. Participation, co-determination,
transparency, and sound processes will provide the basis for making wise and forward-looking decisions. Our students and staff will have the opportunity to develop their abilities and potential. Rooted in scientific integrity, we aim to be bold, engaged, and generous -closely connected to
academia, people, and contemporary developments

title: Junior Social Media Manager
description:
Vi er en av Europas raskest voksende plattformer for podkaster og lydbøker, og ser nå etter en Junior Social Media Manager til vårt voksende norske team.


Dette er rollen

Som vår nye Junior Social Media Manager hos Podimo Norge vil du holde våre sosiale kanaler engasjerende, underholdende og relevante. Dette er en rolle med fokus på innhold, produksjon og innsikt samt planlegging/publisering, trendovervåkning og community-engasjement på TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat og YouTube.

Du vil bli en del av et større team, og bidra til at innhold knyttet til lanseringer og kampanjer er i tråd med våre overordnede visjoner og mål.

Rollen er basert på vårt kontor i Oslo, og rapporterer direkte til Head of Commercial, Norge.


Dette vil du gjøre:

  • Redigere og tilpasse innhold til TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat og YouTube, basert på målgruppe, plattform og formål

  • Skrive tekst og justere ordlyd til innlegg og publisere på tvers av ulike kanaler

  • Produsere og formatere grafikk og maler i Canva, i tråd med merkevaren

  • Redigering og teksting av video i CapCut eller Premiere Pro

  • Overvåke kommentarer og meldinger, samt svare på enkle spørsmål og identifisere risikoer

  • Holde oversikt over trender og dele idéer teamet kan teste

  • Bidra med utkast og innholdsplaner til showlanseringer, sesonger og øvrige kampanjer

  • Samle og organisere resultater til faste team-gjennomganger, slik at vi stadig blir bedre


Dette er deg

Du vil trives hos Podimo hvis du er nysgjerrig, vennlig og handlekraftig. Du liker å jobbe tett med andre, dele ideer og lære raskt. Du tar ansvar for dine oppgaver, kommuniserer tydelig, og bryr deg om å lage innhold som føles autentisk og relevant for det norske publikummet.

  • Du har god forståelse av TikTok, Snapchat og Instagram (formater, trender og hva som fungerer).

  • Du er praktisk anlagt i Canva og liker å lage materiell og maler som ser bra ut.

  • Du har erfaring med videoredigeringsverktøy som Premiere Pro og CapCut.

  • Du er komfortabel med både innholdsproduksjon og community-engasjement, og er ivrig etter å lære og utvikle deg innen feltet.

  • Du har et datadrevet tankesett; kan lese grunnleggende analyser og bruke dem til å forbedre innhold.

  • Du behersker norsk og engelsk flytende.

Dette er oss

Podimo ble grunnlagt i København i 2019, og er en plattform for podkast- og lydbokelskere – og for skapere av lydinnhold. I appen vår har du en hel verden av podkaster og lydbøker lett tilgjengelig. Inntektsdelingsmodellen vår belønner skapere for å lage innhold folk faktisk vil høre på – enten de har et stort publikum eller en nisje.

Vi er en modig og nysgjerrig gjeng. Vi ser verdien i det hver enkelt bidrar med, og respekterer kollegaers ideer, meninger og tid. Vi jobber med integritet og ydmykhet, og tror vi blir best når vi er best sammen.

Vi brenner for å oppdage, skape og nerde over gode historier. Vi støtter skaperne våre tett og har stor respekt for prosessen deres når vi hjelper dem med å realisere de mest spennende ideene og historiene. Vi elsker det vi gjør – og viktigst av alt, vi har det gøy mens vi gjør det.

Vi ønsker å bygge et selskap og en kultur som speiler mangfoldet i verden vi lever i: mangfold av talent, stemmer, ideer og perspektiver. Det gjelder for merkevaren vår, innholdet vårt, skaperne våre og teamene våre.

Hos Podimo er du velkommen som den du er – uansett hvor du kommer fra, hvordan du ser ut, eller hvilke historier du har på øret.

We're a courageous and curious bunch. We recognize the value every individual brings, and respect our coworkers’ ideas, opinions, and time. You are welcome at Podimo for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what stories you have playing in your headphones.

title: Hardware Reliability Manager
description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale-up that has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionize livestock management, we need top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for an Hardware Reliability Manager for our Hardware Reliability Team.


Hardware Reliability Team

Our Hardware Reliability Team works with quality at both ends of our product life cycle. First: Validation of new livestock product designs, and second: monitoring and identifying failures on products in the field. These tasks are split into two disciplines: validation and failure analysis. As Hardware Reliability Manager, you will lead both of these teams. You will have a holistic view of the real-life conditions of our products, and ensure that these conditions are replicated in the lab. What can not be replicated in the lab has to be validated in the field on test farms around the globe. You will also monitor product performance, coordinate field investigations, and recommend mitigations of quality issues together with other stakeholders.


Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Shape the overall validation and quality strategy to match business goals and risk tolerance.

  • Lead the Hardware Reliability Team across new and existing products - setting priorities, allocating resources across projects, clearing roadblocks, and keeping the team on track.

  • Deliver clear, structured reporting on test progress, pass/fail metrics, and overall quality status.

  • Own end-to-end mechanical, electronics, and embedded validation plans from early product development through mass production and failure analysis.

  • Serve as a service point for internal stakeholders on validation and product quality.

  • Plan, conduct, and execute field testing under real-world operating conditions to validate product performance and catch issue trends early.

  • Monitor collar performance in the field after we release the product.

  • Coordinate validation activities delivered to the engineering and manufacturing teams.


We are looking for someone who has:

  • Bachelor or Master degree in engineering or another relevant degree

  • Experience with leading engineering activities within hardware and software

  • Experience with leading cross-functional teams at a technical level

  • Excellent analytical skills

  • Proven project management skills

  • Knowledge of international testing standards


We are looking for someone who is:

  • Motivated by working in an autonomous cross-functional team.

  • Thrives in a fast-paced development environment and can rapidly assess and prioritize critical issues.

  • Structured with the ability to bridge the gap between engineers and internal and external stakeholders.

  • Willing and able to travel across the Nordic region and internationally to meet with end-users and colleagues.

  • Comfortable working in an English-speaking environment.


About Nofence

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock.


What we bring to the table

At Nofence, we're not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We're a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth.

We believe in seeing results fast. As a manager, your work won't be lost in the bureaucratic shuffle. You'll witness the immediate impact of your contributions in real-time, influencing the evolution of our cutting-edge virtual fencing solution for livestock.

Join us, where ambition meets reality, and let's keep pushing the boundaries in the world of agri-tech!


About the Application

Please submit your application directly through this portal. In line with applicable data protection regulations and our data protection practices, we are unable to accept or process applications received by email. Applying through the portal also ensures your personal data is handled securely. We will evaluate candidates continuously and look forward to hearing from you! If you have any questions about Nofence or the application, please reach out to our VP Engineering Fabien Lepoutre at below email.

title: Join us in our mission to find new ways of protecting neurons from neurodegeneration!
description:
About the position

We are looking for a highly motivated researcher to join our team at the Department of Microbiology, at the Institute of Clinical Medicine at the University of Oslo. The position will be associated with the young research group “Mitonuclear DNA Maintenance and Transcriptional Control“ and will be working on the Research Council of Norway funded research project “MIND: Mitochondria-Initiated Neuronal Defense against Parkinson’s Disease”.

The position is for 2 years, from 1st of January 2027. Start date is negotiable.


More about the position

This position offers a unique opportunity to help uncover how DNA repair and mitochondrial transcription shape neuronal resilience in Parkinson’s disease. You will be the main experimental researcher of Work Package 2, where we develop and apply a human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) based model of midbrain dopaminergic neurons and midbrain organoids. Using patient-derived iPSCs carrying an alpha-synuclein (SNCA) triplication and isogenic controls, you will investigate how loss of DNA repair enzymes alters mitochondrial transcription, alpha-syn aggregation, and neuronal survival.

The project explores a new idea in Parkinson’s disease (PD): that certain types of DNA repair deficiency can activate protective mitochondrial and transcriptional responses in neurons, rather than only causing damage. We focus on the DNA base excision repair (BER) enzymes and how their loss affects mitochondrial function, α-synuclein aggregation, and survival of dopaminergic neurons.

You will be employed at the Department of Microbiology, which is jointly affiliated with the University of Oslo and Oslo University Hospital. The institute hosts a strong but very social environment, with access to advanced core facilities. The research section in the department has 15 research groups and 6 project groups (https://www.ous-research.no/microbiology/) working in various fields, including brain cancer, microbiology, epigenetics causes of disease, as well as groups focusing on bioinformatics.

The department will be located in the new life science building from January 2027 located near Forskningsparken with easy access by public transport (metro, tram, and bus), bicycle routes. You will work in an international, interdisciplinary environment with close collaboration across research groups in Oslo and with our partners at the University of Edinburgh.


Why we are seeking a researcher

Parkinson’s disease is one of the fastest-growing neurodegenerative disorders worldwide, yet current treatments are not disease-modifying. The MIND project challenges the traditional view that mitochondrial DNA damage is purely detrimental and explores how specific DNA repair defects may activate protective transcriptional programs in neurons. We are seeking a researcher who can take a leading experimental role in WP2: to establish and characterize our human iPSC-derived midbrain dopaminergic neuron model and to dissect how DNA repair-dependent changes in mitochondrial and nuclear transcription contribute to neuroprotection against alpha-syn–induced stress.

You will work closely with the principal investigator Dr. Nicola Pietro Montaldo, Prof. Hilde Loge Nilsen (UiO/OUH), and Prof. Tilo Kunath (University of Edinburgh).

If you are excited by the idea of discovering new neuronal self-defense programs, reshaping how we think about DNA repair and mitochondrial stress in Parkinson’s disease, and contributing to future therapeutic strategies, we encourage you to apply.


Your main tasks will be

Culture of iPSCs and Dopaminergic neurons:

  • Establish differentiation protocol for human neuronal cultures
  • Differentiate cryopreserved human iPSC into mature dopaminergic neurons (up to ~day 45)
  • Differentiate cryopreserved human iPSC-derived midbrain progenitors into mature dopaminergic neurons (up to ~day 45)
  • Validate neuronal identity and midbrain/dopaminergic markers using immunocytochemistry and RT-qPCR

Model Parkinson’s disease in vitro:

  • Work with a defined panel of iPSC lines: A patient line with SNCA (α-synuclein) triplication (high α-syn levels and aggregation) Isogenic SNCA-corrected controls (reduced or no α-syn expression).Lines with BER knockout on the SNCA triplication background
  • Measure α-syn and phospho-α-syn (pSer129) levels and aggregation (Western blot, ELISA, immunofluorescence)
  • Use seed amplification assays to investigate spreading of misfolded α-syn species
  • Assess mitochondrial function and stress responses
  • Measure mitochondrial respiration (OCR), ATP production and responses to mitochondrial stressors such as MPP+
  • Analyze mitochondrial DNA integrity and basic nuclear DNA damage responses
  • Contribute to transcriptional and data-driven analyses
  • Prepare samples for RNA-seq and other omics readouts
  • Work with the PI and collaborators on basic analysis and interpretation of differential gene expression and pathway changes.

Functional readouts of neuronal health:

  •  Use microelectrode array (MEA) recordings (Maestro Pro Platform) to monitor neuronal network activity and relate this to α-syn load and mitochondrial status.

What you will gain:

  • Hands-on experience with human iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons and state-of-the-art PD models
  • Training in mitochondrial biology, DNA repair, and transcriptional regulation in neurons
  • Access to advanced infrastructure (imaging, MEA, sequencing, high-performance computing)
  • Close collaboration with leading groups in DNA repair (Nilsen), PD/iPSC modeling (Kunath), and a growing national BER network (BER Norway)
  • Opportunities to co-author publications and present your work at national and international meetings.

What skills are important in this role?

 Required qualifications:

  • A PhD (or equivalent) in molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, neuroscience, biotechnology, or a closely related field
  • Documented experience with mammalian cell culture and standard sterile techniques, including primary cells, neuronal progenitor cells, and/or 3D/organoid cultures
  • Solid competence in core molecular and cell biology methods, such as: DNA / RNA extraction, PCR / qPCR / RT-qPCR, Western blotting, and immunohistochemistry / immunocytochemistry / immunofluorescence with associated fluorescence microscopy
  • Experience with multicolor flow cytometry and functional cellular or immune assays
  • Hands-on experience preparing high-quality samples for next-generation sequencing (NGS), ideally including single-cell or single-nucleus RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq / snRNA-seq) from complex tissues, together with standard quality-control metrics (e.g. Qubit, TapeStation)
  • Experience coordinating wet-lab work with bioinformatics and sequencing core facilities, and developing, optimizing, and documenting laboratory workflows
  • Experience with human iPSC-derived models, midbrain organoids, and/or neuronal differentiation (dopaminergic or other CNS lineages preferred
  • Good understanding of experimental design, protocol development and optimization, data documentation, reproducibility, and basic statistical analysis
  • Good written and oral communication skills in English
  • Ability to work independently at the bench while coordinating effectively with principal investigators, bioinformaticians, core facilities, and collaborators.

Desired qualifications:
It is an advantage if you have one or more of the following:

  • Background in DNA repair, transcription, or chromatin biology
  • Experience supervising or training junior researchers or students
  • Experience with neurodegeneration models, especially:
    •  Parkinson’s disease
    • α-synuclein biology (expression, aggregation, or toxicity assays)   
  • Experience with mitochondrial biology, e.g.: 
    • Measuring oxygen consumption rate (OCR) or related metabolic assays
    • Working with mitochondrial toxins
  • Familiarity with bioinformatics / scripting (R, Python, or similar)
  • Microelectrode array (MEA) or other electrophysiological recordings (an advantage, not a requirement)
  • Flexibility to work on weekends when necessary to support cell culture work.

Meeting the required criteria is essential; the desired qualifications and personal skills will be used to distinguish between otherwise well-qualified candidates.


Personal skills 

In this role, you should:

  • Be curious, motivated, and scientifically engaged, with a strong interest in neurodegeneration and molecular mechanisms
  • Work systematically and reliably, with attention to detail and reproducibility
  • Be proactive in troubleshooting and optimizing protocols
  • Communicate clearly and openly, sharing results and challenges with the team
  • Enjoy working in an interdisciplinary and international environment and collaborating across groups and institute.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer / We can offer you / Why should you choose us?

  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.

  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.

  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.

Application

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV), including a dedicated description of relevant skills, qualifications, and competencies that demonstrate how the applicant meets the requirements of this call

title: Researcher on Global Maternal Health
description:
About the position 

Applications are invited for a three-year researcher position (80%) at the Institute of Health and Society as part of a Global Health research project, "Preventing Severe Hypertensive Adverse Events in Pregnancy and Childbirth" (PRESHA). The position is part of a new Norwegian Research Council-funded project (Research Projects for Scientific Renewal – Global Health) led by Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg at the University of Oslo. Intended starting date for the position is Autumn 2026. 

The appointment is a part-time 80% position and is made for a period of up to three years. The researcher will work closely with Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg.

The candidate is welcome to participate in building a long-term research program with particular emphasis on thematic areas fitting within a broader perspective on global women’s health across the life course.


More about the project

The PRESHA project is an ambitious project that aims to prevent maternal and perinatal death and disability due to pre-eclampsia in low-resource settings through improved prediction, prevention and clinical management. The project takes place in Mwanza, Tanzania. The official project period is from 2023-2028. The project partners are from Norway, Tanzania and the Netherlands. The project is unique in that it combines the introduction of biomarker PlGF/Sflt-1 for pre-eclampsia prediction with strengthening the organization of existing care processes. We will use a combination of disciplines and innovative methodological approaches to explore existing implementation challenges and co-create, implement and evaluate a package of interventions for prevention and management of pre-eclampsia that is adapted and relevant to the Tanzanian context.

For more information about the project, or further inquiries about the position please contact Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg.


Your main tasks will be: 

The researcher will have a central role in the implementation phase of PRESHA, while also conducting analyses of cohort data. Key responsibilities include:

Research position

  • Lead the day-to-day coordination of the implementation phase in close collaboration with partners in Tanzania, the Netherlands and Norway.
  • Organize and support implementation of the PRESHA quality-of-care package (PRESHA-QoC), including training, supervision, co-creation workshops and audit cycles.
  • Coordinate the stepped-wedge implementation of biomarker-based risk prediction (PRESHA‑TRIAL) across participating facilities.
  • Oversee timelines, documentation, reporting, ethics renewals and regulatory requirements related to the implementation phase.
  • Facilitate communication between clinical teams, research staff, community partners and the international study group.
  • Contribute to data quality assurance, protocol adherence and monitoring of implementation processes.
  • Analyze cohort data related to the social determinants of health and their impact on outcomes related to hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
  • Lead and co-author scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Contribute to methodological innovation in implementation research.
  • Work closely with the PI and team on developing and writing research grant applications (e.g. for project extension, new related studies).

Engage in dissemination, policy briefs and knowledge translation activities towards Tanzanian and international stakeholders.


Qualification requirements 

Qualification requirements

  • A PhD (or equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree) in global health, public health, epidemiology, medical sciences, social sciences with strong health focus, or a closely related field. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved.
  • Documented experience with mixed-methods research (both quantitative and qualitative).
  • Strong skills in quantitative analysis, preferably including:
    • cohort or longitudinal data analysis
    • regression modelling
    • handling of routine health dataexperience with statistical software (e.g. Stata, R, or similar).
  • Experience with qualitative methods (e.g. interviews, focus groups, observations) in health research.
  • Demonstrated interest in or experience with implementation research, quality improvement or health systems research.
  • Familiarity with maternal health, hypertensive disorders in pregnancy, or related fields in global women’s health.
  • Familiarity with the thematic areas of the project and the complexity of maternal health is required.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English is required.

Desired qualifications
