title: Miljøarbeider 100% ved Tjønnen dagsenter og timeavlastning
description:
Tjønnen Dagsenter og timeavlastning har ledig en 100 % fast stilling som miljøarbeider. Er du engasjert, faglig dyktig og ønsker å bidra til en aktiv og meningsfull hverdag for mennesker med utviklingshemming? Da ønsker vi deg med på laget!

Tjønnen Dagsenter har høy kompetanse på tilrettelegging av aktiviteter for personer med utviklingshemming og ulike bistandsbehov. Vår visjon er «Aktiv i fellesskap», og vi legger vekt på kunnskap, kreativitet, kvalitet og mestring i møte med våre tjenestemottakere.

Som miljøarbeider hos oss blir du en del av et faglig sterkt og inkluderende team. Du vil få en variert arbeidshverdag med miljøarbeid, tilrettelegging av aktiviteter, oppfølging av tjenestemottakere og samarbeid med kollegaer, pårørende og andre samarbeidspartnere.

Vi har særlig fokus på forebygging og håndtering av utfordrende atferd, og arbeider aktivt med MAP (Møte med aggresjonsproblematikk) og Helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven kapittel 9.

Stillingen er knyttet både til dagsenteret og timeavlastningen.

Dagsenteret ligger sentralt på Melkeplassen med kort avstand til kollektivtransport og har gode parkeringsmuligheter. Vi holder til i lyse og moderne lokaler som er godt tilrettelagt for brukergruppen.

Vi søker deg som:

  • har relevant utdanning og erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker med utviklingshemming
  • har engasjement for mennesker med ulike bistandsbehov
  • trives med å jobbe i team
  • er trygg, omsorgsfull og løsningsorientert
  • ønsker å bidra til et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

Velkommen som søker til Tjønnen Dagsenter og timeavlastning!


    Arbeidsoppgaver
    • Leder delegerer ansvarsområder til miljøarbeidere/ helsefagarbeidere i henhold stillingsinnehavers formelle kompetanse og erfaring.
    • Må tilegne seg kunnskap innen fagområdet og holde seg oppdatert på fag, lov- og avtaleverk
    • Bidra til at ressursene innen etatens tjenester benyttes på en fleksibel og effektiv måte.
    • Bidra til å fremme et godt faglig innhold i tjenesten og arbeide målbevisst for å nå oppsatte mål.
    • Kvalitetssikre en god og helhetlig tjenesteomsorg.
    • Bidra til å fremme et godt arbeidsmiljø og omdømme ved å gi god service til pårørende, tjenestemottakere og medarbeidere.
    • Oppfølging av vedtak etter Helse og omsorgstjenestelovens kap. 9 og Pasient og brukerrettighetslovens kap. 4A.
    • Veiledning av kollegaer, samarbeidspartnere og lærlinger.
    • Tverrfaglig samarbeid med interne og eksterne aktører.
    • Delta i kvalitetsarbeid, herunder kontakt med pårørende, deltakelse i ansvarsgrupper, oppfølging av individuelle planer og delta i planlegging og oppfølging av konkrete handlingsplaner i tråd med overordnede styringsmål.
    • Bistå beboerne i målrettet miljøarbeid i henhold til vedtak
    • Bidra til daglig drift av praktiske gjøremål
    • Andre delegerte arbeidsoppgaver fra leder
    Kvalifikasjoner
    • Fagbrev, utdanning og autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider, hjelpepleier, omsorgsarbeider barne- og ungdomsarbeider eller tilsvarende.
    • Personer utenfor Skandinavia må dokumentere språkferdigheter på B2-nivå i norsk skriftlig og muntlig igjennom bestått B2 prøve i norsk
    • Må ha god skriftlig og muntlig formidlingsevne.
    • Må ha god forståelse og kunnskap om Helse og omsorgstjenesteloven kap. 9 og Pasient og brukerrettighetslovens kap. 4A.
    • Må ha god forståelse og kunnskap om dataverktøy ifm rapportering, avvikshåndtering, legemiddelhåndtering, handlingsplaner mm.
    • Personlig egnethet og interesse for tjenesten
    • Må har sertifikat, klasse B
    • Ha gyldig arbeids- og oppholdstillatelse
    • Politiattest må fremvises ved ansettelse
    Personlige egenskaper
    • Må ha evne og vilje til å sette seg inn i gjeldende lovverk for etatens tjenesteområde
    • Må være fleksibel, løsningsorientert, serviceinnstilt og god til å samhandle
    • Må ha høy etisk bevissthet og evne til kritisk refleksjon.
    • Må være lojal mot beslutninger som treffes
    • Må ha gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsferdigheter
    • Evne til å tenke og handle strategisk og analytisk
    • Etterleve de verdier og holdninger som er nedfelt i kommunens arbeidsgiverpolitikk og etiske standard, samt handle i tråd med Bergen kommunes verdier: kompetent, åpen, pålitelig og samfunnsengasjert.
    • Være utviklingsorientert og opptatt av god tjenestekvalitet.
    • Ha en åpen og inkluderende væremåte, være samarbeidsvillig og lærevillig.
    Vi tilbyr
    • Et spennende faglig miljø
    • En engasjert personalgruppe som er gode relasjonsbyggere og med stor lagånd.
    • Gjennomsnittlig 37,5 timers arbeidsuke, arbeid knyttet til timeavlastning er på kveld og helg. 
    • En organisasjon i utvikling og vekst.
    • Opplæring og mentorprogram
    • Stor variasjon i brukergruppe og oppgaver- rullering av oppgaver.
    • Godt utstyrt med hjelpemidler
    • Lett tilgang med kollektiv transport.
    • God pensjonsordning, boliglånsordning og ulykkes- og gruppelivsforsikring
    • Lønn ihht. stillingsregulativ som miljøarbeider er for tiden 475.300 - 556.100 (avhengig av ansiennitet)
    • Mulighet for medlemskap i bedriftsidrettslag innenfor flere idrettsgrener.
    KontaktinformasjonAndre Sandvik Shepherd, Avdelingsleder, Andrea.Shepherd@Bergen.kommune.no
    Linda Holst, Fagleder enhet for avlastning og dagsenter, 40807437, linda.holst@bergen.kommune.no

    Om arbeidsgiveren:

    Bergen kommune søker motiverte medarbeidere som er kompetente, åpne, pålitelige og samfunnsengasjerte. Kvalitet i tjenestene skapes gjennom godt arbeidsmiljø og mangfold blant ansatte.

title: Har du godt humør og lyst til å hjelpe? Da vil jeg gjerne høre fra deg!
description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Tilkallingsvikar
⏰ Arbeidstid: Dag, kveld og helg

Heisann! 😊

Jeg er en positiv og omgjengelig dame i 60-årene som bor i naturskjønne Odda sammen med mannen min og vår kosete katt. Nå er jeg på jakt etter noen dyktige og hjertevarme assistenter med godt humør til mitt BPA-team!

Jeg har MS, som betyr at jeg trenger litt ekstra bistand i hverdagen for å leve livet slik jeg ønsker. Selv om jeg sitter i rullestol, er jeg fortsatt aktiv og forflytter meg godt på egen hånd. Jeg jobber en dag i uken, noe som gir meg stor glede og mening.

Jeg er interessert i håndarbeid, som strikking, og liker å se på gode filmer og serier. Jeg setter stor pris på en god samtale over en kopp kaffe. Jeg liker musikk og skulle gjerne gått på konsert av og til.

Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstid

Jeg søker nå etter en tilkallingsvikar som kan stille opp ved ferieavvikling, sykdom eller annet fravær.

Arbeidet foregår hovedsakelig på dagtid, men det kan også være aktuelt med vakter på ettermiddag, kveld og i helg.

Typiske vakttider kan være:

  • Dagvakter: kl. 07:00-15:00 eller kl. 08:00-15:00

  • Fredager: kl. 07:00-09:00

  • Helgevakter: etter avtale

Vær oppmerksom på at dette kun er eksempler på når vakter kan forekomme, og at arbeidstid vil variere etter behov.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som min assistent vil du få varierte arbeidsoppgaver - ingen dag vil være helt lik! Jeg trenger hjelp med praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet, som..

  • Husarbeid og stell av hagen

  • Rengjøring av hjelpemidler

  • Litt snømåking om vinteren

  • Matlaging, baking og handling

  • Trening

  • Kjøring til og fra sosiale aktiviteter og jobb

Hvem er du?

Jeg ser etter noen med godt humør, som er positiv, fleksibel og gjerne har noen av de samme interessene som meg. Om du i tillegg er selvstendig og kan ta initiativ på dager hvor jeg ikke er i toppform, vil det være et stort pluss.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Gode norskkunnskaper

  • Plettfri politiattest

  • Personlig egnethet og kjemi vektlegges

  • Ønskelig med gode datakunnskaper

  • Ikke allergisk mot katt

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper jeg at du sender inn en søknad! Jeg gleder meg til å bli kjent med deg.

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Eva Caroline Halvorsen på epost: eva.halvorsen@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

title: Vernepleier
description:
Avdeling Eplehagen har som overordnet mål å bidra til at innbyggerne vi bistår skal oppleve mestring i egen hverdag gjennom å fokusere på den enkelte innbyggers ressurser. Ved å innarbeide helsefremmende og habiliterende/ rehabiliterende elementer  i de tiltak som iverksettes, ønsker vi å bidra til opplevd god helse samt å forsøke å bidra til en god hverdag.
Avdeling Eplehagen inngår i Levanger kommune sin satsning med "Kommunalt ambulerende team rus og psykisk helse".  Avdelingen bidrar med å styrke kapasiteten i dette arbeidet. Kommuneorganisasjonen bruker samskaping og relasjonell velferd som premiss for drift og utvikling av kommunens  tjenester og lokalsamfunn. 
Vi søker personell som sammen med gode medarbeidere vil være med å utvikle avdelingen i tråd med Levanger kommune sine målsettinger, forpliktelser og verdigrunnlag. Som ansatt i vår avdeling vil du møte både utfordringer og muligheter. 

ArbeidsoppgaverAvdeling Eplehagen yter tjenester til innbyggere med omfattende bistandsbehov gjennom hele døgnet, samt innbyggere med behov for oppfølging og veiledning på enkeltområder. En strategi for å lykkes i tjenesten er å legge vekt på relasjonell tilnærming og å forsøke å utvikle relasjonell kapasitet mellom avdelinger og nærmiljø.
Stillingen inngår i avdelingens turnus med arbeid på dag, kveld og helg. Arbeidet innebærer å vurdere og iverksette gode miljøterapeutiske tiltak hos enkeltinnbygger gjennom å utøve miljøarbeid - praktisk bistand og helsehjelp.
Det vektlegges samarbeid med innbygger, pårørende og andre aktører, slik som andre avdelinger i kommunen samt med andrelinjetjenesten. Målsettingen er å skape trivsel, tillit og trygghet med fokus på egen mestring.
Avdelingen bistår voksne innbyggere som kan ha utfordringer i forhold til psykiatri, rus/avhengighetsproblematikk, utviklingshemming, eller andre utfordringer knyttet til egen livsmestring.
Vernepleier ivaretar kontroll av multidoser, produksjon og kontroll av dosetter for innbyggere som mottar bistand til legemiddeladministrasjon. En vil også ha veilereansvar overfor kollega og studenter samt lede arbeidslaget i det daglige i form av "ansvarsvakt".Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisasjon som vernepleier. 
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Gode datakunnskaper
  • God norsk muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ønsker at du 

  • har tverrfaglig fokus
  • har evne til å arbeide i krevende situasjoner i tett samarbeid med andre
  • er fleksibel, endringsvillig, engasjert og løsningsfokusert
  • har evne til å arbeide kunnskapsbasert
  • har gode samhandlings- og kommunikasjonsevner

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Levanger er vekstkommunen midt i Trøndelag! Levanger har det meste; nærhet til fjell og fjord, en fredet og idyllisk trehusby, kort veg til Trondheim og til internasjonal flyplass. Levanger er en av landets største landbrukskommuner og har et mangfoldig næringsliv, samt en sterk offentlig sektor. Sykehuset Levanger, Nord universitet og NTNU HUNT forskningssenter er viktig både for kommunen, regionen og Trøndelag fylke. Sammen med våre 20.807 innbyggere (pr. 4.kvartal 2025) arbeider vi stadig med å utvikle bærekraftige lokalsamfunn og god folkehelse, samt skole-, barnehage- og omsorgstjenester med høy kvalitet.

 

I Levanger kommune ønsker vi mangfold og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne eller kulturell bakgrunn.

Arbeidstakere ansettes i kommunen på de vilkår som følger av lovbestemmelser, reglement og gjeldende tariffavtaler. De første 6 måneder er prøvetid.
Svært gode pensjonsordninger, det trekkes 2 % av lønn til pensjonsordning. Søkere som vil påberope seg fortrinnsrett må angi dette i søknaden. 

Det må påregnes bruk av privat telefon for sikkerhetsløsninger, dette medfører ikke kostnader for den ansatte.

Pass eller nasjonalt ID kort må fremvises før tilgang til fagsystem kan gis.

For stillinger med krav om politiattest er det et vilkår for å tiltre stillingen at tilfredsstillende politiattest framlegges.

Det gjøres oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkerne kan bli offentliggjort selv om søker har bedt om å få sitt navn m. v. unntatt fra offentlig søkerliste. Søkere som ikke får sin anmodning om å bli unntatt offentlighet tatt til følge, får varsel om dette.

title: Frokost og kjøkken hjelp
description:

  • aldri blir lei av å lage vaffelrøre😉

Ta og gjerne kontakt med Geir "verten sjøl" på telefon 91629122 om du vurderer stillingen, og om det er noe du lurer på.

- planowanie i nadzorowanie przeglądów, konserwacji, remontów oraz napraw maszyn i urządzeń,
- organizowanie działań prewencyjnego utrzymania ruchu oraz reagowanie na awarie i przestoje produkcyjne,
- nadzór nad urządzeniami technologicznymi i transportowymi, w tym suwnicami, podnośnikami, wózkami widłowymi, sprężarkami oraz innymi urządzeniami wykorzystywanymi na terenie zakładu,

- koordynacja prac związanych z modernizacją i rozbudową infrastruktury technicznej zakładu,
- nadzór nad utrzymaniem w należytym stanie technicznym bocznicy kolejowej, torów, rozjazdów oraz infrastruktury kolejowej,
- koordynowanie przeglądów, napraw i prac utrzymaniowych na bocznicy kolejowej,
- współpraca z działami produkcji, technologii, jakości, BHP, magazynem oraz administracją,
- współpraca z firmami zewnętrznymi, serwisami i podwykonawcami realizującymi prace techniczne,
- planowanie budżetu Działu Utrzymania Ruchu oraz nadzór nad kosztami utrzymania infrastruktury i parku maszynowego,
- planowanie zakupów części zamiennych, materiałów eksploatacyjnych, narzędzi i wyposażenia technicznego,
- analiza przyczyn awarii oraz wdrażanie działań mających na celu ograniczenie przestojów,
- prowadzenie i nadzór nad dokumentacją techniczną, przeglądami oraz naprawami urządzeń,

title: Recruiter & Employee Support (m/f/d) (Recruiter/in)
description:
Do you like working with people, take on responsibility and don't just want to work through tasks, but actively shape them?

For our team at the Olszyna site, we are looking for a committed personality who will actively accompany recruiting and employee support and develop it together with us.

**Your tasks**

•    Recruiting of employees, especially drivers, from the first contact to the successful start

•    Support of our employees and drivers in the ongoing employment relationship

•    Intensive support of new employees during the onboarding and hypercare phase

•    Active contact with employees, even in the event of absences and as part of the return to everyday work

•    Contact person for our German and Polish-speaking employees

•    Close cooperation and coordination with operations, scheduling and other internal interfaces

•    Maintenance and structured tracking of recruiting and employee data

•    Active participation in the further development of our recruiting and support processes

Your development perspective

With us, you will have the opportunity to develop professionally, take on responsibility and grow into a coordinating role in the future.

We are looking for people who are not just looking for a job, but who want to build something together with us.

•    Spoken and written German and Polish, other languages are a plus

•    Confident handling of MS Office, especially Excel, Outlook and Teams

•    Strong independence and initiative

•    Very good organization and structured way of working

•    Strong communication skills and enjoyment of dealing with different people

•    Decision-making skills and willingness to take responsibility

•    Hands-on mentality, flexibility and solution-oriented thinking

•    Energy, willingness to learn and desire to actively drive things forward

•    Mobility and reliable accessibility of our location in Olszyna

•    Class B driving licence is an advantage

**Your background**

Your professional or educational background is not decisive for us. Experience in recruiting, employee support, personnel services or logistics is an advantage, but not a must.

What counts most for us is your personality, motivation, way of working and your potential.

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Project Manager / Delivery Assurance for SAP and Service Now (f/m/d)

Full or part time

At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 18,500 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. With SAP at our core and a powerful ecosystem of partners like Microsoft and ServiceNow, we continuously improve solutions and AI-driven technology to make them work for companies – and for their people.

We are part of NTT DATA, a $30+ billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work.

With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network.

**Make this the place where you grow

**Location: **Germany, Poland, Bulgaria or Romania

What makes us special:

We have a holistic view of the individual needs of our employees. Here (https://nttdata-solutions.com/de/karriere/benefits/)  you can find a detailed overview of our wide variety of benefits during different life phases.

■ Flexible working hours and locations: workation, mobile working, part-time models, sabbaticals, etc.

■ Your further development by plan: topic-specific induction, targeted career development based on career models, programs and your own academy

■ Family first: e.g. daycare allowance, paid maternity leave and paternity network

■ SAP Platinum Partnership: strong SAP partnership, large knowledge network, and SAP Learning Hub and certification opportunities.

■ We take care: e.g. 25% subsidy for company pension plan, company health management and cooperation with fitness providers

■ We help you get from A to B: company car (depending on your role), discount on public transport and bicycle leasing via JobRad®.

Do you love challenges?

As Project / Delivery Assurance Manager for SAP and ServiceNow Projects and Managed Services, you will be responsible for:

■ Conducting risk and quality assessments for new and existing large customer engagements, ensuring SAP and ServiceNow-specific risks are addressed.

■ Providing feedback on the Deal Governance process to ensure that new projects and services meet agreed standards and quality expectations.

■ Supporting Red/Amber projects by developing and executing "Back to Green" action plans, including internal management reporting.

■ Managing customer escalations: leading top management customer escalations, supporting executive management in the de-escalation process, addressing root causes, and restoring customer confidence.

■ Defining the necessary quality checks for SAP and ServiceNow projects and services to ensure quality, speed and profitability

Convince us with your potential!

■ Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field

Several years of work experience in Delivery Assurance, Project and/or Services Management proves your:

■ Expertise in SAP and ServiceNow within complex enterprise environments

■ Delivery assurance skills, supported by certification (e.g. Six Sigma)

■ Strong project/service management and leadership abilities

■ Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach

■ Excellent communication and collaboration skills with technical and business stakeholders

■ Commitment to continuous improvement, attention to detail, and adaptability under pressure

■ Knowledge of IT standards and regulations (ISO 9001, CMMI, GDPR)

■ Proficiency in written and spoken English and German

Do you have questions?

title: Front Office Supervisor  (Empfangschef/in (Hotel))
description:
Front Office Supervisor

Opis firmy

Tworzymy wyjątkowe miejsce dla naszych Gości dzięki wspólnej pasji do nowoczesnego designu i wysokiej jakości obsługi.

Już ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast.

Dołącz do naszego zespołu w Gdańsku!

Odkryj możliwości pracy w miejscu, gdzie liczy się pasja, zaangażowanie i chęć rozwoju!

Opis oferty pracy

Twoim priorytetem będzie troska o dobre samopoczucie Gości i Pracowników!

Twoje obowiązki będą obejmować również:

- Meldowanie Gości, sprawdzanie listy przyjazdów oraz innych raportów
- Zapewnienie profesjonalnej, najwyższej jakości obsługi
- Monitorowanie oraz reagowanie na opinie Gości

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

Czy posiadasz wyjątkową osobowość oraz doskonałe umiejętności z zakresu gościnności?

Jeśli tak, to idealnie będziesz pasować na to stanowisko! Nasze dodatkowe wymagania:

- Doświadczenie zawodowe w branży hotelarskiej
- Doskonałe wyczucie jakości i obsługi
- Otwartość, komunikatywność oraz bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (w mowie i piśmie)
- Umiejętność pracy w zespole i gotowość do udzielania pomocy we wszystkich działach – wyniki osiąga się dzięki współpracy!
- Praca w godzinach porannych, popołudniowych i/lub nocnych

umiejętności prawidłowego prowadzenia gospodarstwa domowego
4) udzielanie pomocy rodzinom w rozwiązywaniu problemów socjalnych.

title: Job i Portugal med firmabolig - Kunderådgiver for Audi - Opstart den 1. november - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi. Vi har opstart den 1. november med mulighed for firmabolig.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger en kunderådgiver til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security - ManageEngine, ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have long years of experience ( 5 + ) with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.- You have 3-5 years of experience with ManageEngine or similar technologies.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce.
At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.
As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About UsTo solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger en kunderådgiver til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

Er du interesseret? Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com for at høre mere, vi vender retur indenfor 24 timer.

title: Assistant Manager für Reddit in Lissabon | Sales & Operations (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
Für ein internationales Team im Reddit Project suchen wir einen erfahrenen Assistant Manager , der mehrere Operations Supervisors führt, Performance vorantreibt und sein Team kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt.

Hier geht es nicht nur darum, KPIs im Blick zu behalten. Du entwickelst Führungskräfte, löst Herausforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass dein Bereich seine Ziele erreicht.

Dein neuer Job auf einen Blick

Position:  Assistant Manager – Reddit
️ Sprache:  Englisch (mind. C1)
Bereich:  Sales / Digital Marketing
Arbeitszeiten:  Montag bis Freitag, 08:00–17:00 Uhr
Arbeitsmodell:  Hybrid
Bonus:  Bis zu €2.000

Deine Aufgaben

Als Assistant Manager führst und entwickelst du die Operations Supervisors und trägst Verantwortung für die Performance deines Bereichs.

- Du führst und entwickelst deine Operations Supervisors.
- Du coachst deine Führungskräfte und unterstützt sie dabei, ihr volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen.
- Du überwachst relevante KPIs und setzt ambitionierte Performance-Ziele.
- Du entwickelst Maßnahmen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Ergebnisse.
- Du übernimmst eskalierte Kundenfälle und findest schnelle, professionelle Lösungen.
- Du erkennst Herausforderungen und Chancen frühzeitig und entwickelst proaktiv Lösungen.

Das bringst du mit

Leadership-Erfahrung:  Du hast bereits nachweislich Teams geführt – das ist für diese Position Voraussetzung.  Sales / Digital Marketing:  Du bringst praktische Erfahrung aus Sales und/oder Digital Marketing mit.  Englisch:  Du sprichst Englisch mindestens auf C1-Niveau.  Performance-Mindset:  Du arbeitest ergebnisorientiert und hast gleichzeitig einen starken Kundenfokus.  Problemlösung:  Du gehst Herausforderungen strukturiert und lösungsorientiert an.  Kommunikation & EQ:  Du kommunizierst klar, kannst dich schnell auf unterschiedliche Situationen einstellen und bringst ein hohes Maß an emotionaler Intelligenz mit.

Was dich erwartet

Apartment-Option für Relocater:  Du kannst zwischen einem Vergütungspaket mit Unterkunft  oder einem höheren Gehalt ohne Unterkunft  wählen.  Attraktives Vergütungspaket:  Fixgehalt plus Bonusmöglichkeiten von bis zu €2.000.  Internationales Projekt:  Arbeite in einem spannenden internationalen Umfeld rund um Reddit.  Karriere & Entwicklung:  Übernimm Verantwortung, entwickle dein Team weiter und baue deine Leadership-Erfahrung aus. ️ Planbare Arbeitszeiten:  Montag bis Freitag von 08:00 bis 17:00 Uhr.

Bereit für deinen nächsten Leadership-Schritt?

Du hast bereits Führungserfahrung, kennst Sales oder Digital Marketing und möchtest mehr Verantwortung in einem internationalen Projekt übernehmen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Apartment-Option für Relocater: Du kannst zwischen einem Vergütungspaket mit Unterkunft oder einem höheren Gehalt ohne Unterkunft wählen.
Attraktives Vergütungspaket: Fixgehalt plus Bonusmöglichkeiten von bis zu €2.000.

Karriere & Entwicklung: Übernimm Verantwortung, entwickle dein Team weiter und baue deine Leadership-Erfahrung aus.
️ Planbare Arbeitszeiten: Montag bis Freitag von 08:00 bis 17:00 Uhr.


Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?


Du kennst Sales, kannst Menschen führen und möchtest deine Erfahrung in einem internationalen Digital-Advertising-Projekt einbringen?
Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security - ManageEngine, ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have long years of experience ( 5 + ) with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.- You have 3-5 years of experience with ManageEngine or similar technologies.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce.
At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.
As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About UsTo solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?

title: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
description:
As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

description:
Product Manager – Managed Cloud Services (f/m/d)


Full or part time

At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 18,500 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. With SAP at our core and a powerful ecosystem of partners like Microsoft and ServiceNow, we continuously improve solutions and AI-driven technology to make them work for companies – and for their people.

We are part of NTT DATA, a $30+ billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work.

With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network.

**Make this the place where you grow.

**Location: **Germany, Romania or Bulgaria

What makes us special:

We have a holistic view of the individual needs of our employees. Here (https://nttdata-solutions.com/de/karriere/benefits/)  you can find a detailed overview of our wide variety of benefits during different life phases.

■ Flexible working hours and locations: workation, mobile working, part-time models, sabbaticals, etc.

■ Your further development by plan: topic-specific induction, targeted career development based on career models, programs and your own academy

■ Family first: e.g. daycare allowance, paid maternity leave and paternity network

■ SAP Platinum Partnership: strong SAP partnership, large knowledge network, and SAP Learning Hub and certification opportunities.

■ We take care: e.g. 25% subsidy for company pension plan, company health management and cooperation with fitness providers

■ We help you get from A to B: company car (depending on your role), discount on public transport and bicycle leasing via JobRad®.



Do you love challenges?

■ In your role, you will be responsible for identifying and evaluating market trends and new technologies for IaaS and Paas Services for our SAP customer base (Managed Cloud Services).

■ You will play an active role in creating managed services portfolio roadmaps.

■ Your tasks will also include designing new global managed cloud portfolio services in terms of content, offerings, and cost calculation.

■ You will take on end-to-end service offer management (go-to-market, portfolio, delivery) with a focus on portfolio lifecycle management and support the sales and presales teams with your expertise.

■ You will maintain key product documentation (SOWs, costing, pricing, sales enablement) in collaboration with Presales & Bid Management

■ Your responsibilities also include providing internal teams with product knowledge and conducting enablement sessions to ensure readiness for market launch.

■ Finally, you will be responsible for preparing decision-making templates for senior/executive management.

Convince us with your potential!

■ You have successfully completed a degree in (business) information technology, economics or a comparable qualification.

■ You have at least 3-5 years of professional experience in SAP technology consulting, operations and support.

■ You already have comprehensive knowledge of Hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, GCP), Infrastructure-as-a-Service or Platform-as-a-Service as well as SAP products and technology (S/4HANA, SAP Netweaver, SAP ECC).

■ Knowledge of automation and AI is an advantage.

■ You are fluent in written and spoken English and/or German.

■ Occasional travel, including (inter)nationally, is not a challenge for you.

■ You are characterized by customer-oriented thinking and acting, combined with strong communication and presentation skills and a confident manner. A team-oriented approach to work – including in an international environment – rounds off your profile.

Do you have questions?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents stating your earliest start date.

description:
Zabezpečovať realizáciu poradenských aktivít v školách prezenčným, alebo dištančným spôsobom: - realizovať individuálne poradenstvo pre pedagogických zamestnancov (PZ), vedúcich pedagogických zamestnancov (VPZ), - realizovať návštevy hodín PZ a VPZ s cieľom zvýšenia kvality výchovno-vzdelávacieho procesu, - poskytovať im spätnú väzbu na pozorované edukačné aktivity, - navrhovať odporúčania na zvýšenie kvality výchovno-vzdelávacieho procesu, - identifikovať a diagnostikovať problémy PZ a VPZ, - podporovať PZ a VPZ pri tvorbe návrhov možných riešení ich problémov, - pomáhať im pri aplikácii týchto riešení vo výchovno-vzdelávacom procese v triede a práci so žiakmi, - vedieť poskytovať poradenstvo v niektorých z uvedených oblastí: vzdelávacie programy (ŠVP, ŠkVP), hodnotenie vzdelávacích výsledkov žiakov, vzdelávací proces a vyučovací štýl učiteľa, personalizácia vyučovania a inkluzívne vzdelávanie, digitalizácia. Realizovať skupinové formy rozvoja spôsobilosti PZ a VPZ vo vyššie uvedených oblastiach - formou poldňových/celodňových workshopov, - formou organizovania učiacich sa skupín/organizácie prednášok a diskusií, Monitorovať potreby PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl v regióne - formou dotazníkov pre PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl a školských zariadení, - formou individuálnych rozhovorov s PZ, VPZ a riaditeľmi škôl a školských zariadení. Vykonávať administratívne úlohy spojené s pracovným miestom: - vyplnenie pracovného výkazu, - vedenie dokumentácie o činnostiach, - iné podľa potreby EduHubu. Vykonávať pracovné činnosti podľa potreby a pokynov zamestnávateľa.
Výhody:- flexibilný úväzok 40 – 100 percent , - organizácia času podľa dohody min. 2 dni v týždni, súvisle 7,5 h , - zaujímavá pracovná príležitosť v oblasti školstva na nepedagogickej pozícii, - flexibilita. Ak ešte nemáte absolvované vzdelávanie v mentoringu alebo koučingu 50 h , zabezpečíme a uhradíme ho za vás. Hľadáme predovšetkým ľudí, ktorí sú ochotní vydať sa na cestu rozvoja škôl vo svojom regióne.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

Solid practical experience working with Linux operating systems, including Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or similar distributions.
Confident use of the Linux command line for system administration, log analysis, process management, package installation, permissions, and file system operations.
Good understanding of computer networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall fundamentals.
Familiarity with server architecture, storage technologies, RAID, and hardware diagnostics.
Experience using ticketing platforms, monitoring systems, remote management tools, and log analysis solutions.
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize and resolve multiple technical issues efficiently.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and colleagues.

description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

title: Všeobecní administratívni pracovníci
description:
Hlavnou náplňou práce je agenda nadriadeného, organizácia stretnutí, vybavovanie služobných ciest, administratívna podpora – email manažment, telefonáty, bežná dokumentácia. Podpora predaja vozidiel v showroome. Plní okrem vyššie uvedenej agendy aj náročnejšie a častokrát aj vybrané odborné činnosti a úlohy v rámci vedenia firmy, ako HR, PR a marketing, finančný reporting, plánovanie. Pracovná doba typická pre pozíciu Asistent/ka na predajni nových vozidiel je 8 hodín denne, v pracovných dňoch od pondelka do piatku a v sobotu do 13:00 hod ( s možnosťou dohody ).
Výhody:- Možnosť kariérneho a platového rastu, kde Tvoje úsilie a výsledky budú ocenené. - Získanie služobného vozidla na základe odvedených výkonov, ktoré Ti umožní flexibilné cestovanie a rýchle presuny po meste. - Firemný notebook a telefón, ktoré Ti uľahčia komunikáciu a prácu na diaľku. - Príjemná pracovná atmosféra, kde sa budeš cítiť ako súčasť tímu a budeš mať podporu od skúsených kolegov. - Možnosť získať zaujímavé skúsenosti a pracovať s modernými vozidlami, ktoré Ti umožnia byť v kontakte s najnovšími trendy v automobilovom priemysle.

Upper-Intermediate or higher proficiency in both written and spoken English.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Typická pracovná doba je delená a to od 7:00 hod do 12:00 hod následne 16:00 hod až 21:00 hod (závisí od vyťaženia), pričom sa prispôsobuje aktuálnej prevádzke.
Výhody:Vychutnaj si chutné a kvalitné jedlá v hotelovej reštaurácii za výhodné ceny. V prípade vzdialeného bydliska nad 30 km od hotela poskytujeme ubytovanie 1 € noc. Využívaj všetky hotelové služby – fitness, bazén, sauna, infrasauna – úplne zdarma, aj pre svojich rodinných príslušníkov. Pracuj v mladom a dynamickom kolektíve, kde sa budeš môcť ďalej rozvíjať. Uži si prácu v úspešnej reštaurácii, ktorá je známa svojou kvalitou a štýlovým prostredím. Ak máš záujem, pošli svoj životopis alebo nás kontaktuj osobne v Hoteli GOLFER , Kremnica. Tešíme sa na nového kolegu alebo kolegyňu, ktorý á bude s nami tvoriť príjemnú atmosféru pre našich hostí aj celý tím!

title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE
