title: Clinical Lead
description:
Are you an experienced clinical development professional looking for the opportunity to take scientific ownership of a clinical program and help shape the future of a differentiated compound?

We are looking for a scientifically curious, strategic and hands-on Clinical Development Lead to provide clinical and scientific leadership across the design, execution and interpretation of clinical studies. In this role, you will play a central part in translating scientific insight into high-quality clinical evidence and development decisions that can make a meaningful difference for patients.

You will work closely with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Safety, Biostatistics and other cross-functional partners to ensure that the clinical program is scientifically robust, operationally feasible and aligned with the compound’s development objectives. This is an opportunity to combine scientific depth with visible cross-functional leadership in an entrepreneurial, collaborative and fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities
The Clinical Development Lead is the expert responsible for leading the delivery of clinical program objectives for an assigned compound, in line with Company strategy and agreed development plans.

Main responsibilities include:
•Lead the Clinical Team at project level and provide clear scientific direction, alignment and guidance across the clinical program; may include line management responsibility.
•Lead the scientific development and delivery of clinical sections of trial- and program-level regulatory documents, including Investigator’s Brochures, briefing books, safety updates, submission dossiers and responses to Health Authorities.
•Drive the clinical component of the development program in close partnership with global line functions, ensuring scientific quality, clear priorities and timely delivery.
•Provide ongoing clinical and scientific review, interpretation and communication of clinical trial data to inform program strategy and development decisions.
•Serve as a core member of the Safety Management Team and contribute to the assessment and communication of the compound’s benefit-risk profile.
•Support the preparation of safety-related documents, including Periodic Safety Update Reports, Drug Safety Update Reports and other safety documentation, in collaboration with the Project Physician and Drug Safety Physician.
•Maintain a strong understanding of the therapeutic area, competitive landscape, relevant mechanisms of action and evolving standards of care.
•Lead clinical contributions to scientific communications, including study abstracts, posters, oral presentations and manuscripts.
•Represent the clinical perspective in cross-functional discussions and contribute to the continuous evolution of the clinical development strategy.

Candidate Requirements
•Advanced degree in life or health sciences, such as PhD, PharmD, MD, MSc or equivalent.
•At least seven years of relevant experience in clinical development within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
•Proven experience contributing to the planning, execution, reporting and publication of Phase II to IV clinical trials in a global, cross-functional and matrix environment.
•Demonstrated experience leading clinical projects or substantial clinical development workstreams through to completion.
•Strong experience in the preparation of clinical and regulatory documentation, including Investigator’s Brochures, protocols, briefing books, clinical study reports, submission dossiers and responses to Health Authorities.
•Experience supporting regulatory submissions, such as INDs, NDAs and MAAs, and contributing to interactions with Health Authorities, including pre-IND, pre-NDA, end-of-Phase II and SAWP/CHMP meetings.
•Excellent understanding of global drug development, from first-in-human studies through post-approval activities.
•Strong knowledge of clinical trial design methodology and statistics applied to clinical research.
•Ability to interpret and integrate preclinical, translational and clinical data into clinical trial design and development planning.

title: Sampling Assistant (w/m/d)
description:
Shape the future of Life Sciences with Techfirm Engineering 🚀 For our International / Consulting / Industrial Services team, Techfirm Engineering is looking for a Sampling Assistant with a background as a Laboratory Technician and experience in a GMP-regulated environment.

Your Mission

As a Sampling Assistant, you will be responsible for the collection, management and coordination of samples within a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. You will work closely with Manufacturing and Quality Control teams to ensure that samples are collected, documented and transferred in accordance with GMP requirements.

Key Responsibilities:
Perform environmental and utility sampling in a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment.
Collect samples from water systems for TOC, Bioburden and Endotoxin testing.
Perform viable air and particulate sampling using equipment such as Surface Air Samplers and particle counters (e.g. Climet).
Ensure the correct identification, handling, storage and distribution of samples from Manufacturing to the QC Laboratory.
Schedule and manage sampling activities using LIMS systems, such as LabWare LIMS.
Use manufacturing systems such as DeltaV for remote control of vessels when required for sampling activities.
Ensure accurate and compliant GxP/GMP documentation and maintain relevant procedures, SOPs and work instructions.
Support the management and investigation of deviations and other quality-related events using systems such as TrackWise.
Collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Quality Control, Quality Assurance and other relevant departments.
Ensure that all sampling activities are performed in accordance with GMP, EHS and data integrity requirements.
Contribute to continuous improvement of sampling processes and procedures.
Support the training of colleagues and team members in sampling-related activities when required.

Your Profile

Degree or professional qualification as a Laboratory Technician / Laboratory Technologist or equivalent scientific/technical education.
Previous experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or chemical manufacturing environment.
Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment is highly desirable.
Practical experience with environmental monitoring and/or sampling activities.
Knowledge of sampling techniques for water systems, viable air and particulates is an advantage.
Experience with LIMS, ideally LabWare LIMS.
Familiarity with GMP/GxP documentation, SOPs, deviations and CAPA.
Knowledge of TrackWise, DeltaV or similar systems is an advantage.
Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when handling samples and documentation.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently while being part of a multidisciplinary team.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Project selection aligned with your skills, experience, and career goals

Inclusive workplace promoting diversity and equal opportunities

Un\-e secrétaire de police du commerce (50 à 60%) Un\-e secrétaire de chancellerie (60% à 70%)
==================================================================================================







Police Lavaux est une association de six communes du district de Lavaux\-Oron, soit Bourg\-en\-Lavaux, Chexbres, Lutry, Puidoux, Rivaz et Saint\-Saphorin, dont la mission principale est d’assurer la protection des personnes et des biens sur le territoire en fournissant un service de police de proximité.



Au sein de sa Division Police Administrative, l'Unité Administrative et d'Accueil (UAA) est le premier point de contact de la population, des commerçants et des partenaires : réception de l'Hôtel de police, autorisations de police du commerce, chancellerie, gestion du port et du cimetière de Lutry.







Police Lavaux réorganise actuellement cette unité afin d’optimiser la répartition des tâches et d’améliorer le service au public. Dans ce cadre, elle recrute :



Un\-e secrétaire de police du commerce (50 à 60%) Un\-e secrétaire de chancellerie (60% à 70%)
==================================================================================================



**Police du commerce \- Missions générales**



* Assurer la gestion administrative de la police du commerce  
* Gérer les demandes d’autorisation simples  
* Facturer les taxes et les émoluments  
* Suppléer l’inspecteur de police du commerce pour les tâches urgentes et l’appuyer ponctuellement sur le terrain pour des contrôles d'établissements et de manifestations  


**Chancellerie \- Missions générales**



* Gérer la chancellerie (gestion de la correspondance, des rapports et des écrits de Police Lavaux et des réquisitions des différents services partenaires)  
* Gérer l’ensemble des archives  
* Collaborer aux tâches de réception de l’Hôtel de police  


**Profils recherchés**



* CFC d’employé de commerce ou titre jugé équivalent  
* Maturité professionnelle commerciale souhaitée  
* Connaissance de l’administration publique (quelques années d’expérience au sein d’une administration communale dans une fonction similaire), un atout  
* Sens du service public  
* Aisance relationnelle  
* Discrétion, fiabilité, efficacité et précision  
* Capacité à travailler de manière autonome, méthodique et organisée  
* Très bonnes connaissances en français, aisance dans la rédaction  
* Maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels exigée  


**Nous offrons**



* Des possibilités de formation continue et de développement professionnel  
* Excellentes prestations de prévoyance professionnelle  
* Horaire de travail de 40h/semaine  
* 5 semaines de vacances par année (6 semaines dès 50 ans)  
* Lieu de travail à Lutry

title: Clinical Lead
description:
Are you an experienced clinical development professional looking for the opportunity to take scientific ownership of a clinical program and help shape the future of a differentiated compound?

We are looking for a scientifically curious, strategic and hands-on Clinical Development Lead to provide clinical and scientific leadership across the design, execution and interpretation of clinical studies. In this role, you will play a central part in translating scientific insight into high-quality clinical evidence and development decisions that can make a meaningful difference for patients.

You will work closely with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Safety, Biostatistics and other cross-functional partners to ensure that the clinical program is scientifically robust, operationally feasible and aligned with the compound’s development objectives. This is an opportunity to combine scientific depth with visible cross-functional leadership in an entrepreneurial, collaborative and fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities
The Clinical Development Lead is the expert responsible for leading the delivery of clinical program objectives for an assigned compound, in line with Company strategy and agreed development plans.

Main responsibilities include:
•Lead the Clinical Team at project level and provide clear scientific direction, alignment and guidance across the clinical program; may include line management responsibility.
•Lead the scientific development and delivery of clinical sections of trial- and program-level regulatory documents, including Investigator’s Brochures, briefing books, safety updates, submission dossiers and responses to Health Authorities.
•Drive the clinical component of the development program in close partnership with global line functions, ensuring scientific quality, clear priorities and timely delivery.
•Provide ongoing clinical and scientific review, interpretation and communication of clinical trial data to inform program strategy and development decisions.
•Serve as a core member of the Safety Management Team and contribute to the assessment and communication of the compound’s benefit-risk profile.
•Support the preparation of safety-related documents, including Periodic Safety Update Reports, Drug Safety Update Reports and other safety documentation, in collaboration with the Project Physician and Drug Safety Physician.
•Maintain a strong understanding of the therapeutic area, competitive landscape, relevant mechanisms of action and evolving standards of care.
•Lead clinical contributions to scientific communications, including study abstracts, posters, oral presentations and manuscripts.
•Represent the clinical perspective in cross-functional discussions and contribute to the continuous evolution of the clinical development strategy.

Candidate Requirements
•Advanced degree in life or health sciences, such as PhD, PharmD, MD, MSc or equivalent.
•At least seven years of relevant experience in clinical development within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
•Proven experience contributing to the planning, execution, reporting and publication of Phase II to IV clinical trials in a global, cross-functional and matrix environment.
•Demonstrated experience leading clinical projects or substantial clinical development workstreams through to completion.
•Strong experience in the preparation of clinical and regulatory documentation, including Investigator’s Brochures, protocols, briefing books, clinical study reports, submission dossiers and responses to Health Authorities.
•Experience supporting regulatory submissions, such as INDs, NDAs and MAAs, and contributing to interactions with Health Authorities, including pre-IND, pre-NDA, end-of-Phase II and SAWP/CHMP meetings.
•Excellent understanding of global drug development, from first-in-human studies through post-approval activities.
•Strong knowledge of clinical trial design methodology and statistics applied to clinical research.
•Ability to interpret and integrate preclinical, translational and clinical data into clinical trial design and development planning.

* Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Security Architect (idealerweise mit Cloud\- /Application\-Security\-Schwerpunkt)

**Persönlichkeit**



* Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten
* Selbstständige, lösungsorientierte und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise

**Job Title: Operations Specialist**

**Salary:** competitive

**Hours:** Full\-time (100%), 42 hours per week (standard office hours, with some flexibility of commute), unlimited employment

**Vacation:** 25 days annual holiday, plus local legal bank holidays. An additional day off on your birthday.

**Start Date:** Now

If you’re motivated by meaningful work, strong customer relationships, and continuous learning, this role is for you. Help deliver technology that makes a real difference in public safety while building trusted relationships with key customers across Switzerland.

**Company Overview:**

Buddi is a fast\-paced, high\-growth UK based technology company that is a global leader in the design, manufacture and supply of equipment to the Criminal Justice Sector around the world.

Buddi has a long\-standing contract for its supply within Switzerland, and this is managed from our office in Lausanne.

Buddi has hubs, such as we have in **Lausanne, Switzerland** in many other parts of the world where that is necessary and improves the quality of our delivery and customer support.

Buddi’s parent company, Big Technologies PLC, is listed on the UK stock market and provides the financial resources and stability for the company to expand the supply of the equipment to new areas. Europe is a particular area for such expansion.

**Role Overview:**

As the **Operations Specialist**, you will join a small team in Lausanne and support our contract delivery within Switzerland. You may also support our wider operations in the region. Some flexibility with partially working remotely.

Fluency, written and verbal, in English language and either German, French or Italian is a necessary requirement to support our Cantonal customers in Switzerland. Any other languages, at any level, would be beneficial though not essential.

From the Lausanne office you will manage the stock of equipment, including in country logistic supply via the postal service and provide the first line of direct customer support, whether through telephone or email engagement.

Alongside the day\-to\-day operations conducted from the office there will be a necessity for some travel to customer offices within Switzerland, specifically those that are German or French speaking, for face\-to\-face meetings and delivery of some training relating to the equipment and software. Training will predominantly be supplied in Lausanne however it may also be preferable to attend Buddi’s UK office occasionally.

You will help in identifying and nurturing good practice, helping maintain strong customer relationships, and ensuring we meet and exceed our service delivery standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide operational support to help customers meet their Electronic Monitoring (EM) objectives, including timely and accurate equipment deliveries and technical advice.
* Support the delivery of training and knowledge sharing sessions, both upon request and by identifying areas for improvement.
* Support the completion of contractual obligations, such as the management of SLAs, KPIs, and the delivery of regular performance reports.
* Participate in regular account management meetings, capturing customer feedback and driving continuous service enhancements.
* Contribute to wider business development activities including supporting new customer implementations.


**Required Skills \& Experience:**

* Fluency in English and either German, French or Italian.
* A proactive, positive attitude with a passion for customer support and personal development.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Quick learner with the ability to understand and then explain Buddi’s products and services.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly in billing and data accuracy.
* Competency with office\-based IT tools and software ( Microsoft Office suite)
* Eligibility to work in Switzerland.


**Desirable Skills:**

* Previous experience in direct customer communication.


**Additional Information:**

* Buddi supplies its equipment to criminal justice agencies, therefore data security, confidentiality and security vetting are contractual necessities.
* Willingness to achieve any available high\-level security vetting is required.
* Compliance with all data security and confidentiality requirements, whether from Buddi or our customers, is a necessity.


If you’re passionate about customer success, detail\-oriented, and eager to contribute to a high\-performing team, we’d love to hear from you.

Safety Manager
==============

The and Zinc (NiZn) Safety Manager will contribute to the development of NiZn Safety management systems and improvement of global Safety performance. The role will support the implementation and ongoing evolution of Glencore’s Health, Safety, Environment, Communities \& Human Rights (HSEC\&HR) strategy, including SafeWork, the associated Safety technical standards and guidance, and safety strategic projects in alignment with Glencore’s Health and Safety Policy. In this position, travel to sites will apply of around approximately 40% of time.

This role reports to the NiZn Department HSEC and HR Lead.

**The main tasks and responsibilities**

* Contribute to the implementation and evolution of Glencore’s Health, Safety, Environment, Communities \& Human Rights (HSEC\&HR) strategy including SafeWork, Fatal Hazard Protocols, and associated safety Technical Standards and guidance within the NiZn Department


* Support global continuous improvement through contributing to the design of systems and processes to monitor, assure and report on Safety performance


* Deliver technical support to the NiZn assets in the areas of Safety and Group\-wide Safety management system


* Support the development and implementation of assurance processes for Glencore’s safety management, as required


* Support data management and ensure timely and accurate delivery of any required information for internal and external reporting, including the Annual Report, Annual Sustainability Report, and ICMM\-required reporting


* Support monitoring and trends analysis of safety Incidents data reported by the NiZn business units


* Provide support and group\-level monitoring of performance related to safety objectives, targets, and metrics


* Promote a proactive approach to the management of safety with Glencore’s Corporate HSEC \& Human Rights and Sustainability Group, Departmental and Regional HSEC Leads, and other relevant internal stakeholders, to encourage leveraging of best practices across the business


* Provide coordination of group safety projects, training programmes and workshops to assist in the implementation of technical standards across the business


* The candidate is available to travel to sites estimated 40 % travel


**Our ideal person**

* An experienced professional with effective persuasion and decision\-making capability
* Experience/knowledge of the following areas will be beneficial, UG and OC mining, concentrators, hydrometallurgical and pyrometallurgical process plants
* Eperience in risk management, catastrophic hazard management, occupational safety, fatal hazard protocol management and process safety management
* A high level of personal credibility, with the authority to build respect and trust at all levels of a company
* Composed, professional and collaborative. Comfortable “rolling up the sleeves” with a “can do” approach
* A genuine interest in building and sustaining positive relationships with key internal and external stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to navigate complexity and act strategically, as well as being flexible and adaptable to fast changing priorities
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and advanced analytical and creative problem\-solving capability
* The candidate should be able to show to proven safety results and be able clearly showcase how to contribute towards future safety improvements


**Minimum requirements**

* Degree Qualified (Health and Safety discipline, or other qualification with relevant experience) and relevant in\-field experience (\>8 years)


* Understanding, experience and knowledge in safety management issues, governance, and performance within a global multinational setting


* Experience with global operations and international standards such as, ISO19001, ISO 450001, ISO31000, UN Sustainable Development Goals and GRI Standards


* Experience and knowledge in projects management


* Experience planning and implementing assurance activities


* Extensive experience in the implementation of SafeWork and Glencore Fatal hazard Protocols viewed favourably


* Significant experience working in the extractives industry


* Fluency in English, with proficiency in French or Russian preferred


**Benefits**

* We are committed to providing benefits, which promote mental, physical, and financial well\-being. From healthy meal options in our restaurants and bistros to free use of the in\-house gym including sport classes with professional trainers.
* We reimburse public transport for commuting to work; alternatively, we offer free parking space.
* We provide tuition assistance for further education and training courses.
* We have a competitive parental leave policy. Our childcare benefits also include emergency childcare services and financial assistance towards daycare costs.
* Employees’ Swiss Pension 2nd pillar is fully paid by Glencore.


**Who we are**

Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that advance everyday life.

With over 140,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 30 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of offices.

Glencore’s customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.

Financial Analyst \& AI Engineer
================================

**Merion Swiss Partners SA**

Geneva, Switzerland

### **About us**

Founded in Geneva in 2019, Merion is an independent, FINMA\-regulated wealth management firm. We provide bespoke portfolio management built on independence, transparency, collaboration, and stability.

We are seeking a high\-potential, entry\-level / junior professional to design and implement next\-generation automated management tools within our existing framework, as well as to contribute to financial and investment analysis, research, and the development of the Company’s internal analytical tools.

### **Innovation \& Artificial Intelligence**

* Privacy\-First Local AI Engine: A 100% offline, local AI assistant that securely parses PDFs, conducts smart searches across internal files, and summarizes news sentiment without data leaks.
* Internet mitigation tool: develop a KYC AI tool that groups internet and AI searches in various languages and alphabets (Latin and Cyrillic).
* Contribute to the adoption of AI and automation capabilities across research workflows.
* Company’s visibility via AI: improve the Company’s visibility in the field of Wealth and Investment Management on Google and via AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude.


### **Research Tools \& Analytics**

**Proprietary solution for Equities and Bonds**

* Create an Analysis and Research Proprietary Database that automates pipeline tracking from multiple sources within the Company’s internal investment universe.
* Build a screening and data solution based on the database that returns data such as daily prices, stops and targets based on technical analysis and/or sentiment, news, descriptions (EN/FR), investment or disinvestment rationales, ratings, and default risks.
* Automate data collection to support financial research activities.
* Transform the solution into an end\-user interface technology.
* Work closely with end users to understand their needs and continuously improve the solution.


**Proprietary solution for Structured Products**

* Create an Analysis and Research Proprietary Database for Structured Products and their underlyings.
* Screen underlyings and return a live one\-page format with key information, P\&L, probabilities of autocall or an unfavorable scenario, and issuer default risk.


### **Financial Analyst**

* Analyze and challenge the data resulting from the Analysis Database, especially in relation to purchase and sale signals or recommendations, and potentially mitigate associated risks. Ensure data quality, integrity, governance, and accessibility across the research platform.
* Investment research: evaluate emerging technologies relevant to financial research and data analysis.
* Modular Portfolio Dashboard: an interactive desktop interface (Streamlit) to build portfolio profiles, enforce rules, brackets, currencies, markets, etc., and run backtests based on the Company’s universe.
* Support the assessment of investment opportunities through fundamental and quantitative analysis, including financial ratios, historical performance, risk factors and market data.
* Use Python, SQL, Excel and other analytical tools to automate financial analysis, reporting and recurring investment\-monitoring processes.
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the Company’s internal financial research methodologies, analytical models and investment\-monitoring framework.


### **Office Support**

* Translation of internal and sensitive documents from EN to RU.
* Support to the Company’s Business Introducers via KYCs, KYTs and FINMA standards (RU / FR / EN).
* Possibility to develop the Company’s clientele.
* Handle the Company’s website.


### **Your profile**

**Financial \& Investment Analysis**

* Ability to combine financial reasoning with quantitative and data\-driven approaches and to translate analytical results into clear conclusions for investment professionals.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to work with financial and market data from multiple sources.


**Data \& Programming**

* Financial Scraping \& Data Retrieval: proven experience in financial web scraping (Beautiful Soup, Selenium) and automated daily data parsing into local Excel/SQL environments.
* Tool Implementation \& Interfaces: hands\-on experience implementing functional desktop control panels and UI analytics tools using Python (Pandas, NumPy) and frameworks such as Streamlit.
* Quant Modeling: constrained portfolio optimization, multi\-currency conversions, and historical backtesting metrics, including Sharpe ratio and volatility. Prior experience supporting quantitative asset pricing or empirical risk factor research is highly valued.
* Local AI/NLP: implementation of secure, offline LLMs via LangChain or LlamaIndex to process data entirely on\-site. Specific exposure to building custom text preprocessing, PDF extraction tools, and news sentiment scoring engines is ideal.


**Education**

Master’s degree in Finance or Quantitative Finance (completed or in progress).

**Languages**

Fluent English and Russian.

Good knowledge of French — minimum B1\.

Attractive environment.

Full time.

By having a huge impact on the industry, they are growing their skills portfolio and boosting their career in a fast\-pace a look behind the scenes by checking on Instagram.



We are all in at Swissquote. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives to join our team and contribute to our shared success.



Are you all in? 't be shy, apply!



Head Client Lifecycle Integrity \- Director \- Member of Senior Management
==========================================================================



As part of its ongoing organisational evolution, Swissquote is creating a new department, theClient Lifecycle Integrity (CLI) Department. Acting as a1\.5 line of defence and independent from the Front Office, the CLI brings together key activities supporting the integrity\-related management of private client relationships throughout their lifecycle, from onboarding and periodic reviews to AML transaction monitoring.



In this context, the Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will play a key leadership role in shaping and implementing the new organisation. As a member of Senior Management and Director, the role is responsible for defining the CLI's strategic direction, establishing an effective and forward\-looking operating model, driving a culture ofcontinuous improvement and operational excellence and ensuring the successful integration and performance of its different activities, in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and internal policies. The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity shall in particular have a strong focus on technology enablement, AI\-driven optimisation and operational scalability, with a strong client\-centric and data\-driven approach.



The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will act as a senior partner to the Executive Management and work closely with the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department as well as technology functions to continuously enhance the Bank's integrity\-related client lifecycle framework.







  **Key responsibilities:**



**1\. Leadership, Governance \& Stakeholder Management**



* Lead the CLI, defining its strategy, organisation, governance and priorities, and establishing clear accountability across the department.
* Establish and maintain a strong, risk\-based control environment, ensuring that all activities within the CLI's remit are effective, consistent and compliant with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank's risk tolerance.
* Provide senior leadership and direction on complex or sensitive cases and operational matters, driving appropriate escalation and decision\-making.
* Represent the CLI at Senior Management and in relevant governance bodies, and act as a strategic partner to the Executive Management, the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department and other key stakeholders.
* Serve as a senior point of contact for FINMA, auditors and other relevant external stakeholders within the CLI's area of responsibility.
* Drive high standards, quality and effectiveness across the different CLI activities, supported by appropriate policies, procedures, controls, management information and risk and performance indicators.
* Ensure timely reporting of key risk and performance indicators to the Executive Management and relevant governance bodies.
* Build and develop a high\-performing management team and foster a culture of strong control, collaboration and operational excellence.
* Contribute to the preparation of external and internal audits, inspections as well as regulatory reviews.


**2\. Client Onboarding, Integrity\-related Lifecycle Management \& AML Transaction Monitoring**



* Oversee private client onboarding (incl. with respect to prospects introduced or managed by Group foreign entities), in line with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank's risk tolerance.
* Oversee integrity\-related lifecycle activities, including periodic and event\-driven reviews, changes in circumstances, account maintenance, dormant account processes and closures, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.
* Oversee AML transaction monitoring across all client segments, ensuring effective identification, assessment and escalation of potentially suspicious activities.
* Ensure appropriate risk management and robust governance for complex or high\-risk client relationships and transactions, while maintaining effective collaboration with Front Office and the Compliance Department.


**3\. Process Effectiveness, Automation \& Continuous Improvement**



* Continuously enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CLI processes, with a focus on optimisation, automation and digitalisation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to leverage technology, data, analytics, workflow solutions and AI to reduce manual activities, improve quality, consistency and risk effectiveness and ensure compliance.
* Establish and monitor appropriate operational and quality metrics to identify performance gaps, assess outcomes and support informed management decisions.
* Work closely with technology functions as well as other relevant stakeholders to deliver sustainable improvements across client onboarding, integrity\-related lifecycle management and AML transaction monitoring as well as anticipate and adapt to the evolving client onboarding and lifecycle landscapes.
* a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging teams to challenge existing ways of working and identify practical opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and control effectiveness.

* Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Law, Business Administration or equivalent degree.
* Proven track record in process optimisation, automation, digitalisation and operational excellence.
* A relevant certification in project management, process improvement or transformation (e.g. PMP) is considered an asset.
* Strong understanding of howdata, technology, workflow tools and AI can be used to enhance control effectiveness, decision\-making and operational efficiency.
* Strong expertise in client onboarding, KYC/AML, client lifecycle management and AML transaction monitoring, with a broad understanding of related legal and regulatory requirements.
* Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving abilities, particularly when dealing with complex or high\-impact regulatory and operational matters.
* Demonstrated experience managing and developing large and diverse teams, with a strong track record of building high\-performing management structures, developing talent and leadership capabilities, and establishing effective career development and succession planning frameworks.
* Past exposure to Executive Management, regulators, auditors and senior internal stakeholders.
* High level of integrity, sound judgement and professional credibility, combined with strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative leadership approach.

* Contribute to the design and implementation of Group HR policies, processes and tools.

Working directly with the Group HR Director, you will gain visibility across the organization and have the opportunity to influence the development of HR practices, processes and tools. * Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, coordinate multidisciplinary teams, and ensure the continuous improvement of PLM processes and solutions

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Interest in innovation, digital transformation and engineering processes
* First experience in project management or willingness to develop project management skills

* Team\-oriented, autonomous and eager to learn

* Technical degree, Higher Technical School diploma (Swiss HF/ES) or equivalent qualification in Microtechnology, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, or a related field

* Native French or German speaker with good working knowledge of the other language

The role also carries people leadership responsibility, developing and leading the RGM team while building commercial capabilities across the organization.

* Drive cross\-functional adoption of RGM principles, capabilities and execution across the Commercial Team.
* Standardise revenue management reporting and analysis (tools, processes and routines), leveraging data and analytics to create a competitive advantage.

**What you'll bring:**

* Completed Bachelor's degree (University/FH)
* Min 7 years work experience or other relevant assignment with proven track record and owned results ideally in more than one of the following areas: Customer Management, Portoflio Pricing and Promo Management, Trade Investments, Brand Management and Commercialization, Commercial Finance, Category Management, Insights and Big Data.

Du kennst Microsoft\-Umgebungen nicht aus Schulungsunterlagen, sondern aus dem Betrieb. Du weisst, was in einer hybriden M365\-Umgebung schiefgehen kann \- und wie man es behebt.

Was du mitbringst:

EU Logistics \& Customs Manager
===============================

**Logistics \& Customs Manager(Switzerland\-Based)**



**Summary**

Responsible for managing logistics operations, customs compliance, import/export procedures, and cross\-border movement of goods within the European Union. The role ensures timely delivery, regulatory compliance, cost efficiency, and effective coordination with customs authorities, logistics providers, suppliers, and internal teams.



**Key Responsibilities**



\& Supply Chain

* Manage EU import and export logistics operations and cross\-border shipments.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, carriers, customs brokers, warehouses, and other logistics service providers.
* Monitor shipment status, customs clearance, delivery schedules, and logistics costs.
* Identify and resolve logistics, customs clearance, and delivery issues.
* Drive logistics process improvements and cost\-saving initiatives.




\& Trade Compliance

* Oversee customs declarations, import duties, tariffs, VAT, and related documentation.
* Ensure compliance with EU customs regulations and applicable import/export requirements.
* Develop and maintain customs procedures, policies, and compliance controls.
* Maintain accurate customs records and documentation for audits and regulatory inspections.
* Monitor changes in EU customs legislation and assess their impact on business operations.
* Work closely with Finance, Tax, Legal, Procurement, Product, and Supply Chain teams on customs and trade compliance matters.




(Binding Tariff Information) Management

* Lead the BTI application process, including preparation, submission, and follow\-up with relevant EU customs authorities.
* Prepare and maintain supporting documentation for BTI applications, including detailed product descriptions, technical specifications, product composition, images, catalogues, and other relevant information.
* Coordinate with internal Product, Engineering, R\&D, Tax, and Legal teams to ensure accurate product classification information.
* Review and validate BTI decisions and tariff classifications and ensure they are correctly implemented in customs declarations and internal systems.
* Maintain a centralized BTI database/register, including application status, BTI reference numbers, tariff classifications, validity periods, and applicable products.
* Monitor BTI validity, regulatory changes, product changes, and other circumstances that may affect the continued applicability of existing BTIs.

Develop and enhance risk governance, including policies, methodologies, tools and templates, ensuring consistent adoption across the P&C organization.

Support Risk Management leadership on strategic priorities, executive discussions and key risk matters.

12+ years’ experience within P&C Commercial Insurance or Retail, preferably in a business function such as Underwriting or Claims, or in risk management.  
Degree or equivalent qualification/experience in risk management, insurance, actuarial science, finance, economics, business administration or a related discipline. Professional underwriter certification is an advantage.  
Advanced understanding of the P&C insurance business, including key risk drivers across underwriting, reserving, claims, pricing, catastrophe exposure, reinsurance, operational risk and strategic risk.  
Experience working in a second line risk management function, or equivalent experience providing independent review, challenge and advisory support to business stakeholders.  
Proven ability to interpret risk information, identify key themes and translate findings into clear recommendations and management actions.  
Excellent communication, critical thinking, collaboration and execution skills, with a track record of engaging with senior stakeholders and influencing decision-making in a complex matrix organization.  
Experience leading or supporting risk assessments, risk appetite reviews, assurance activities, governance processes and management reporting.

**Your profile**



The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.



Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.



**About us**



Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not\-for\-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world\-class education in a stunning alpine setting.



The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.



There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.



**What we offer**



Aiglon is dedicated to the well\-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.



**How to apply**



Deadline for applications: **02\.11\.2026**



Early applications are encouraged. We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate. Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.



**Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.**



**Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.**



You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s .



**JOB PURPOSE**



The role of the Invigilator is to play a crucial part in maintaining the integrity, confidentiality, and security of the assessment and examination process. The Invigilator ensures that all examinations are conducted strictly according to required regulations, providing all candidates with an equal opportunity to demonstrate their abilities while preventing candidate malpractice and administrative errors. The invigilator also adheres to the school’s safeguarding policies and procedures at all times.



**KEYS TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**



*      Conduct examinations in strict adherence to the regulations and guidelines of Aiglon College and relevant exam boards (including SAT, CollegeBoard, IB, JCQ, Pearson and CIE).

  

*      Ensure all candidates have an equal opportunity to demonstrate their abilities.

  

*      Safeguard and ensure the security of examination materials before, during, and after each examination.

  

*      Prevent potential candidate malpractice and administrative failures.

  

*      Follow the school’s safeguarding policies and procedures at all times.

  



Invigilators are required to:



*      Declare if they have invigilated previously and whether they have any current invigilation maladministration/malpractice sanctions applied to them.

  

*      Confirm their availability in advance of main examination periods.

  

*      Ensure a strong understanding of current exam board regulations, guidelines, and confidentiality requirements by studying provided materials.

  

*      Complete relevant invigilator training prior to examination periods or at the start of each academic year as directed.

  



An ideal candidate will:



*      Be reliable, flexible, and readily available during major exam periods.

  

*      Have clear, authoritative, yet calm verbal skills along with effective communication, interpersonal, and teamworking skills.

  

*      Be a confident, reassuring presence to candidates in examination rooms and effectively manage group situations.

  

*      Possess basic IT skills (e.g., familiar with the use of email and mobile messaging).

  

*      Seek to achieve competence in the role and a rigorous understanding of examination board regulations.

  

*      Have attention to detail, strict adherence to compliance and seating protocol.

  



Main duties in detail:
======================



Before examinations
===================



*      Report to and be briefed by the Exams Officer/SAT Coordinator prior to each exam session.

  

*      Keep confidential examination question papers and materials secure.

  

*      Ensure examination rooms are set up according to required arrangements.

  

*      Admit candidates into examination rooms under formal examination conditions.

  

*      Give full attention to conducting the examinations properly.

  

*      Identify candidates and seat them according to seating plans.

  

*      Distribute the correct question papers and examination materials to candidates.

  

*      Instruct candidates on the conduct of their exams and deal with candidate questions.

  

*      Start examinations on time.

  



During examinations
===================



*      Supervise and observe candidates at all times and be vigilant throughout examinations.

  

*      Keep disruption in examination rooms to a minimum.

  

*      Deal with emergencies or irregularities effectively.

  

*      Record/report any incidents, disruption, or irregularities.

  

*      Complete attendance registers.

  

*      Record accurate start and finish times and track times updates.

  

*      Deal with candidate questions according to the regulations.

  



After examinations
==================



*      Instruct candidates on finishing their examinations and collect all examination scripts in attendance register order.

  

*      Dismiss candidates from the examination room.

  

*      Check candidates' names on scripts and match details against the attendance register.

  

*      Securely return all examination scripts and materials to the Exams Officer/SAT Coordinator.

  



OTHER TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
================================



*      Supervise candidates with exam timetable clashes between sessions as required.

  

*      Provide support to candidates with access arrangements (e.g., reading, scribing), following provided training.

  

*      Assist with exam\-related administrative tasks, such as "second pair of eyes" security checks.

  

*      Take part in invigilator training

  

*      Undertake any other reasonable tasks required by the Exams Officer/SAT Coordinator to support smooth exam operations.

  

*      Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.

  

*      Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.

School Shop Support Assistant
=============================







**Aiglon College** seeks to appoint a suitably qualified











School Shop Support Assistant
=============================



to join the school from: **ASAP**



JOB PURPOSE
===========



The School Support Assistant provides reliable, flexible support to the School Shop and other areas of the School throughout a 12\-month fixed\-term contract. The role includes planned work during the twice\-yearly stock takes in January and July and during the annual Essentials Fair. At other times, the post holder may be offered work when additional support is needed, including staff sickness cover, alumni reunions, special occasions, busy periods and other operational requirements.



Post holders are expected to act as ambassadors for Aiglon, provide a helpful and professional service, and adapt confidently to different duties, teams and working environments.



CONTRACT AND AVAILABILITY
=========================



*      Fixed\-term contract of 12 months.

  

*      Planned attendance for the January stock take, July stock take and annual Essentials Fair, on dates communicated in advance.

  

*      For the remainder of the year, additional assignments may be offered as operational needs arise and will be agreed according to the School’s requirements and the post holder’s availability.

  

*      Hours may vary depending on the assignment and may include early mornings, evenings or weekends for special events.

  



GENERAL REQUIREMENTS
====================



An ideal candidate will:
------------------------



*      Be reliable, punctual, flexible and available for the planned work periods.

  

*      Respond promptly and professionally when contacted about additional work.

  

*      Have effective communication skills and good interpersonal skills.

  

*      Work well as part of a team and independently after instruction.

  

*      Be confident, approachable and reassuring when supporting students, families, visitors and colleagues.

  

*      Be methodical, organised and attentive to detail.

  

*      Be comfortable working with numbers and have basic IT skills.

  

*      Exercise discretion and respect confidentiality.

  

*      Be willing and able to undertake physical work, including lifting boxes and standing for extended periods.

  



KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
==============================



Twice\-yearly stock takes \- January and July
=============================================



*      Count merchandise accurately and follow stock\-take procedures as instructed.

  

*      Record and input quantities clearly and correctly, and double\-check discrepancies when required.

  

*      Reorganise shelves and storage areas and ensure products are correctly labelled and sized.

  

*      Identify damaged, missing or obsolete items and report inconsistencies promptly.

  

*      Support restocking, merchandising and preparation of the shop for reopening.

  



Essentials Fair
===============



*      Help set up the Fair, including moving boxes and furniture, counting and labelling stock, checking barcodes and preparing displays.

  

*      Distribute stationery orders and deliver goods to buildings or boarding houses as required.

  

*      Welcome and advise students and parents on uniforms, expedition kit and other purchases.

  

*      Use the checkout system to invoice purchases and label clothing with name tapes.

  

*      Pack away remaining stock and restock the School Shop after the Fair.

  



On\-call and Additional Support
===============================



*      Provide temporary cover when a member of staff is absent or when another short\-term need arises.

  

*      Support alumni reunions, school events, special occasions and other periods of increased activity.

  

*      Assist with customer service, reception, sales, stock handling, setup, pack\-down, deliveries, administration or other suitable duties according to the assignment.

  

*      Follow the instructions of the manager responsible for each assignment and work cooperatively with the team.

  

*      Undertake any other reasonable tasks consistent with the purpose of the role and the post holder’s skills and training.

  



Working Conditions
==================



*      Work may take place in the School Shop, storage areas, event spaces or other locations across the campus.

  

*      The role can involve lifting and moving boxes or furniture, standing for extended periods and working in busy, fast\-paced environments.

  

*      Appropriate induction, instructions and task\-specific training will be provided.

  



OTHER TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
--------------------------------



*      Undertake any other tasks which may be reasonably required by the School Shop Manager to assist in the smooth running of the School Shop

  

*      Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people

Senior Client Onboarding, KYC \& KYT Officer
============================================

**Functions (duties and responsibilities)**

* Review and approve onboarding files for individuals and legal entities, including complex and high\-risk structures, ensuring completeness, accuracy and compliance with CDB 20, FINMA expectations and internal directives/guidelines.
* Review FATCA, QI and CDB formalities for consistency with CRS/AEI formalities, identifying inconsistencies and escalating material issues where required.
* Control, validate and approve captured customer data and account documentation, ensuring data quality, traceability and adequate audit trail.
* Capture, assess and follow up on deficiencies detected during onboarding, periodic reviews and client lifecycle management processes.
* Challenge Front Office on documentation quality, missing information, risk assessments, economic rationale, transactional rationale and justification of complex client structures when required.
* Oversee and perform client onboarding, KYC due diligence and periodic review processes, including enhanced due diligence, AML\-related clarifications, PEP assessments and other higher\-risk factors.
* Perform and review periodic KYC reviews for existing client relationships, ensuring that client information, risk indicators, Source of Wealth, Source of Funds, expected account activity and transactional profile remain complete, consistent and up to date.
* Apply strong Know Your Transaction (KYT) knowledge to assess transactional behaviour, expected account activity, transactional rationale and potential inconsistencies with the client profile, escalating unusual or unexplained activity where appropriate.
* Perform complex onboarding and periodic review assessments for high\-risk clients, including PEPs, complex ownership structures, trusts, foundations, holding companies, cross\-border relationships, EAMs and other sophisticated private banking structures.
* Assess Source of Wealth and Source of Funds information and challenge the adequacy, plausibility and evidential quality of supporting documentation where necessary.
* Provide expert advice and guidance to the Front Office on onboarding, KYC, KYT, AML, CDB, FATCA, CRS/AEI and related client lifecycle topics.
* Act as subject matter expert for onboarding, KYC, KYT and AML requirements within the first line of defence.
* Review and validate work performed by junior onboarding team members, ensuring consistency of standards, risk\-based judgement and quality of execution.
* Provide coaching and training to onboarding specialists and Front Office teams on documentation standards, KYC quality, KYT awareness, periodic review expectations and risk\-based judgement.
* Lead initiatives with Legal, Compliance, Risk and Front Office management to strengthen onboarding, KYC, KYT and periodic review controls, streamline procedures and improve operational efficiency.
* Communicate and explain complex documentary, KYC, KYT and AML matters to relevant stakeholders, including senior management of the Bank.
* Coordinate and support audit fieldwork, including preparing files, addressing auditor queries and ensuring remediation actions are adequately evidenced.
* Prepare management information, quality indicators and KPIs related to onboarding and periodic review volumes, deficiencies, ageing, turnaround times, escalations and remediation progress.
* Participate in committees, working groups and remediation initiatives related to KYC, AML, KYT, client lifecycle management, onboarding and periodic review process enhancement.
* Support the implementation of regulatory, audit and internal policy changes affecting client onboarding, KYC, KYT and periodic review processes.
* Complete and review account opening documentation and ensure that all required documentation is properly obtained, recorded and retained.




**Your profile**

* Degree in law, business administration, economics, finance or a related field. A master’s degree in law, compliance, risk management or a related discipline is highly desired.
* ACAMS certification is desired. Additional AML, Compliance, Risk Management or Swiss banking certifications are considered a strong advantage.
* Minimum 7–10 years of experience in client onboarding, KYC, KYT, periodic reviews and AML within private banking, wealth management or a comparable international banking environment.
* Strong knowledge of Swiss banking regulations and standards, including FINMA expectations, AMLA/AMLO\-FINMA, CDB, FATCA, CRS/AEI and QI requirements.
* Advanced knowledge of complex private banking structures, including trusts, foundations, holding companies, complex beneficial ownership chains, cross\-border arrangements, EAM relationships and other sophisticated structures.
* Proven experience performing and documenting Source of Wealth, Source of Funds, PEP, high\-risk client and complex structure assessments.
* Strong KYT understanding, including assessment of expected account activity, transactional rationale, transactional consistency with the client profile and identification of unusual or unexplained activity.
* Solid experience in periodic KYC reviews and client lifecycle management, including risk reassessment, documentation refresh, deficiency management and escalation of material changes in the client risk profile.
* Strong understanding of customer risk rating methodologies and the connection between KYC quality, periodic reviews, transactional behaviour and ongoing monitoring.
* Experience with audit remediation, regulatory reviews, internal control enhancement or KYC transformation programmes is highly desirable.
* Accustomed to working with a very large amount of documentation, both physical and digital, while maintaining strong quality standards and traceability.
* Experience managing the general physical archive of documentation is an advantage.
* Proactive attitude and desire to contribute to the Bank by improving processes, controls and client experience.
* Highly organised, structured and accurate way of working, with strong ability to prioritise complex cases and meet deadlines.
* Committed, responsible and resilient personality.
* Customer\-oriented attitude and capability to work under pressure without losing focus, while applying sound risk\-based judgement.
* High level of discretion and trustworthiness.
* Ability to work in a multidisciplinary team and to influence stakeholders constructively across Front Office, Legal, Compliance, Risk and Operations.
* Ability to challenge business stakeholders constructively while maintaining effective working relationships.
* Leadership, mentoring and coaching skills, with the ability to support junior team members and raise quality standards across the function.
* Knowledge of client onboarding, KYC, KYT and data management systems. Experience with banking platforms, workflow tools and digital onboarding solutions is a strong asset.
* Full professional proficiency in English is required. Spanish is an advantage. Knowledge of additional languages, such as or French, is considered a plus.
